plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 Markdown 笔记插件：本地保存、公式与图表、拖拽导入和目录迁移。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Markdown Notes 在 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面端**里，留一处安静记录的地方。 一个独立的 Markdown 笔记插件：从左侧进入，默认阅读，随时编辑，保存为电脑上的普通 `.md` 文件。所有工作区共用笔记目录，无需调用模型或连接云端笔记服务。 [下载安装包](https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-markdown-notes/releases/latest) · [使用说明](#使用) · [开发](#开发) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-markdown-notes/issues) ![笔记阅读界面](docs/images/reading.png) > 社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。目前面向 **Windows 桌面版 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 开发；其他 DSH 版本尚未验证。 ## 功能 - **阅读与编辑**：默认展示排版后的文章；点击「编辑」修改源码，支持并排预览。 - **简单的文档管理**：平铺列表、新建、重命名、删除、草稿另存为。 - **自动保存**：停止输入约 450 ms 后保存；离开编辑区、切换文档或点击「完成」时保存，也支持 `Ctrl+S` / `⌘S`。 - **丰富的 Markdown**：代码高亮、表格、任务列表、脚注、数学公式、Mermaid、信息图、注音和提示框。 - **拖拽导入**：把 `.md` / `.markdown` 文件拖入页面，复制导入并打开；保留原文件，同名文档自动改名。 - **目录迁移**：在界面中更换保存目录，自动搬迁笔记，迁移成功后删除空的旧文件夹。 - **资源管理器**：从「更多」菜单直接打开当前笔记目录。 - **按需加载**：未打开笔记时仅加载轻量入口，编辑器和图表库在使用时加载。 不注册 Agent 工具，不读取聊天记录，不请求模型。没有同步、文件夹树、附件管理或版本历史。 ## 更多预览 以下截图来自实际 DSH 桌面窗口。截图中的 DSH 导航栏属于宿主应用。
文本样式与嵌套列表 ![文本样式与嵌套列表](docs/images/formatting.png)
LaTeX 数学公式 ![行内与块级公式](docs/images/math.png)
Mermaid 流程图 ![Mermaid 流程图](docs/images/mermaid.png)
源码编辑与并排预览 ![编辑器与并排预览](docs/images/editor.png)
## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-markdown-notes/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-markdown-notes-0.3.1.tgz`，**无需解压**。 2. 打开 DSH **主界面左侧「插件」**，点击右上角「添加插件」。入口不在设置中的「内置插件」列表里。 3. 粘贴下载包的完整本地路径，例如： ```text D:\Plugins\dsh-markdown-notes-0.3.1.tgz ``` 4. 按提示安装、启用；如果提示需要重启，重启 DSH。 5. 从左侧「笔记」进入。 Release 安装包已包含构建产物，不需要单独安装 Node.js、React 或构建工具。GitHub 自动生成的 **Source code ZIP** 是源码，不是可直接导入的插件安装包。 ### 升级 关闭正在编辑的笔记并确认显示「已保存」，然后通过 DSH 插件页面卸载旧版、安装新版并重启。笔记与保存位置配置独立于安装包，卸载插件不会删除它们。 安装包声明了与 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 的兼容性。如果新版本 DSH 拒绝安装，请先核对兼容性，不要直接忽略版本检查。 ## 使用 ### 阅读、编辑和管理文档 - 文档栏顶部「新建」直接创建笔记并进入编辑。 - 单击文档打开阅读，点击右上角「编辑」修改；编辑时可切换源码和并排视图。 - 点击顶部文档名称可以改名；删除、另存为、导入等操作位于「…」菜单。 - 删除需要确认，确认后直接删除磁盘文件，不进入回收站。 - 文件被其他编辑器修改时，插件会提示冲突并保留草稿，可使用「草稿另存为」。 ### 保存位置与自动迁移 默认位置是当前用户主目录下的 `Documents/DSH Notes`，例如： ```text %USERPROFILE%\Documents\DSH Notes ``` 在「… → 保存位置」中选择文件夹或输入绝对路径，点击「迁移并使用」： 1. 保存当前草稿，检查新旧目录和同名冲突。 2. 复制顶层 `.md` 笔记与插件的初始化标记。 3. 保存新路径，再清理已成功迁移的旧文件。 4. 旧目录为空时自动删除；有其他文件、子文件夹或迁移期间被外部修改的文件时，保留并提示。 迁移不会覆盖目标目录中的同名文档。复制或配置保存失败时，原文件保留。新旧目录不能互为父子目录，也不能是磁盘根目录、用户主目录或目录链接。 新路径保存在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh-markdown-notes\settings.json`，重启、升级后继续生效。插件的 `directory` 配置项仅作为首次使用时的初始目录；之后请通过界面迁移。 ### 导入 Markdown 将 UTF-8 编码的 `.md` / `.markdown` 文件拖到笔记页面，或选择「… → 导入 Markdown」。文件会复制到笔记目录，原文件不变；同名文档会添加 `(2)` 等后缀。 每批最多 **20 篇**、合计 **20 MB**，单篇最大 **2 MB**。直接放入目录的 Markdown 文件，可通过「… → 刷新列表」加载。 ### 默认示例 首次使用会创建 `Markdown 内容示例.md`，展示常见及扩展语法。同名文件已存在时不覆盖；示例可自由编辑、改名或删除。删除后不会反复生成。 示例改编自 [Doocs Markdown 编辑器](https://github.com/doocs/md)的示例文档，已移除结语后的推荐阅读和二维码。原文中关于微信公众号菜单、公式编辑器等其他产品的说明仅作为文章保留，不代表本插件提供对应功能。来源与许可见 [第三方说明](THIRD_PARTY.md)。 ## Markdown 支持范围 | 内容 | 支持情况 | | --- | --- | | 标题、段落、强调、删除线、分隔线 | 支持一至六级标题 | | 列表与引用 | 有序、无序、嵌套列表、任务列表、多层引用；任务状态通过源码修改 | | 链接、图片、表格、脚注 | 支持网络图片、文档内脚注跳转 | | 代码 | 常用语言高亮、复制；未知语言保留原文 | | 数学公式 | KaTeX：`$…$`、`$$…$$`、`\(…\)`、`\[…\]` | | Mermaid | 本地渲染流程图、饼图等图表 | | AntV Infographic | 本地模板渲染，默认示例的四个图标随包提供 | | PlantUML | 展示源码，不发送至外部渲染服务 | | 行内扩展 | `==高亮==`、`++下划线++`、`~下标~`、`^上标^`、Ruby 注音 | | 提示框与学术环境 | `> [!TIP]` 等警告块，以及 `::: tip`、`::: theorem` 等容器 | | 目录 | 单独一行的 `[TOC]` 生成二级及以下标题目录 | | HTML | 保留经过清理的展示标签，不执行脚本和事件处理器 | 公式字体、图表引擎和默认信息图图标随插件提供。Markdown 中的网络图片仍从原地址加载；自定义信息图中未随包提供的图标会省略，不联网检索。没有图片上传、本地附件解析或微信公众号专用图片滑动组件。 ## 性能与边界 - 启动入口约 **16.7 KB**，页面、编辑器、预览、Mermaid 和信息图库通过 DSH 原生加载器分别加载。 - 图表接近可视区域时才绘制；并排预览等待输入停顿 **300 ms** 后更新。 - Mermaid 缓存最多 12 项、约 100 万字符；不启动后台轮询或目录监听。 - 超过 **12 万字符**的文档暂停自动预览，可手动加载；超过 **8,000 字符或 180 行**的图表需手动绘制，超过 **32,000 字符**仅展示源码。 - 文件操作采用异步 I/O；迁移只串行化本插件的操作。 插件仍与 DSH 共享界面线程，首次加载和复杂图表可能产生短暂长任务，已经加载的库也会占用内存。因此不承诺任意文档都绝对零卡顿。强制结束进程或断电时，尚未写入的草稿也不能保证恢复。 ## 开发 需要 **Node.js 22+** 和 npm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-markdown-notes.git cd dsh-markdown-notes npm ci --ignore-scripts npm run build npm run typecheck npm test npm pack --pack-destination dist ``` `npm run build` 会先生成内置示例、离线图标和 KaTeX 字体样式。生成文件不提交到 Git。需要单独生成时运行 `npm run generate`。 构建完成后，可在 DSH「添加插件」中输入项目的绝对路径进行本地安装。修改后重新构建并重启 DSH。 ### 浏览器检查 ```bash npx playwright install chromium node scripts/browser-check.mjs ``` 检查脚本使用构建后的真实插件代码、文件 API 和独立临时目录，不连接 DSH 账号或读取个人笔记。覆盖阅读、编辑、保存、导入、迁移、按需加载、明暗主题及窄窗口；结束后关闭浏览器、服务并清理临时数据。结果写入 `artifacts/qa`。 Explorer 在测试中使用替身，只核对目标路径。隔离浏览器测试不能替代 DSH 原生加载器、目录选择器和 Explorer 窗口的宿主验收。 ### 主要文件 | 文件 | 职责 | | --- | --- | | `src/client.tsx` / `src/page.tsx` | 轻量入口、笔记页面与交互 | | `src/editor.tsx` / `src/preview.tsx` | 编辑器与按需预览 | | `src/markdown.ts` | Markdown 解析及扩展语法 | | `src/storage.ts` | 文件读写、导入、迁移 | | `src/settings.ts` / `src/explorer.ts` | 保存位置配置与系统目录入口 | | `scripts/build.mjs` | DSH 分块构建与依赖许可汇总 | | `tests/` | 保存顺序、迁移、导入、渲染等测试 | 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/Wanyi424/dsh-markdown-notes/issues) 反馈问题。请附上 DSH 版本、插件版本、复现步骤和经过脱敏的截图或最小 Markdown 示例。 ## 许可证与致谢 本项目代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。第三方库、示例内容与相关品牌遵循各自的许可，详见 [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md)。 感谢 DeepSeek Harness、CodeMirror、markdown-it、KaTeX、Mermaid、AntV Infographic、DOMPurify、Highlight.js、Lucide、Material Design Icons 与 Doocs。

plugins.description: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: gateway + dashboard control, Hermes own health report, and the DSH <-> Hermes bridge. Generated mirror of plugins/hermes-panel - do not edit here.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hermes-panel

[中文文档](README.zh.md) | English

> **`1.1.0-rc.1` — a pre-release, published on purpose before it is finished.** It is on npm and in the
> market so that it can be installed, used and broken by someone other than its author, which is the only
> test that was ever going to catch the interesting bugs. Install it the same way as anything else; the
> version number is the honest part.

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar panel for the
**native [Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) agent**: it finds your Hermes
installation, starts and stops its messaging gateway and web dashboard, and embeds the native
dashboard in a panel.

There is **no Hermes panel in the left sidebar**. The plugin registers nothing there.
It ships **one seat**: a `Hermes` tab in the right column, opened from the ⊕ list's
**Open Hermes** row, with three faces switched by a row of icons in its strip (the
active one is marked, each has a tooltip):

| | |
|---|---|
| 🌐 | **Dashboard** — an iframe of the native Hermes dashboard, beside the conversation rather than in place of it: DSH on the left, Hermes on the right, one window |
| 💬 | **Record** — the Hermes ↔ DSH exchange, read from DSH's own session logs; every row says which directory it ran in |
| ⚙ | **Setup** — the health report and upgrade, the DSH bridge, and the shared workspace |

The same strip carries **start / stop**, **restart**, and **↗ open in a new tab**.

The tab belongs to no session, so it rides the conversation view: switching sessions
keeps it, and switching faces never reloads the page — the iframe never leaves the
document, it is only hidden.
| Health † | runs Hermes' own `official-web/doctor.ps1 -Json` and renders its nine-point report |
| Upgrade † | runs `check-update.ps1` to report, then `update.ps1 -Apply` to upgrade — stopping Hermes first, and **not** starting it again |
| Install † | a guided install for a machine that has no Hermes at all: clone (or use a local checkout), run its `install.ps1`, re-discover |
| DSH bridge | both halves of the DSH ↔ Hermes channel: writes `mcp_servers.dsh` into Hermes' `config.yaml`, diagnoses the MCP client version each profile resolves, and hands Hermes a **session id** so it can review a result and send a follow-up into the same session |
| Shared workspace | one directory both agents work in; the `AGENTS.md` inside it is read by both, so shared context needs no conversion |
| Configuration | **none required** — Hermes is discovered automatically |
| Languages | Chinese and English, chosen at runtime |
| Platform | Windows (process control uses `netstat` / `taskkill`; see [Platform](#platform)) |

† **These three are the `official-web` distribution's own maintenance scripts.** An upstream
Hermes — `pip install hermes-agent`, data in a home directory with `config.yaml` — has none of
them, and there is no `hermes-agent` equivalent to call instead, so the panel **disables the three
and says why** rather than offering a button that fails. Everything else (start/stop, the
dashboard, the record, the bridge, the shared workspace) works on any installation, and
`GET /hermes/api/status` reports the set as `capabilities`.

> **Not to be confused with `hermes-web-ui`.** That npm package brands itself *Ekko Studio* and
> used to be named *Hermes Studio*. This plugin targets the **native** Hermes Python agent
> (`hermes_agent`, `HERMES_HOME`), not that one.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @guanyang14700/dsh-hermes-panel
```

Restart `dsh` afterwards — the **host** half is a Node module and browser refreshes do not reload it.
The panel then appears in the sidebar as **Hermes**.

### What it needs

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 1.0.0` (a peer dependency, checked by the panel and reported per profile) |
| Hermes | any installation the plugin can recognise — upstream (`pip`/`pipx`/`uv`, home with `config.yaml`), or the `official-web` distribution (home with `official-web/.env`). **Hermes is not bundled**; with none installed, the panel offers a guided install |
| Optional | `official-web/` inside that home — its four PowerShell scripts are what 体检 / 查更新 / 升级 / 安装 wrap. Without it those three controls are disabled |
| For the DSH bridge | a `python` (the one carrying `hermes-agent`), a `node`, and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in `~/.dsh/.env` |
| OS | Windows. Process control shells out to `netstat` / `taskkill`, and the maintenance scripts are PowerShell — see [Platform](#platform) |

> Development checkouts use `@guanyang14700/dsh-hermes-panel` through a `link:` dependency. See
> [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for the rename procedure and what has to follow it — the profile
> needs the package linked under its new name before DSH can resolve the bundle.

## Zero configuration

Nothing about *this machine* is hard-coded. On activation the plugin looks for a Hermes
installation by testing each candidate directory for either marker: **`config.yaml`** (upstream
layout) or **`official-web/.env`** (the distribution layout). When the distribution's `.env` is
there, `HERMES_HOME`, `VENV`, `HERMES_EXE` and `DASHBOARD_PORT` are read from it — it is already
the single source of truth for those values.

The CLI is resolved in this order: the configured `hermesExe`, the distribution's `HERMES_EXE`,
a `VENV`, then **`hermes` on PATH**. A home that has none of those is still reported as found —
the panel shows its status, its settings and the bridge, and says which setting to fill before it
can start anything.

Candidate directories, in order:

1. `hermesHome` from the plugin config;
2. the `HERMES_HOME` environment variable;
3. `%USERPROFILE%\Hermes`, `%USERPROFILE%\hermes` and `%USERPROFILE%\.hermes`;
4. `Hermes` / `hermes` / `.hermes` under **every ancestor directory of this package** — the layout
   where the harness and the Hermes checkout sit side by side.

Each candidate is also expanded to its `home/` subdirectory, which is where the `official-web`
distribution keeps the data directory.

If nothing is found, the panel says so and lists every path it tried. **Re-detect** re-runs the
search, so installing Hermes while the panel is open is picked up without restarting DSH.

### Settings

Because empty values mean *detect this*, override only what you need.

**Where to change them:** open the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar (the entry that installs and
manages plugins) and, under the **Official** group, click the **Hermes Panel settings** card. That
card exists because this plugin registers its own settings page into the panel's `plugins.item`
slot — see [why that is necessary](#why-the-settings-page-registers-itself).

> The panel lists this plugin **twice**, and both entries are real. Under **Installed** is the
> bundle card with the enable/disable switch; under **Official** is the settings page. They are
> named differently on purpose: two identically titled cards, only one of which carries the form,
> is how you end up opening the wrong one.

The same values live in the profile's own patch layer, which is what a settings save writes:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hermesHome` | `''` | Hermes home; empty = auto-detect |
| `hermesExe` | `''` | Hermes CLI; empty = `HERMES_EXE` from `.env`, else derived from `VENV` |
| `dashboardPort` | `0` | `0` = `DASHBOARD_PORT` from `.env`, else 9150 |
| `bindHost` | `127.0.0.1` | dashboard bind interface |
| `extraSearchPaths` | `[]` | extra directories to search, one per line |
| `installSource` | `''` | a git URL to clone, or an existing local checkout, used only when no Hermes is found. Empty = install nothing |
| `installTarget` | `''` | where to clone; empty = `%USERPROFILE%\Hermes` |
| `bridgeWorkspace` | `''` | where DSH's file tools resolve when Hermes drives it; empty = the DSH root's parent |
| `sharedWorkspace` | `''` | a directory both agents work in; empty = no sharing |
| `bridgeProfile` | `''` | DSH profile the bridge drives; must not mount Hermes' MCP servers; empty = `dsh-agent` |
| `manageGateway` | `true` | start/stop the messaging gateway along with the dashboard |
| `autostart` | `false` | bring Hermes up when t

plugins.description: Open delivered-file cards with the system default app
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-open-native

点交付卡片 → 直接用**系统默认程序**打开文件（`.xlsx` 就是 WPS），不再跳进 DSH 右侧的
内置预览。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的交付卡片（`present` 出来的文件那个卡片）把两件事刻意分开了：

- **点卡片本体** = 在右侧 Sidebar 内嵌预览。这是写死的，没有设置项能改。
- **用系统默认程序打开** = 卡片上另一个独立的分体按钮「打开（默认）」。

这个插件把第一件事改成第二件事。

> 注意：这个插件只负责「走哪条打开通道」。文件最终由哪个程序接管，仍然取决于
> Windows 对那个扩展名的默认程序关联。如果点开发现是微软 Office 而不是 WPS，
> 那是系统关联的问题（`FileExts\.xlsx\UserChoice` 的哈希失效），不是插件的问题。

## 怎么做的

改动全在浏览器端，不碰 DSH 本体（不改 `app.asar`，升级不会丢）。

- DSH 的卡片里那个铺满整块的预览按钮，`title` 属性上挂的就是解析后的绝对路径
  （`resolveWorkspacePath(cwd, file.path)`）。
- 原生打开的通道是宿主的 `session.openWorkspacePath({ path })`。
- 本插件在 `document` 的**捕获阶段**监听 `click`：命中 `[data-presented-file]` 卡片、
  且不是点在卡片右下角的动作按钮上时 → `preventDefault()` 掉原来的预览 →
  改调 `session.openWorkspacePath`。

## 保留原来的行为

**按住 Shift（或 Ctrl / Alt / Cmd）点卡片**，仍然走 DSH 内置的侧边栏预览。

## 安装

这是一个标准的 DSH 插件包（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-open-native
# 或者用本地打包好的文件：
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/绝对路径/dsh-open-native-1.1.0.tgz
```

装完在 DSH 可视化页面的「插件」面板里就能看到它（标题「原生打开」，带图标），
可随时启用/停用。

## 包装内容

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半区：不注册任何服务，只为让 bundle 能被加载 |
| `lib/client.js` | 客户端半区：捕获阶段的点击拦截，真正干活的部分 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，把本插件挂进 profile |
| `icon.svg` | 插件面板里的图标（`package.json` 的 `icon` 字段） |
| `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`、`locale/zh-CN.json` | 面板里显示的名称与描述 |

`package.json` 里的 `dsh.engines.dsh` 声明了适用的 DSH 版本（`>=0.2.0-rc.2`），
是给插件市场做兼容判断用的元数据。

## 排错

按 F12 打开开发者工具，看 Console 里有没有 `[dsh-open-native]` 开头的警告：

- `宿主没有受理原生打开` → 宿主拒绝了这次调用（路径不在会话工作区内，或宿主没装
  原生打开能力）。
- 什么都没打出来 → 说明点击没被识别成卡片，多半是 DSH 改了卡片的 DOM 结构
  （见下）。

## 它可能在什么时候坏

插件靠两个 DOM 特征认卡片，DSH 大版本更新后可能要跟着调：

- 卡片容器：`[data-presented-file]`
- 预览按钮：`button` 的 class 里含 `cardPreview`

两处都在 `lib/client.js` 顶部的常量里。改完记得重新打包并向 profile 重装一次。

第二条有退路：类名对不上时，插件会退回「卡片里第一个 `title` 是绝对路径的按钮」，
所以 DSH 单纯重命名 CSS module 不会让它整个失效——**真正会一击致命的是卡片容器标记**。
另外路径必须长得像绝对路径（`C:\`、`\\`、`/` 开头）才会被打开，避免把 `title`
上的普通文案当成路径去调宿主。

## 版本

- **1.1.0** — 预览按钮识别加了退路；路径改为从「这一下真正点到的按钮」上取，
  卡片里出现多个文件时不会认错。
- **1.0.0** — 首个版本。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 归档管理插件：双 Tab 面板管理已归档会话，支持归档/取消归档/彻底删除
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-manager

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager)](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-4f6ef7)](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager)

Archive manager plugin: manage **archived sessions** and **active sessions** of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) in one place.

> **Quick install** (restart DSH afterwards and you are done)
>
> ```bash
> dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
> ```
>
> Other install methods: see [Installation](#installation) | Version downloads: see [Releases](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases)

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has built-in session archiving: archiving a session keeps its data **fully on disk** and merely hides it from the active list. But the built-in archive handling offers only a single filter ("Hide archived / All conversations / Archived only") and **no dedicated place** to review, archive, or clean up sessions in one spot — archived sessions simply pile up on disk.

This plugin fills that gap: it **reuses DSH's native archiving mechanism** and adds a dedicated management UI where "archive" and "delete" sit side by side.

## Features

### Sidebar entry

A new "Archive Manager" icon at the bottom of the sidebar (next to Settings); click it to open the management panel.

### Two-tab panel

The panel has two tabs, and **every session row offers archive-type actions and delete side by side**:

| Tab | Contents | Actions per row |
|---|---|---|
| **Archived** | All archived sessions | [Unarchive] [Delete] |
| **Active sessions** | Currently active sessions | [Archive] [Delete] |

Each entry shows:
- Session title ("Untitled session" when there is no title)
- Session ID (monospace)
- Bound workspace directory (**clickable** — opens directly in the file manager)
- Status badges: `session log` / `cache` / `data missing` / `running`

### Three operations

- **Archive**: calls DSH's native `archiveSession`; the session is hidden from the active list and its **data is kept exactly as is**
- **Unarchive**: calls DSH's native `unarchiveSession`; the session returns to the active list and its **data was never moved**
- **Permanent delete**: removes the session's **session log directory + projection cache** (irreversible)
  - The **bound workspace directory is never deleted** (by design, so your project files cannot be removed by accident)
  - A confirmation dialog guards the operation
  - The archive record is queued and cleaned up automatically by the plugin on the **next DSH start** — no manual step required,
    and after a delete no "empty-data session" will reappear in the active list

### Ghost entry detection

Entries in the archived list whose data was deleted long ago and only an archive record remains are marked "data missing"; deleting such an entry clears that leftover record.

### Agent tools

`archive_list` / `archive_add` / `archive_remove` / `archive_delete`, drivable with natural language.

## Screenshots

The **Archived** tab — every entry offers [Unarchive] and [Delete], and shows the bound workspace directory and on-disk data status:

![Archived sessions](assets/screenshot-2-archived-sessions.en.png)

The **Active sessions** tab — [Archive] and [Delete] side by side:

![Active sessions](assets/screenshot-1-active-sessions.en.png)

## Installation

> Replace `<profile>` in the commands below with your profile name; the DSH desktop app uses `desktop` by default.
> After installing, **restart DSH** and the "Archive Manager" icon appears at the bottom of the sidebar.

### Option 1: Install directly from GitHub (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
```

DSH pulls the plugin from this repository and installs it into the profile as a bundle. To pin a specific version, add a ref:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager#v0.1.0
```

### Option 2: Download a release and install locally

1. Open the [Releases](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases) page,
   download **Source code (zip)** of the latest version and extract it
2. Install using the path of the extracted directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<absolute path of the extracted directory>
```

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-archive-manager
```

Uninstalling removes only the plugin itself; it does **not** delete any session data or archive records.

## Usage

1. Click "Archive Manager" at the bottom of the sidebar to open the panel
2. In the "Active sessions" tab, click [Archive] on sessions you no longer need — they are hidden from the active list while their data is kept as is
3. In the "Archived" tab, review all archived sessions
4. Click [Unarchive] when needed to put a session back into the active list
5. For sessions you no longer need, click [Delete] → confirm → permanent delete (irreversible)

## Safety notes

- **Deletion is irreversible**: the session log and projection cache are removed outright, and a confirmation dialog is shown first.
- **The bound workspace directory is never touched**: even if a session is bound to `D:\projects\xxx`, deleting an archived session removes **only session data**;
  your project directory and the files in it are completely unaffected.
- **Archiving itself carries zero risk**: it only writes a marker; no data is moved or copied, and you can unarchive at any time.
- Session data is located by **scanning `$DSH_HOME/sessions/*/` for an exact sessionId match** rather than re-deriving
  the path encoding, which avoids deleting the wrong directory.
- Deletion is idempotent: if the target directory or cache is already gone, it counts as "already deleted" instead of raising an error.

## Implementation notes

- **Source of the archived list**: the runtime projection is preferred (`workspaceController.follow()`'s first-frame baseline carries
  `archivedSessionIds`; the stream is aborted as soon as it is read), with a fallback to the persistent snapshot in
  `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`. The panel therefore reflects the in-memory truth rather than a possibly stale disk copy.
- **Active sessions**: `sessionQuery.listSessions()` (which already excludes archived sessions), plus a defensive de-duplication pass.
- **Session title / cwd**: read from the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
  (the cache embeds these values in a `{ <key>: { val } }` structure).
- **Session log directory**: `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace encoding>/<sessionId>/`, located by exact-match scanning;
  after deleting a session, if its workspace encoding directory becomes empty, that empty directory is cleaned up as well.
- **Archive / unarchive**: calls DSH's native `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`
  and `unarchiveSession(id)` — the plugin does not implement archiving semantics itself.
- **Removal from the archive set goes through the "pending-cleanup queue" (key design)**: permanent delete has three steps — delete the log, delete the cache, and
  **enqueue** the id, but **does not unarchive at that moment**.
  The reason: `unarchiveSession` means "send this session back to the active list", not "forget this id".
  If you previously opened a session in the archive panel, it stays in the harness's memory; deleting the on-disk data
  and then unarchiving makes the harness put this session — no data, but still in memory — back into the active list,
  where opening it necessarily fails with `session/not-found` — and **only a restart clears it**.
  Once queued, the session stays archived (so it can never appear in the active list) and the plugin runs
  `unarchiveSession` on the **next start** to finish the job — at that moment memory is clean, so unarchiving cannot trigger a ghost.
  Queue file: `$DSH_HOME/storages/archive-manager-pending.json`;
  queued entries are hidden from the panel immedi

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for other agent harnesses.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.
Every request is attributed to the calling agent and every session is recorded against its creator,
so several harnesses can share one endpoint and still ask "which sessions are mine?".

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | A page of the session index: `sessionId`, title, running state, archival state, activity time, and the recorded owning agent (`view: "full"` adds cwd and liveness). Narrow server-side with `query` (title/cwd/owner/id), `mine: true` (or the `restrictToOwner` setting), `owner: "<id>"`, and `running`; page with `cursor`/`nextCursor`. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | A window of one session's transcript (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset`. `mode: "tail"` (default, last 10) / `"head"` / `"outline"` (one compact row per message with a preview and length, no full text); `roles`, `afterSeq` + `window.nextAfterSeq` to page, `maxChars` (default 2000) to cap a single answer. Reports `totalMessages`, `matchedMessages` and `returned`, so the caller always knows what it has not read. `limit: 0` still means everything. Works while the session is archived. |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_search_sessions` | Find sessions by content server-side and get bounded snippets instead of transcripts: title/cwd/owner/id (`scope: "title"`) or the messages themselves (`"messages"`, `"both"` by default). Looks at the newest `scan` sessions the caller can see (default 20), reports `where`/`seq`/`snippet` per match, and then `dsh_read_session` reads just that session. |
| `dsh_whoami` | How this endpoint identifies the calling agent — `x-dsh-mcp-client` header, else `initialize` `clientInfo`, else `User-Agent` — plus the sessions that agent created. Attribution, not authentication: callers share the endpoint token. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do; `query` narrows by name or description and `limit` caps the list. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, and the default permission preset. |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session and a command such as `/compact` exists only when that
session's preset composes it (`standard`/`ptc`/`cordis` do; `minimal` does not). Execution goes
through the same `commands.execute()` the Web composer uses: the handler runs immediately, the
lifecycle is logged as `command/run` + `command/done`, and **no model turn is started**. `kind` is
`success` or `error`; a line the Host would not parse as a command, or a name it does not know, is
rejected with the available commands listed.

### Progressive disclosure

A session's log runs to megabytes and a Harness can hold hundreds of sessions, so no read is a dump:
each tool takes the smallest question that answers what the caller needs, and every payload says what
it did *not* return.

| Need | Call |
|---|---|
| Which sessions exist? | `dsh_list_sessions({ mine: true, query: "tripothon", limit: 10 })` — index rows are id, title, running, archived, time, owner. |
| The next page | `cursor: nextCursor` from the previous result. |
| What is in a long session? | `dsh_read_session({ sessionId, mode: "outline" })` — role, seq, chars, preview per message. |
| What just happened? | `dsh_read_session({ sessionId })` — the last 10 messages, with `window.reachedEnd`, `totalMessages` and `returned`. |
| Walk it forward | `afterSeq: window.nextAfterSeq`, `roles: ["user"]`, `maxChars: 0` when the full text is really needed. |
| Where was X mentioned? | `dsh_search_sessions({ query: "mount", mine: true })` — snippets from titles/cwd/owners and from the messages of the newest `scan` sessions. |
| Which Harness tools exist? | `dsh_list_tools({ query: "file" })`. |

Costs stay bounded by construction: `scan`, `limit`, `perSession` and `maxChars` are ceilings, n

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: deepseek_pricing_tier — is the DeepSeek API on peak (full price) or off-peak (half price) right now, and when does it flip. Zero network, no API key.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-pricing

**English** · [简体中文](#简体中文)

[![tests](https://github.com/ybbms777/dsh-deepseek-pricing/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ybbms777/dsh-deepseek-pricing/actions/workflows/test.yml)
![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-cordis%20bundle-blueviolet)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that answers the two questions that decide a DeepSeek API bill: **is the API on peak (full price) or off-peak (exactly half price) right now**, and **when does it flip**. It also reports today's peak windows and the live list prices for the tier you are in.

Registering one tool:

| Tool | What it returns |
|---|---|
| `deepseek_pricing_tier` | `tier` (`peak`/`off`), `reason`, Beijing wall clock, today's peak windows, the next switch time + countdown, per-model prices for the live tier, and optionally the upcoming switches |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:ybbms777/dsh-deepseek-pricing"
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin` activates it as a profile layer. Restart `dsh --profile web` afterwards, then check **Settings → Plugins**. Peer dependencies: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (^4.0.1) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (^0.0.1-rc.1).

## Why an agent wants this

Off-peak is **exactly 50% of peak** and is decided by when a request *finishes*. Before launching a large batch, retrieval sweep or evaluation run, the agent can ask:

> peak hours are Beijing (UTC+8) Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding Chinese public holidays; everything else — weekday nights, the 12:00–14:00 lunch break, all weekend, all holidays — is half price.

So a job that can wait costs half as much. The tool is pure arithmetic on DeepSeek's published rate card: **no network calls, no API key, no credentials**, `isConcurrencySafe` is true, and it never writes anything.

## Use

Once mounted, the model calls `deepseek_pricing_tier` on its own. Typical args:

```jsonc
{ "at": "2026-10-12T09:30:00+08:00", "format": "summary" }  // evaluate a specific instant
{ "days": 7, "format": "json" }                             // now + upcoming switches
```

Rendered output for a peak instant:

```
PEAK — DeepSeek bills full price right now
now (Beijing): 2026-10-12 09:30:00 (Monday) — outside the weekday peak windows (Beijing 09:00-12:00, 14:00-18:00)
today's peak windows: 09:00-12:00, 14:00-18:00 (Beijing)
next switch: 2026-10-12 12:00:00 → off-peak (half price) (in 0d 02:30:00)
deepseek-flash: in(cache miss) 2 / out 8 RMB per 1M — DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, concurrency 2500
deepseek-v4-pro: in(cache miss) 9 / out 27 RMB per 1M — DeepSeek-V4-Pro（0813 版）, concurrency 500
```

## One implementation, two consumers

The peak/off-peak rule is **not** re-implemented here. `tier.js` is generated by `tools/sync-core.mjs` from the `/*CORE-START*/ … /*CORE-END*/` block of [deepseek-pricing-panel](https://github.com/ybbms777/deepseek-pricing-panel)'s `index.html`, at a pinned commit, verbatim:

```sh
node tools/sync-core.mjs          # regenerate tier.js
node tools/sync-core.mjs --check  # CI: fail if tier.js drifted from the pin
```

The generated file carries the source commit and the CORE block's SHA-256, and `tests/core.test.mjs` asserts the header — so the model-facing tool and the human-facing HTML panel can never disagree about the rule.

## Tests

```sh
npm ci
node --test
```

16 tests, no test framework beyond Node's own runner. `tests/plugin.test.mjs` **boots the real harness packages**: a real `@deepseek-ai/cordis` context with a real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` `ToolRegistry`, mounts the plugin with `ctx.plugin()`, and executes the tool through the registry pipeline — asserting the model-facing schema, the rendered summary, the JSON value, the error path for an unusable `at`, and the prompt-section wiring. The only stand-in is the `systemPrompt` service the registry injects (a two-method stub). CI runs the suite on Ubuntu + Windows × Node 20/22 plus the drift check.

## Model names

`deepseek-flash` is **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, not V4-Flash: the legacy ids `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` still resolve, but those models are retired and requests are served by V4.1-Flash at Flash prices. `deepseek-v4-pro` is DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Both ids and versions were verified against a live `GET api.deepseek.com/models`.

## Caveats

- Prices and the schedule are transcribed from DeepSeek's published pricing page and can change; this plugin visualises the published rule, it does not enforce it.
- A government make-up workday (调休上班日) is **off-peak** under the rule, because DeepSeek distinguishes only Mon–Fri from weekend.
- The 2026 China holiday calendar is built in; a new year's notice needs a re-pin (`tools/sync-core.mjs` after updating `HOLIDAYS` upstream in the panel).

## License

MIT.

---

## 简体中文

这是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，回答决定 DeepSeek API 账单的两个问题：**现在按高峰（全价）还是空闲（正好半价）计费**、**下一次切换在几点**，并给出今天的高峰窗口与当前生效单价。

注册的工具：`deepseek_pricing_tier` —— 返回 `tier`（peak/off）、判定原因、北京时间、今天的高峰窗口、下次切换时刻与倒计时、各模型当前单价，可选未来若干天的切换列表。

**安装**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:ybbms777/dsh-deepseek-pricing"
```

包内声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`dsh plugin` 会把它作为 profile 层启用；重启 `dsh --profile web` 后在「设置 → 插件」中查看。

**为什么 Agent 需要它**：空闲价正好是高峰的 50%，只取决于请求什么时候跑完。高峰 = 北京时间（UTC+8）周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日）；其余全部时段 —— 工作日夜里、午休、整个周末、整个节假日 —— 都是半价。所以能等的批处理任务，成本直接减半。纯本地算术：**不联网、不需要 API key、不写任何文件**。

**一份实现，两个消费者**：峰谷规则**没有**在这里重写。`tier.js` 由 `tools/sync-core.mjs` 从 [deepseek-pricing-panel](https://github.com/ybbms777/deepseek-pricing-panel) 的 `index.html` 里 `/*CORE-START*/ … /*CORE-END*/` 段按固定 commit 原样生成，文件头记录来源 commit 与 CORE 段的 SHA-256，`node tools/sync-core.mjs --check` 在 CI 里守住不漂移 —— 因此面向模型的工具与面向人的 HTML 面板不可能对规则产生分歧。

**测试**：`npm ci && node --test`，16 个用例、只用 Node 自带 runner。其中 `tests/plugin.test.mjs` 会**真的启动 harness 包**（真实的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 上下文 + 真实的 `dsh-tools` `ToolRegistry`），用 `ctx.plugin()` 挂载插件并走注册中心管线执行工具。

**注意**：`deepseek-flash` 是 **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**（不是 V4-Flash，旧模型名已下线但由 V4.1-Flash 承接）；调休上班日按规则算空闲半价；单价与规则以官方定价页为准。

plugins.description: An exam-revision loop for DeepSeek Harness: drill until every knowledge point reaches your target accuracy. / 通用应试复习闭环，每题必写思维链，蒙对不算对。
plugins.readme_text:
# mastery-loop

**A general exam-revision loop for DeepSeek Harness.** It reads your course materials and your notes vault, then drills you — question, grade, question again — until **every knowledge point** reaches your target accuracy, and finally hands you a pre-exam list.

Two things make it different from a quiz bot:

- **Every question requires you to write your reasoning, not just your answer.** Grading checks the reasoning first, then the answer. **A lucky guess does not count as correct.**
- **Wrong-answer reasons are stored verbatim and reused.** So a mistake you make three times is counted three times, instead of splitting into three near-synonyms and vanishing from the statistics.

通用应试复习闭环：读你的课程材料与笔记库 → 出题 → 批改 → 再出题，直到每个知识点的熟练度都达到目标正确率，最后产出考前 list。**每道题都要求你写出思维链**，批改先判思维链再判答案，**蒙对不算对**。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mastery-loop
```

## 用法：两步

### 1 · 先初始化（只跑一次）

```
/mastery-loop-setup
```

它会探测你的课程材料与笔记库，问清路径 / 素材 / 语言 / 融合方式 / 卷子格式，然后在你**知识库根目录**生成 6 个文件并校验：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ledger.md` | 复习账本（进度 + 已初始化的凭据） |
| `index.md` | 主题 → 知识点的反向索引 |
| `errors.md` | 错误原因表 |
| `paper-format.md` | 每个课程的每个考试的卷子格式 |
| `error-taxonomy.md` | 失分原因分类（**初始为空**，等归纳） |
| `config.md` | 路径 / 每门课的素材选择 / 语言标准 |

> 初始化**有意做成独立的 skill**：它要问六组问题，跟日常复习是两件事。分开之后 `mastery-loop` 本身短得多。

### 2 · 之后正常复习

```
/mastery-loop
```

或者直接用自然语言说「我想开始复习了」—— 这个 skill **模型可以自动调用**。

## 复习循环长什么样

```
读状态 → 与用户逐步确认（范围 / 目标正确率 / 是否混合考）
   → 复习清单
   → 出题（每题后面挂「答案：」「思维链：」两行）
   → 批改（先判思维链 → 再判答案 → 错了才提炼错误原因）
   → 写回账本与错误原因表
   → 达标？→ 问是否继续
   → 考前 list（从第一轮就开始攒，不是最后生成）
```

**达标是逐点判断的**：一个知识点要「**总共出过 ≥ 5** 且 **熟练程度 ≥ 目标正确率**」。不到 5 次标「样本不足」，继续出题。

## 错误原因为什么写成英文

`errors.md` 里的错误原因**默认用英文** —— 因为要套 **ASD-STE100（简化技术英语）** 的写法：一句一个偏移、不超过 20 词、动词开头、不写题号和数字。

这样做的目的是**可统计**：同名错误必须逐字一致，才能数出「我在这一点上错了几次」。

> ⚠️ 口径说明：本 skill **借用 ASD-STE100 的原则**，**不声称符合** ASD-STE100 —— 官方明说它不适用于一般写作。
> 另外，「同一表述必须逐字复用」是本 skill 的**跨文档外推**（STE 只要求「一篇文档内一致」）。**这个外推的责任在本 skill，不在 ASD。**

## 一次只复习一门课吗

**建议**。但范围由你定 —— 跨多门时 skill 会问你是否要**跨课程混合出题**（**默认不混合**）。

## 语言

**按产物类别分别定**（知识点笔记 / 出的题 / 批改解析 / 记录性文件 / 产出 / 机制层），在初始化时问你。想要中英双语对照、法文、或纯中文都行 —— 除了 `errors.md` 的错误原因默认英文（要套 STE）。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Names the provider beside the model in DeepSeek Harness's composer control (Provider/Model) while keeping the provider-grouped picker.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-provider-model-picker

**Provider + Model** — the composer's model control names the provider beside the model: `DeepSeek Demo/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` instead of `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker/releases/tag/v0.3.4)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-provider-model-picker/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

## The ambiguity it removes

The shipped picker prints the catalog model name alone, which is ambiguous as soon
as two providers offer a model with the same name, or as soon as the model is not
the one you think the session is on. This plugin keeps the control exactly where
it is and adds the one fact it was missing.

```
                                    before                  after
   ┌──────────────────────────────┐  ┌───────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
   │  Ask anything…               │  │ DeepSeek-V4.1-F… ▾│  │ DeepSeek Demo/DeepSeek-V4.1-F… ▾ │
   │                              │  └───────────────────┘  └──────────────────────────────────┘
   │  📊  DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash  ▾  │  ⤴ the trigger this plugin re-registers
   └──────────────────────────────┘
```

## What it contributes

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| `conversation.input.model` | re-registered at a lower priority than the shipped picker, rendering this plugin's trigger (`Provider/Model` + reasoning effort) and its two-level menu |
| Locale namespace `dsh-provider-model-picker` | English and Simplified Chinese copy for the control |
| Composer row CSS variables | honours the host's `--dsh-composer-model-text-display` / `--dsh-composer-model-icon-display` compact switch like the shipped occupant |

No host route, no service, no Config: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists only so
the Loader row can carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`).

## The label rule

| Directory state | Trigger shows |
|---|---|
| Model loaded in the catalog | `Provider/Model` — the catalog provider name, or the localized **DeepSeek Account** for the account provider |
| Model missing from the catalog (removed, or its group failed to load) | `Provider/model-id`, using the group's name when known and the raw provider id otherwise |
| No catalog yet | the shipped forms: `Loading models…`, then `Select model` |

The reasoning effort keeps its own caption beside the label
(`DeepSeek Demo/DeepSeek-V4.1-Pro · High`), and the trigger's accessible name and
tooltip use the same provider-qualified string.

**A model that advertises no reasoning levels gets no caption and no Effort row** —
the control offers only what the adapter publishes, exactly like the shipped
picker, because the host rejects an effort its adapter never advertised. For a
`dsh-llm-pi-ai` route that capability is the model entry's `reasoningEfforts`
(omit the field to keep the installed catalogue's own metadata):

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      baidu-team:
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
            name: BD DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
            # level name → the wire value dispatch sends; only `off` may be empty
            reasoningEfforts:
              low: low
              medium: medium
              high: high
```

The level names are `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`.
Declaring them is a host-configuration change, not a plugin one: the same levels
then appear in `/model` and in this control's Effort row.

## Screenshot

![The composer's model control: a trigger reading DeepSeek Demo/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with its root pane open and its model pane open](docs/images/provider-model-control.png)

Both panels come from `tools/preview.mjs`, which renders the built bundle outside
the GUI over a fake catalog. On the left, the trigger names the provider and the
root pane drills into Model and Effort; on the right, the model pane lists every
provider group — and **DeepSeek Demo and Baidu Team both offer
`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`**, which the bare model name cannot tell apart.

## How the shadow works

`conversation.input.model` is a **`single`** slot — one occupant per cell, and the
slot registry renders the **lowest live `priority`**, keeping the higher entry
registered. The shipped picker (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`)
registers at the default `0`; this plugin registers at `-1`.

That choice buys three things:

- **The shipped picker stays installed.** It is not removed, so nothing else that
  refers to it breaks, and the `/model` command popup is untouched.
- **A crash falls back, not blanks.** The registry supervises entries; a component
  that throws abdicates its cell and the shipped trigger renders again.
- **The data is shared.** Both the menu here and `/model` read the same
  per-session directory instance (`ctx.modelDirectories`), so a switch made in one
  is what the other shows next.

If another occupant already holds `priority: -1`, the registration is refused —
the plugin logs and leaves the shipped picker alone rather than breaking the
composer's own registration.

Because shadowing the seat means owning it, the plugin also ships the picker
underneath: the root Model/Effort cells, provider-grouped model list, search past
four models, reasoning-effort levels, pending spinner, keyboard navigation
(`↑`/`↓` walk rows, `Tab` accepts or leaves a drilled pane, `Escape` back/closes),
and an in-menu error strip with Retry.

The registration is held by an effect, and the effect hands back the slot's own
disposer: unloading the plugin removes the occupant instead of leaving a dead
entry in the registry, at which point the shipped picker renders again.

### Why it declares two services it never reads

`inject` lists `remote` and `remote.session`, which this plugin never touches
directly. They are there for the **callee**, not the caller.

`ctx.modelDirectories` is a cordis **service proxy**: it rebinds `this` to the
*caller's* context for the duration of the call. `directoryFor()` builds a
session's directory from `this.ctx.remote.session` — but only on a **cache miss**,
i.e. the first call for a session that no other surface has warmed yet. So the
call succeeds or dies depending on *who asked first*:

| Who calls first for that session | Result |
|---|---|
| The shipped picker or the `/model` popup (they declare `remote.session`) | Directory built and cached; a later call from anywhere is a cache hit |
| This plugin, at `priority: -1`, before the shipped entry renders | `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject` |

That is why the defect looked intermittent and session-shaped: any session whose
directory happened to be warm worked, and a **session switch** — a new session,
this entry first — failed every time. The shipped package declares the same two
services for the same reason.

`test/support.ts` enforces the rule in its directory double, so dropping either
declaration fails the suite instead of the GUI.

## Requirements

- **Node.js >= 22.17** and **pnpm 11.8.0** — the version pinned through
  `packageManager`, which `corepack ena

plugins.description: The GPT Image image generator plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-generation

![dsh-image-gen-plugin](assets/dsh-image-gen-plugin-logo.png)

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件包，做两件事：

1. 给 Agent 注入一个 `generate_image` 工具：给提示词就能出图，并落盘到本机。
2. 在「设置」里加一页「图片生成」：模型、接口地址、密钥、输出格式等都在这里配。

请求走的是 **OpenAI 兼容的 `POST {apiUrl}/images/generations`**，参数名与 Dasipaint 的 `openai.rs::build_request` 一致（`model` / `prompt` / `n` / `size` / `quality` / `output_format` / `background`），所以官方 OpenAI、各种中转网关、自建反向代理都能用。

这个工具不挑模型类型：端点背后是自然语言驱动的自回归绘画模型时，提示词会原样透传，不做任何 GPT-image 风格的模板包装；端点背后是别的图片模型时，也照发不误。真正只有 OpenAI 图片接口才认的字段（`moderation`）默认就不发，还给了开关，见「设置项」。

**目录**

- [安装](#安装)
- [使用](#使用)
- [工具参数](#工具参数)
  - [图生图](#图生图)
  - [自定义分辨率的规则](#自定义分辨率的规则)
  - [画质档位](#画质档位)
  - [文件名模板](#文件名模板)
- [怎么写提示词](#怎么写提示词)
- [设置项](#设置项)
- [工具卡片](#工具卡片)
- [自检](#自检)
- [文件](#文件)
- [安全](#安全)
- [行为说明](#行为说明)
- [关于源码里的两处约定](#关于源码里的两处约定)
- [许可与来源](#许可与来源)

## 安装

`dsh plugin add` 会把包装进 profile，并对照包里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 把它追加到 profile 的 bundle 栈上，不需要手改任何配置文件。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-gen-plugin
```

Harness 里也可以让 Agent 执行 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 填包名 `dsh-image-gen-plugin`。

或者从源码安装 —— 这个目录本身就是完整的包，不需要构建，把上面的包名换成本目录的绝对路径即可：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\MyProject\deepseek-image-generation\dsh-image-gen-plugin"
```

装完刷新一下页面（`http://127.0.0.1:3080`）。升级：改完源码后重新跑一次 `add` 会覆盖安装；Host 侧的 JavaScript 需要重启 DSH 才会加载新的一代。

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-image-gen-plugin
```

## 使用

1. **设置 → 图片生成**：填 API 地址、API 密钥，选模型。
2. 新会话里对 Agent 说「画一只戴帽子的柯基」，它会调用 `generate_image`，图片落在输出目录里，聊天卡片上直接显示。
3. 图生图就直接把源图路径给它，说清楚要改什么。

## 工具参数

`generate_image` 暴露 8 个参数：

| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | 是 | 提示词，用自然语言写。要求图里出现文字时，把文字原样引号写清楚，并说明位置和排法 |
| `resolution` | 否 | **自动比例**（`auto`，默认）或自定义分辨率。自定义写 `宽x高`，如 `1536x864` |
| `quality` | 否 | 画质：`low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max`，对应 低画质 / 标准画质 / 高画质 / 超高画质 / 顶级画质 |
| `count` | 否 | 本次生成几张，1–10；不传就用设置里的默认值 |
| `background` | 否 | `auto` / `transparent` / `opaque` |
| `location` | 否 | 存储位置。**不传就是会话工作区**；相对路径相对工作区解析，绝对路径原样使用，目录不存在会自动创建 |
| `images` | 否 | **图生图**：源图路径数组。最多 16 张，每张 ≤50MB |
| `mask` | 否 | 可选的 PNG 蒙版，标注要改的区域，**必须恰好配 1 张源图**。透明像素是允许重绘的区域，不透明像素保留 |

后几个不传时都取设置页里的默认值；**画质不在设置里**，它是纯调用参数，省略时按 `high` 出图。

**没有 `mode` 参数**：「生成」还是「编辑」由 `images` 有没有值决定——**这一个开关就够了**，多一个参数只会多一种自相矛盾的可能（声明 edit 却不给源图、声明 generate 却给了源图）。传 `images` 就是编辑，不传就是生成。

### 图生图

传 `images` 就把调用从「生成」变成「编辑」：

| | 无 `images`（文生图） | 有 `images`（图生图） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 端点 | `POST /images/generations` | `POST /images/edits` |
| 编码 | `application/json` | `multipart/form-data` |
| 源图 | — | `image` 字段，可多张（**API 硬上限 16 张**） |
| 蒙版 | — | `mask` 字段，**恰好 1 张 PNG，且只配 1 张源图** |

提示词写法要跟着换：文生图描述整幅画面，图生图描述**改动**（"把背景换成纯色影棚墙"、"把毛色改成姜黄"、"加一条红围巾"）。

两条链路都有回归测试：断言传源图时确实打到 `/images/edits` 且是 multipart，以及**纯文本调用仍然走 `/images/generations` 的 JSON**（防止我把所有调用都塞进编辑分支）。

multipart 是**手写编码**，不是 `FormData`：boundary、CRLF、每个 part 的头部都由本插件控制。网关对 multipart 的挑剔远超 JSON，用 `FormData` 只能拿到一句「400 Bad Request」，手写能让失败指到具体位置。断言逐字节检查了开头的 boundary、结尾的 `--boundary--`、每个 part 的 `Content-Disposition`、`image` part 的 filename 与 Content-Type、数字字段以文本传输、以及**源图字节原样嵌入**。

### 自定义分辨率的规则

尺寸校验照抄 Dasipaint 的 `openai.rs::validate_size` 与 OpenAI 图片接口的文档，按同样的顺序校验：

1. 宽和高都必须是 **16 的整数倍**；
2. 长宽比不超过 **3:1**（即 1:3–3:1）；
3. 最长边不超过 **3840**；
4. 总像素在 **655,360 – 8,294,400** 之间。

第 4 条是关键：**3840×3840 反而超限**（14,745,600 像素），能被接受的尺寸里最大的正方形是 2880×2880；3840×2160 是合法且可用的。批量出图时注意这一点。

工具描述里附了一份全都合法的现成尺寸，覆盖竖版（知识卡、海报）、横版（导图、幻灯片）和超宽（时间轴、横幅）三种版式，例如 `1024x768` / `768x1024` / `2048x1536` / `3840x2160` / `2160x3840` / `3840x1920` / `3696x1584` / `2048x1024`。

### 画质档位

`quality` 五档，从低到高：`low`（低画质）、`medium`（标准画质）、`high`（高画质）、`xhigh`（超高画质）、`max`（顶级画质）。这五档沿用 Dasipaint `genspec.ts::GEN_QUALITIES` 的划分，直接映射到请求体的 `quality` 字段。

### 文件名模板

设置页里可配 `fileNameFormat`，四个占位符混搭随意：

| 占位符 | 渲染成 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{time}` | `2026-10-07T08-14-43-188` | 时间排序 |
| `{prompt}` | `a-cat-in-a-hat`（slug，最长 60 字符） | 一眼看出内容 |
| `{index}` | `1`、`2`… | 区分数张 |
| `{uniq}` | `4a9ea17a` | 保证不重名 |

默认 `{time}-{prompt}`。**同名不会覆盖**：写文件用排他创建（`wx` 标志），撞名自动加 `-2`、`-3` 后缀——所以像 `{prompt}` 这种不含身份信息的模板也安全，只是可排序性差一点。

## 怎么写提示词

这个工具把提示词原样交给端点背后的模型，不做任何模板化包装。这个模型的自然语言控制力强、**会渲染文字、会排版、审美在线**，知识导图 / 知识卡 / 海报 / 信息图 / 幻灯片这类「有版式、有信息密度」的活正是它的主场。所以：

- **不要**堆风格形容词、权重语法（`(word:1.2)`、`::`）、质量咒语（`masterpiece, 8K, ultra detailed`）、参数旗标（`--ar 16:9`、`steps: 30`）。它自己的审美够用，这些只会挤掉真正的内容。
- **要**说清楚「这是什么、要说什么内容」：格式、分栏/分区/层级数量，每块放什么；图里必须出现的文字用引号原样给出，并说明位置和层级。
- 视觉语言和配色只在调用方明确要求时才指定，否则交给模型决定。
- 画场景、出照片同样可以，用描述场景的普通句子说就行。
- 图生图描述「改什么」，不要重新描述整幅画面。

想按场景切分得很细（构图/镜头/光线/材质分开写）也完全可以，但那是可选项，不是本插件的格式要求。

## 设置项

设置页里的字段直接对应插件的 Config（存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里）：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiUrl` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | 接口基地址，会自动拼 `/images/generations` |
| `secret` | 空 | Bearer 令牌，留空表示不改动。字段名与存法见「安全」 |
| `model` | `gpt-image-2.5-flare` | 模型 id，任意端点支持的都行，输入框可以直接改成你自己的模型名 |
| `count` | `1` | 默认张数 |
| `outputFormat` | `png` | `png`/`jpeg`/`webp`；透明背景不能用 jpeg |
| `outputCompression` | `100` | 只对 jpeg / webp 生效 |
| `background` | `auto` | 默认背景 |
| `moderation` | `auto` | 只有你显式选了 `low` 才会发这个字段（`auto` 是双方的默认值，不发） |
| `user` | 空 | 可选终端用户标识 |
| `defaultResolution` | `auto` | 调用没写分辨率时用的尺寸。`auto` 让模型自己决定比例 |
| `maxEdge` | `3840` | 自定义分辨率的最长边上限 |
| `outputDir` | 空 | 图片落盘目录；留空用插件包内的 `assets/` |
| `fileNameFormat` | `{time}-{prompt}` | 文件名模板，四个占位符见上 |
| `requestTimeoutSec` | `600` | 单次请求超时 |
| `sendsModeration` | `true` | 关掉后永远不发 `moderation`，给不认这个字段的模型用 |
| `sendsOutputCompression` | `true` | 关掉后永远不发 `output_compression` |

设置页里填自定义尺寸时会即时校验，违反上面四条规则会直接标红提示；`defaultResolution` 填了不合法的尺寸时，调用会在发请求前失败并给出原因，不会静默退回默认值；`maxEdge` 改小后 `generate_image` 的工具描述和可用档位会跟着变。画质那一栏已经不是输入框了，那是一段说明文字，告诉你它改成了调用参数。

## 工具卡片

卡片读的是结果的 presentationMeta（文件名和访问 URL），模型侧只看到纯文本的绝对路径列表。

- **标题 + 张数**；图片放在固定 260×260 且裁切的框里（**图取不到时不会让 alt 文本把卡片撑变形**）。
- **生成中**：直接显示提示词的**前 5 行**（最后可见字符换成省略号）。不用点任何按钮。
- **出图后**：提示词收起，换成两个展开按钮。
  - **展开提示词** —— 这次调用实际用的**完整**提示词（**全文，不是节段**），仅限高 260px 可滚动，正文一字不裁。
  - **参数** —— 只列这次真正传了的参数（尺寸、画质、张数、背景、位置、写盘文件数）。没传的不显示、不编造；尺寸省略时显示 `auto`。
- 运行时的参数还在流式写入、是残缺 JSON，所以宿主通过 `inject.hooks.toolCallArgumentsPartial` 注入读取流式前缀的 hook，客户端用容错解析只捞字符串字段（**闭合引号可选**，这正是「边生成边显示」的关键）。hook 缺失或抛错时退回 `block.argsRaw`。
- 展开状态由 DSH 的 `useDisclosure` 托管（所属 Turn 重置时自动收起）；该 hook 缺失、抛错或返回畸形对象时**自动退回本地状态**，按钮照常可用。空提示词则不显示提示词区块。
- **卡片不会因为畸形输入而消失**：卡片读的是本插件不拥有的日志，所以每处读取都是全函数（total）——`props`/`block` 不是对象就当归空、`meta.images` 不是数组就当归没有、`url` 不是非空字符串就不渲染（**包括访问器抛异常的条目**）、`argsRaw` 不是字符串就不解析、两个 hook 缺失/抛错/返回 Proxy 都退回本地状态。最外层还有一个 class 错误边界兜底：真抛错时渲染一张**说明失败原因的最小卡片**，而不是留下一行空白。渲染的鲁棒性有一整套畸形输入断言网兜着。

## 自检

```powershell
cd D:\MyProject\deepseek-image-generation\dsh-image-gen-plugin

# 依赖已随插件安装装好时
npm run check

# 依赖还没装时，指向本机 DSH 安装里的 @deepseek-ai 目录
$env:DSH_PACKAGE_ROOT = "C:\Users\<你>\AppData\Local\nvm\v22.22.1\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
npm run check

# 想看模型实际读到的工具描述（改完提示词先跑这个）
node show-prompt.mjs
```

四个套件：

- `checks/host.mjs`：Config 默认值、尺寸四条规则、请求体组装、multipart 逐字节结构、工具注册形状与八个参数、凭证字段命名、文件名消毒、源图校验。
- `checks/client.mjs`：设置页渲染与保存（含密钥不被回写）、尺寸即时校验与主机同判定、提示词在**三个 phase 全生命周期**的可读性、翻译函数的签名契约、错误边界、中英文切换。
- `checks/live.mjs`：用假的 fetch 跑完整调用链——落盘、路由取图、错误信息、取消、重试、`images` 路由、输出 schema 校验。
- `checks/pressure.mjs`：**极端压力套件**。上千条合成畸形输入打向尺寸规则、base64 解码、文件名模板、源图规范化、multipart 编码、生成入口，**任何引擎级异常（TypeError / ReferenceError / Cannot read / is not iterable）都算失败**（「用文字拒绝」是正确结果）。这套件把手写 fetch 桩设为**先记录再抛错**，所以**结构上不可能产生 API 费用**，并会把「出网尝试次数」报出来。

## 文件

```
dsh-image-gen-plugin/
├── package.json          包清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      插入插件行，带一份默认 config
├── index.js              Host 侧：Config schema + generate_image 工具 + 图片路由
├── client.js             浏览器侧：设置页 + 工具卡片（原生 JS，无构建）
├── icon.svg              插件管理页的图标
├── show-prompt.mjs       打印模型实际读到的工具定义全文（不是测试，是查看器）
├── LICENSE               MIT
├── assets/               插件自己的资源目录
│   ├── dsh-image-gen-plugin-logo.png   项目 logo
│   ├── served-index.json               已写出文件的索引（自动维护）
│   └── <生成的图>.png                   outputDir 留空时的落盘位置
└── checks/               自检脚本，与插件运行无关
    ├── all.mjs           依次跑下面四套
    ├── host.mjs          H

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) - converts the whole rendered interface, including third-party plugin copy, at the DOM layer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-tw-ui

[繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) | **English**

Renders the **entire DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI in Traditional Chinese
(Taiwan)** — DSH's own copy, **third-party plugin copy**, and text that later DSH
versions add — by converting the DOM, not by shipping a language pack.

```
Settings -> General -> Language: 中文 (Simplified)   <- the app's own locale
What you actually see:           繁體中文（台灣）     <- converted on screen
```

Because it works at the render layer, it does not have the failure mode that
dictionary-based language packs have: *uncovered copy falls back to Simplified
Chinese and the UI looks half-translated.*

---

## The problem

DSH ships exactly two locales: `zh` (Simplified) and `en`. Using DSH in Taiwan
breaks in three places at once:

1. **DSH's own UI** is Simplified without a language pack;
2. **third-party plugins** (market, sidebar, IM bridges, Agent Teams, …) each ship
   their own Simplified dictionaries, which no language pack can reach;
3. **every DSH release adds copy**, so a language pack's dictionary is always one
   version behind.

This plugin attacks the shared root cause: whatever produced the text, it is
converted on screen.

## Goals / non-goals

**Goals**

| | |
|---|---|
| G1 | The whole page in Traditional Chinese: DSH itself, third-party plugins, and dynamic content that appears later |
| G2 | **Decoupled from the DSH version** — a DSH upgrade must not break it |
| G3 | **Touches no DSH internals**: no dictionary registration, no `LocaleRuntime` patching, no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer range — so DSH's compatibility gate can never skip it, and it coexists with other locale plugins |
| G4 | A clear safety boundary: code, editors and anything you type are **never** altered |
| G5 | Reversible, auditable, tunable (a runtime switch, an override table, a skip marker) |

**Non-goals**

- **Not a language pack**: no new entry in DSH's Language list, no change to DSH's
  locale setting.
- **No translation beyond Simplified → Traditional**: English is left alone, no
  model calls.
- **Does not change stored data** — see [Limitations](#limitations).
- **Web/desktop clients only**: no DOM in TUI or headless profiles.
- **Does not convert text painted into a canvas, or cross-origin iframes.**

---

## Why not just use another Traditional Chinese plugin?

This is the reason the project exists, so here is the honest version. All figures
were checked on **2026-10-13** from each package's npm manifest or repo README.

| Option | Mechanism | Covers third-party plugins | Relationship with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-better-locale` 0.4.3 | registers dictionaries (39 namespaces) | no | peer says `^0.1.5-rc.2` (excludes 0.2.x) → needs a manual exact-version exemption to load |
| `@mimateinn/dsh-i18n` 0.2.6 | dictionaries + Simplified→Traditional character fallback | yes | peer says `<0.2.0-0` → blocked by the compatibility gate without an exemption |
| `dsh-locale-zh-tw` (npm, 0.1.1) | patches `LocaleRuntime` internals | yes | documents itself against the `dsh-client-locale@0.1.1-rc.2` shape; **degrades silently** on mismatch |
| `dsh-multi-lang-ui` 0.1.1 | dictionaries + char table + DOM fallback | yes | peer has no upper bound, passes the gate — mechanically the closest to this project |
| `iceice666/dsh-locale-zh-tw` | dictionaries only (50 ns / 1691 strings) | no (by design, per its README) | — |
| **dsh-zh-tw-ui** (this project) | **pure DOM conversion** | yes | **no peer dependencies, touches no DSH API** |

Each existing approach has a structural weakness:

1. **Dictionary-based** (better-locale, iceice666) — coverage is frozen at the
   upstream version the pack was built against. Measured on this machine:
   better-locale 0.4.3 ships 39 namespaces while DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 registers about 49
   core namespaces, and **17 of them have no Traditional dictionary at all**
   (`pluginManager`, `permission`, `settings.shell`, `settings.webSearch`,
   `agent-team`, `voice-input`, `schedule.manager`, …). Worse, its fallback chain
   is `zh-TW → zh → en`, so the gaps render in **Simplified, not English** — which
   is exactly why a language pack can look like "it installed but nothing
   happened".
2. **Core-patching** (the npm `dsh-locale-zh-tw`) — tightly coupled to DSH
   internals and *designed* to degrade silently: after a DSH update it can simply
   stop doing anything, without an error.
3. **Declared peer ranges** — when your DSH version falls outside them, DSH
   **skips the whole bundle at boot**, silently (the on-disk `compatibility.json`
   exemption list is the fingerprint of working around that).

**This project's trade-off**: touch no DSH API, work only on the DOM. The price is
that it is a *display-layer* conversion; what you get is version independence,
coverage of third-party plugins, and failures you can actually see. The full
consequences are listed under [Limitations](#limitations).

> Note: `dsh-multi-lang-ui` overlaps this project functionally and is a valid
> alternative. This project deliberately stays smaller and single-purpose: **DOM
> conversion only** — one job, no dictionary to keep in sync, no
> `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency of any kind.

---

## How it works

```
                ┌─ DSH's own copy (Simplified)
screen text ────┼─ third-party plugin copy (their own Simplified)
                └─ content that appears later (streaming, dynamic panels)
                        │
                        ▼
        DOM text node → OpenCC cn→twp (Taiwan wording) → override table → write back
                        ▲
                        └─ MutationObserver: re-run on added nodes / changed text
```

- Engine: **OpenCC `cn → twp`** (Simplified → Traditional with Taiwan vocabulary):
  设置→設定, 网络→網路, 软件→軟體, 文件夹→資料夾, 服务器→伺服器, 内存→記憶體,
  屏幕→螢幕, 鼠标→滑鼠, 保存→儲存, 搜索→搜尋, 插件→外掛.
- A small override table (`DEFAULT_OVERRIDES` in `src/convert.mjs`) fixes wording
  OpenCC misses or renders in a non-Taiwan way: 只讀→唯讀, 超時→逾時, 反饋→回饋,
  獲取→取得, 許可權→權限.
- `<html lang>` is set to `zh-Hant-TW` so the browser picks Taiwan glyph forms.
- Memoised per text node, non-Han strings short-circuit, and values are only
  written when they actually change — the converter also remembers its own writes,
  so it can never ping-pong with React.

## Safety boundary: what is never converted

| Target | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `<code>` `<pre>` `<kbd>` `<samp>` `<var>`, CodeMirror / Monaco / xterm / ace / syntax highlighting | **subtree and attributes untouched** |
| `<input>` `<textarea>` `<select>` `<option>` | only `placeholder` / `title`; **what you type or pick is untouched** |
| `contenteditable` (including rich-text composers) | untouched |
| `<svg>` `<math>`, `<script>` `<style>` `<canvas>` `<iframe>` `<video>` `<audio>` | untouched |
| anything marked `data-zh-tw-skip` or `translate="no"` | untouched |
| strings without Han characters (English, kana, digits, code) | passed through |

In other words: **code is never rewritten**, and copying code behaves exactly as
before.

---

## Install

### A. From this repo (the supported path today)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/linmino/dsh-zh-tw-ui.git
cd dsh-zh-tw-ui
node install.mjs --profile desktop      # 'desktop' is the default; use --profile web for the web profile
```

`install.mjs` does exactly four things, all reversible:

1. backs the profile's `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml` up as `*.zh-tw-ui.bak`;
2. appends `dsh-zh-tw-ui` to `dsh.profile.bundles`;
3. sets the `locale` row's `preference` to `zh` (Simplified underneath, Traditional
   on screen — this keeps the UI Chinese even if you later remove another language
   pack, instead of falling back to English with nothing to convert);
4. links `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-zh-tw-ui` → this directory.

It runs **no package manager**, so nothing else in your profile is re-resolved.

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness** — a new bundle is composed only at boot;
refreshing the page is not enough.

### B. From npm (not published yet)

The name `dsh-zh-tw-ui` is currently free on npm. Once published:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-zh-tw-ui
```

### Uninstall

```sh
node uninstall.mjs --profile deskto

plugins.description: DSH 插件：把工作区备份到 S3 兼容对象存储（RustFS / 阿里云 OSS / AWS S3）。凭证只从环境变量读，不落盘、不回显、不进日志。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-oss-backup

把文件备份到**对象存储**的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。支持 RustFS / MinIO 等自建 S3 兼容服务、
阿里云 OSS、AWS S3 —— 一次配置，之后在设置界面点几下就能把整个文件夹传上云。

---

## ⚠️ 安全须知（先读这一段）

1. **优先用密钥管理器把凭证注入环境变量。** 1Password CLI（`op run -- dsh web`）、
   HashiCorp Vault、AWS Secrets Manager、Azure Key Vault、Doppler、direnv 都行 ——
   插件只读 `process.env`，所以**让密钥留在它该待的地方**，
   远比复制粘贴到某个文件里安全。具体接法见 **[凭证接入指南](docs/credential-sources.md)**。
2. **不要用主账号密钥。** 请新建一个**只能读写指定桶**的子账号，只给它 `PutObject` 权限。
   本文「[第 2 步](#第-2-步创建最小权限子账号必做)」有现成的配置可抄。
3. **别把密钥写进会被提交的文件** —— README、issue、脚本、截图、Dockerfile 都算。
   本插件**支持 `.env`**（启动时自动读、**只读不写**），但它只适合本地临时使用；
   用之前**务必确认 `.env` 在 `.gitignore` 里**（本仓库已挡 `.env` / `.env.*` / `*.key` / `*.pem`）。
4. **密钥一旦出现在聊天记录、日志或提交历史里，就当它已经泄漏** —— 立刻去服务商后台轮换掉。
5. **本插件自己不会把密钥写到磁盘上。** 密钥只在内存里流转，界面永远只显示"已设置 / 未设置"，
   日志里也只会出现变量**名**，不会出现变量值。（`.env` 是**你**写的、插件只读 —— 落不落盘由你决定。）
6. 想确认这一点，可以在配好之后自己检查：`~/.dsh/oss-backup/config.json` 里
   **只会有开关、目录、桶名这类非机密信息，不会有任何密钥**。

---

## 一、它能做什么

### 四个用法

| 用法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **手动备份整个文件夹** | 在设置界面填一个目录，点「立即备份」，它就会把该目录（含所有子目录）递归传上去 |
| **定期全量备份** | 按时间表（每 N 分钟 / 小时 / 天，或每天、每月固定时刻）自动把整个目录完整传一遍 |
| **文件改动自动备份** | 打开开关后，每次保存文件（模型用 `write` / `edit` 改文件）都会在 2 秒后自动上传 |
| **让模型上传单个文件** | 模型可以直接调用 `oss_backup` 工具，把一个本地文件传到指定的对象路径 |
| **《接数据》**（趣味） | 点「立即备份」时先在「上传状态」框里玩一局节奏小游戏，通关才真的开始备份。不想要可以在设置里关掉 |

### 支持的对象存储

| provider | 适用 | 寻址方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rustfs`（默认） | RustFS、MinIO 等**自建** S3 兼容服务 | path-style |
| `aliyun` | 阿里云 OSS | 虚拟主机风格 |
| `aws` | AWS S3（也可指向其它 S3 兼容服务） | 虚拟主机风格 |

> 已实测通过：**RustFS 真实上传**（本机）、**阿里云连通性**。AWS 与阿里云的完整上传流程
> 依赖你自己的账号环境，仓库里的配置示例可直接照抄。

### 界面上有什么

- **设置 → 对象存储备份**（与主面板内容一致）：
  - 顶部两张卡片：存储端点、环境状态（是否配好、密钥是否已设置）；
  - **上传状态**：进度条 + 最近几次上传的大小；；
  - **云端备份**按钮：打开当前 provider 的网页控制台，方便核对桶里的内容；
  - **设置**：自动备份开关、备份目录、「跳过依赖 / 缓存目录」开关，以及折叠的「高级设置」；
  - **凭证**：在界面里临时填写密钥（见[第四节](#凭证在设置界面里临时填写密钥)）；
  - **手动备份**：「立即备份」按钮 + 进度条 + 上次结果；
  - **环境自检**：provider / 端点 / 桶 / 区域 / 密钥是否已设置；
  - **最近上传**：时间、对象路径、大小。
- **左侧栏**：一栏状态提示（`已就绪` / `上传中` / `缺配置` / `未连接`）。

---

## 二、安装

```bash
cd <你的插件目录>
pnpm add dsh-plugin-oss-backup          # 或把打好的 .tgz 装进 DSH profile
```

装完后**重启 `dsh web`**，设置页里就会出现「对象存储备份」。

<details>
<summary>本地开发时安装的坑（点开看）</summary>

**不要用 `link:` 安装本地包。** 症状是启动时报 `dsh-plugin-oss-backup: failed to import`：
`link:` 会在 profile 里建一个指向源码目录的软链接，而 Node 解析模块时会先取真实路径，
于是解析起点跳出了 `~/.dsh/profiles` 目录树，插件依赖的宿主模块就找不到了。

正确做法是**先打包再安装**：

```bash
pnpm pack                                   # 产出 dsh-plugin-oss-backup-x.y.z.tgz
pnpm add file:<绝对路径>/dsh-plugin-oss-backup-x.y.z.tgz
```

</details>

---

## 三、配置（照着做就行）

### 第 1 步：决定用哪个 provider

选一个就好：

```bash
OSS_PROVIDER=rustfs     # 默认值，自建服务（RustFS / MinIO）
OSS_PROVIDER=aliyun     # 阿里云 OSS
OSS_PROVIDER=aws        # AWS S3
```

不设置 `OSS_PROVIDER` 时按 `rustfs` 处理。

### 第 2 步：创建最小权限子账号（必做）

**不要跳过这一步。** 用主账号密钥意味着一旦泄漏，整个云账号都危险。

**阿里云 OSS（RAM 子账号）**

1. 控制台 → **RAM 访问控制** → 用户 → 创建用户，勾选"**OpenAPI 调用访问**"
   （只拿 AccessKey，不要开控制台登录）；
2. 创建**自定义权限策略**（不要用 `AliyunOSSFullAccess` 这类系统策略），把 `dsh-backup`
   换成你自己的桶名：

```json
{
  "Version": "1",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["oss:PutObject", "oss:GetObject", "oss:HeadObject"],
      "Resource": ["acs:oss:*:*:dsh-backup/*"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["oss:ListObjects", "oss:GetBucketInfo"],
      "Resource": ["acs:oss:*:*:dsh-backup"]
    }
  ]
}
```

3. 把这个策略授权给刚建的用户；
4. 记下它的 AccessKey ID 与 Secret，下一步要用。

**AWS S3（IAM 用户）**

把上面的策略换成 IAM 语法即可（`Resource` 形如 `arn:aws:s3:::dsh-backup/*`）：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowBackupObjectsOnly",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:GetObject", "s3:DeleteObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::dsh-backup/*"]
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowListOwnBucket",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::dsh-backup"]
    }
  ]
}
```

**RustFS / MinIO**

```bash
mc admin user add <alias> dsh-backup-bot '<一个强随机密码>'
mc admin policy create <alias> dsh-backup-rw ./dsh-backup-rw.json   # 内容即上面的通用策略
mc admin policy attach <alias> dsh-backup-rw --user dsh-backup-bot
```

### 第 3 步：设置环境变量

挑你自己那一档，把值换成上面拿到的密钥。

> **强烈建议优先用密钥管理器接入。** 下面的 `setx` 示例只是"最不依赖任何工具"的写法；
> 更好的做法是让 1Password / Vault / AWS Secrets Manager 这类工具在启动 `dsh web` 时
> 把凭证注入环境变量 —— 密钥就不用出现在 shell 历史、脚本或任何磁盘文件里。
> **完整的接入清单（1Password / Bitwarden / Vault / AWS / Azure / Doppler / direnv /
> Docker / systemd）见 [凭证接入指南](docs/credential-sources.md)。**

**先说清一件事：值从哪来都行。** 插件只关心"这个键在你的进程环境里存不存在"，
不关心它怎么来的。下面这些**完全等价**，用你顺手的那个：

| 来源 | 怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| **密钥管理器**（**推荐**） | `op run -- dsh web`（1Password）、`doppler run -- dsh web`、Vault / AWS Secrets Manager 等 —— 见[接入指南](docs/credential-sources.md) |
| **系统环境变量** | Windows `setx`、macOS / Linux `export`（下面就是这一种） |
| **`.env` 文件** | 复制 `.env.example` 改成 `.env`，放到 `<DSH home>/oss-backup/.env` 或当前工作目录 —— 插件启动时**自动读**（只适合本地临时用，务必确认它被 gitignore） |
| **Docker** | `docker run -e RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY=...` |
| **CI** | GitHub Actions Secrets / GitLab CI Variables 之类 |

**`.env` 的几条规则**（只读，插件**永不写入**）：

- **优先级：`.env` > 系统环境变量**。`.env` 是你显式写下来的那份，比机器上残留的
  旧 `export` 更权威 —— 否则"我在 `.env` 里改了却毫无效果"会非常难查。
  被覆盖的键名会进日志与界面（**只有名字，没有值**）；
- 只采用**第一个能读到的**文件（先看 `<DSH home>/oss-backup/.env`，再看当前工作目录），
  不做多层合并 —— 否则出问题时没法解释某个值来自哪份文件；
- 解析规则就那几条：`KEY=value`、`KEY="value"`、`export KEY=value`、`#` 注释。
  **不支持**行内注释、多行值、变量展开 —— 支持它们只会让"值被悄悄改掉"成为可能的解释；
- 改了 `.env` 要**重启 `dsh web`** 才生效（和系统环境变量一样）。

**① RustFS / MinIO**

```powershell
setx OSS_PROVIDER      "rustfs"
setx RUSTFS_ENDPOINT   "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
setx RUSTFS_BUCKET     "dsh-backup"
setx RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY "<子账号 AK>"
setx RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY "<子账号 SK>"
```

**② 阿里云 OSS**

```powershell
setx OSS_PROVIDER           "aliyun"
setx OSS_BUCKET             "dsh-backup"
setx OSS_REGION             "oss-cn-hangzhou"        # 默认就是这个
# OSS_ENDPOINT 可以留空：会自动拼成 https://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com
setx OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID      "<RAM 子账号 AccessKey ID>"
setx OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET  "<RAM 子账号 AccessKey Secret>"
```

> 如果你显式设 `OSS_ENDPOINT`，**一定要带上 `https://`**。不带协议头时会被当成
> `http://` 处理，连接必然失败。

**③ AWS S3**

```powershell
setx OSS_PROVIDER           "aws"
setx AWS_BUCKET             "my-backup-bucket"
setx AWS_REGION             "us-east-1"              # 必填
setx AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID      "<IAM 用户 AccessKey ID>"
setx AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY  "<IAM 用户 Secret Access Key>"
# AWS_ENDPOINT 一般留空，表示用 AWS 官方端点
```

> **macOS / Linux** 把 `setx X "v"` 换成 `export X="v"`，并写进你的 shell 配置文件。

### 第 4 步：重启 `dsh web`

**这一步不能省。** 环境变量是进程启动时读取的，正在运行的 `dsh web` 不会自动感知新变量。

### 第 5 步：确认配置成功

重启后打开 **设置 → 对象存储备份**，看「**环境自检**」：

- 状态应显示「**就绪**」；
- `provider` 一行会写明当前用的是哪一档（例如 `RustFS / MinIO 等自建 S3 兼容端点 · path-style`）；
- 密钥两行应显示「**已设置（值不显示）**」。

**⚠️ 「就绪」不只看变量配没配齐**：插件会真的对存储桶发一次 `HeadBucket` 去确认服务能连上
（结果缓存 30 秒）。所以还有第三种状态：

| 状态 | 含义 | 怎么办 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **就绪** | 变量齐了，服务也连得上 | 可以直接用 |
| **变量齐了，但服务连不上** | 端点/桶/密钥有一处不对，或者服务根本没启动 | 看下方红字里的具体原因 |
| **缺少 N 个变量** | 环境变量没配齐 | 那一行会列出缺哪个变量名 |

「服务连不上」这一条是专门为下面这种情况加的：**变量都填好了、但 RustFS 没开** ——
以前会显示成"就绪"，看着一切正常，实际上每次上传都在连接被拒。

> **小贴士：`setx` 设了但插件说"未配置"？**
> `setx` 写入的是用户级环境变量，而已启动的进程（尤其是从快捷方式、启动器拉起来的
> `dsh web`）**不一定继承得到它**。所以插件每次启动都会主动去读一遍系统里的环境变量
> （先看进程已有的，再看用户级，最后看系统级），缺什么补什么 —— **不会覆盖你已经设好的值**。
> 界面上会标注「当前来自系统环境变量（启动时自动补读：…）」，看到它就说明补读成功了。
> 你只需要保证**设过值 + 重启过一次**。

---

## 四、使用

### 手动备份一个文件夹

1. 打开 **设置 → 对象存储备份 → 设置**；
2. 在「**备份目录**」里填要备份的目录（例如 `D:\projects\my-project`）；
3. 点「**保存**」；
4. 回到「**手动备份**」块，点「**立即备份**」。

它会**递归备份整个文件夹**，完成后显示：共多少个文件 → 成功几个 / 失败几个 · 总大小。

**没变化的文件会自动跳过。** 插件在 `~/.dsh/oss-backup/uploaded.json` 里记着每个对象键对应的
`(文件大小, 修改时间)`，下次备份时一致的直接跳过 —— 所以重复点「立即备份」只会传真正改过的
那几个，不会再把你几千个没动过的文件重传一遍。界面会显示「跳过 N 个未变化的」。

> 判定依据是**大小 + 修改时间**。改了内容一般也就会改修改时间，所以会被正确重传；
> 只有"内容变了但大小和修改时间都没变"这种刻意为之的情况才会漏判。
> 换机器或删掉那个索引文件也不影响正确性 —— 只是会重传一次，之后恢复正常。

上传后的对象路径规则是 **前缀 + 被备份目录自己的名字 + 相对路径**。例如备份
`D:\projects\projects\yy`（里面是 `11`、`22` 两个子文件夹），桶里会出现：

```
workspace-backup/yy/11/...
workspace-backup/yy/22/...
```

**`yy` 这一层会保留**，这样在桶里一眼就能看出这批文件属于哪个目录。

> **会自动跳过的目录**：`node_modules`、`.git`、`.hg`、`.svn`、`.pnpm-store`、`.npm-cache`、
> `__pyc
