plugins.description: Persistent long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh), powered by HydraDB.
plugins.readme_text:
# HydraDB DeepSeek Harness Plugin

Persistent, cross-session memory for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(`dsh`), powered by [HydraDB](https://hydradb.com).

It recalls relevant context before each turn, syncs your workspace docs into
HydraDB, and captures conversations as durable memory, over the same shared
engine (`scripts/plugin.mjs`) as the HydraDB Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw plugins.

## What's dsh-specific here

- **Entry module:** `index.js`, an ordinary [Cordis](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
  plugin (`export const name` + `export function apply(ctx)`). dsh mounts it by
  package name and calls `apply` with the plugin `ctx`; it registers listeners
  on the harness interception seams over the shared engine.
- **Env prefix:** per the shared client contract, this client reads the canonical
  `HYDRADB_*` names plus the `HYDRA_DEEPSEEK_*` prefix (see `CONTRACT.md`).
- **Skills:** the shared HydraDB skills under `skills/` for manual recall/ingest.

## Seams

| dsh extension point | Engine action |
|---|---|
| `agent/created` | sync workspace docs into HydraDB when a session opens |
| `agent/pre-step` (turn's first step) | recall relevant memory/knowledge and **prepend it to the step messages** |
| `tools/post-execute` (file-writing tools) | incremental workspace sync |
| `session/event` → `turn/end` | capture the completed turn |

Prompt-time auto-recall (`agent/pre-step`) and workspace sync work out of the box.
The `agent/pre-step` waterfall is cooperative: the plugin awaits `next()` and only
prepends a user-role context message to the downstream `enter` decision, so it
composes with other pre-step listeners instead of overriding them.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js >= 18
- A HydraDB account: API key + database ([hydradb.com](https://hydradb.com))
- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)

## Install

This package ships as a dsh **bundle** (`dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`), so
`dsh plugin add` installs and wires it as a profile layer in one step:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-hydradb
```

dsh appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and inserts the `hydradb`
plugin row automatically - no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing. To pass config
inline instead of via the environment, add a `config:` block to the bundle's
`cordis.patch.yml` (see `dsh.config.example.yml` for the `--patch` overlay form).

Credentials come from the plugin config (`api_key`, `database`, optional
`collection`/`base_url`) or the environment:

```bash
export HYDRADB_API_KEY="your-api-key"
export HYDRADB_DATABASE="your-database"
# dsh-prefixed names also work: HYDRA_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY / HYDRA_DEEPSEEK_TENANT_ID
```

The default search mode is `memory`; set `HYDRADB_SEARCH_MODE=both` if you also
want synced workspace knowledge to auto-recall.

## Usage

- **Automatic recall** runs before each turn's first step via `agent/pre-step`
  and prepends relevant memory/knowledge to the step messages.
- The shared skills provide manual `query` / `ingest` / `doctor` / `setup` /
  `last-recall` actions; the contract's canonical slash form is `/hydradb-query`,
  `/hydradb-ingest`, `/hydradb-list`, `/hydradb-inspect`, `/hydradb-delete`.

## Configuration

Config keys, environment overrides, and capture/search/ingest modes are identical
to the other HydraDB plugins - see `config.example.json` and `CONTRACT.md`.

## Verified

Tested against DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) 0.2.0-rc.2: the bundle installs via
`dsh plugin add`, registers as a profile layer, and its `apply` seams activate
cleanly. A live `dsh headless` turn (OpenRouter provider) answered a question
from HydraDB memory recalled and injected through `agent/pre-step`.

## License

plugins.description: Audio-reactive turn rail for DeepSeek Harness: the transcript's own turn marks dance to whatever the system is playing (WASAPI loopback), with hover-only highlighting and a left/right rail option.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pinpu · Spectrum Rail

> Takes over the transcript's **own turn rail** — the marks down the right edge of the
> conversation — and makes them dance to whatever the machine is playing, while
> replacing DSH's built-in "newest turn is highlighted" state with Codex's behaviour:
> nothing highlighted by default, highlight only under the pointer, click-to-jump
> unchanged.

![dancing](docs/preview-live.png)

That is not an illustration. `tools/verify/rail-preview.mjs` builds a real Chromium
page from **the shipped rail's own stylesheet and class names**, extracted from the
installed `dsh-client-ui-chat` bundle, then loads the **real `lib/client.js`** and
drives it (only `/api/dsh-pinpu/spectrum` is stubbed). The differences in mark length
*are* the spectrum: low frequencies at the foot of the rail, next to the newest turn.

Hovering brightens exactly one mark (the third screenshot from the same run):

![hover highlight](docs/preview-hover.png)

## Install

- **From this repository**: add the GitHub repository `sqslm/dsh-pinpu` from DSH's plugin
  page, the same way any other GitHub plugin is installed, or
- **Locally packaged**: `node tools/install-profile.mjs` (`pnpm pack`, then write the package
  into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; `--uninstall` undoes it, `--dry-run` prints the
  plan).
- **Restart DSH once** after the first install: the host half (capture, routes) is loaded at
  process start, the browser half with the page.
- **No dependencies to install**: the native capture module ships with the plugin (see
  [THIRD-PARTY.md](THIRD-PARTY.md)), but it needs a **CPython 3.12** interpreter — DSH bundles
  one and the plugin looks for it on its own.
- **Windows only** for now (WASAPI loopback). On Linux this needs a different source
  (`getUserMedia` monitor or PulseAudio `.monitor`), which is not implemented.

![hover highlight](docs/preview-hover.png)

[中文说明 →](README.zh.md)

## What it changes

The rail's states are CSS-module classes (`mark`, `markActive`, `markPreview`,
`markBusy`, `markUnloaded` → build-hashed `xpvNua_*` names). The plugin reads **no**
class name:

1. **Discovery by geometry** — inside `[data-conversation-scroll]`, find a group of
   sibling buttons with one size, one shared right edge and a constant vertical step
   (≈10px). That group is the rail.
2. **Tagging** — the container gets `data-pinpu-rail`, each mark `data-pinpu-tick="i"`
   counting from the bottom mark (0) upwards.
3. **Overriding with one `!important` stylesheet** —
   - every mark becomes the same dim colour and the same length, which removes the
     built-in highlight *without knowing which class expresses it*;
   - `:hover` brightens the mark under the pointer to full length — and only that;
   - while audio plays, each mark's length is its band's level
     (`transform: scaleX(var(--pinpu-scale))`), bands laid out logarithmically from
     45 Hz to 16 kHz;
   - a mark the app is animating (`markBusy`, detected from the `::before` animation)
     is left alone so its pulse survives.

Click-to-jump is untouched: only the `::before` pseudo-element is restyled, the hit
area is still the app's own button, and its click listener still fires (measured in
the preview: `clicks delivered to the app handler: ["7"]`).

Measured in one preview run:

| State | Last mark (the built-in highlight) | Hovered mark | An un-hovered mark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| before | `rgb(249,250,251)`, `scaleX(1)` | — | dim |
| after, playing | `rgba(255,255,255,.2)`, `scaleX(0.87)` | `rgb(249,250,251)`, `scaleX(1)` | dim, `scaleX(0.49)` |

## Audio: the system output itself (NetEase Cloud Music and friends)

```
any player → default output device → WASAPI loopback → spectrum → the rail
```

- It captures the **loopback of the default output device** — literally what you hear.
  No virtual cable, and no player-specific support.
- To pin one device (headphones plugged in, but capture the onboard card), pick it in
  the settings card's device list; empty means "follow the default output".
- Capture happens in the **host half**: it runs `vendor/loopback.py` with the Python
  the harness ships, and that helper uses the **vendored PyAudioWPatch** (≈290 KB, the
  PortAudio build with loopback support) to open a `[Loopback]` input and stream mono
  float32 PCM on stdout. The host does the FFT and band mapping; the browser half only
  draws.
- Therefore: **no microphone permission, no user gesture**, and not one line of capture
  code in the renderer.

Why not `getUserMedia`: it can only open *capture endpoints*. Measured on this machine,
the registry has `立体声混音 (Realtek USB Audio)` but disabled (`DeviceState=0x10000001`
where every endpoint Chromium lists is `0x1`), so `navigator.mediaDevices` never shows
it; more importantly Stereo Mix mirrors **one** render device, and this machine listens
on that headset — so even enabled it would not carry what you hear. Loopback of
the default output is the only thing that works.

## Settings (Settings → 频谱律动)

The host owns the **signal**, the browser owns the **presentation**. Everything is
`.volatile()`, so edits apply live (mounting the bundle still needs one restart).

| Field | Default | Side | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | host | master switch; off spawns no capture process at all |
| `device` | `''` | host | empty follows the default output, else a `[Loopback]` device |
| `fftSize` | `1024` | host | FFT window, ≈21 ms at 48 kHz |
| `smoothing` | `0.78` | host | frame-to-frame smoothing |
| `gain` | `1` | host | gain after the level curve |
| `autoGain` | `true` | host | normalise per band against the loudest band |
| `gate` | `0.04` | host | at or below this is silence |
| `minHz` / `maxHz` | `45` / `16000` | host | spectrum range |
| `disableActiveHighlight` | `true` | browser | remove the built-in newest-turn highlight |
| `hoverHighlight` | `true` | browser | highlight only under the pointer |
| `restoreOnSilence` | `true` | browser | stop moving once the audio has been quiet for a while |
| `minScale` / `maxScale` | `0.4` / `1` | browser | shortest / longest mark, as a fraction of 20px (0.4 is the app's own "unloaded" length) |
| `invert` | `false` | browser | put the low band at the top instead |
| `colorMode` | `theme` | browser | `theme` keeps the rail's colour; `spectrum` hues by band; `custom` uses one colour |
| `customColor` | `#4d93f8` | browser | the `custom` colour |
| `glow` | `true` | browser | let each mark's brightness follow its own level |
| `hotScale` | `0.85` | browser | **length threshold highlight**: light a mark whose length reaches this fraction of full (`0` = off) |
| `spark` | `1.5` | browser | **random highlight**: expected highlights per second, each lighting one random mark for 160–420 ms (`0` = off; silence never sparks) |
| `demo` | `false` | browser | drive the marks with a synthetic waveform while nothing is captured |

### The two highlight modes

Both light up marks that are already there — nothing is drawn, added or moved. A highlighted
mark takes the same bright colour a hovered mark gets, at full strength, while keeping the
length the spectrum gave it.

- **Length threshold** (`hotScale`): the comparison is made on the *visible length* — the very
  value written into `--pinpu-scale` — rather than on the level, so one parameter is only ever
  interpreted once. The default `0.85` lights a band that is nearly full length; `1.05` is
  equivalent to off (the spectrum cannot reach it), as is `0`.
- **Random** (`spark`): a rate, not a probability, because a per-frame chance is meaningless to
  tune. Each highlight picks one mark that is neither busy nor already lit and lights it for
  160–420 ms; it releases by itself on a later poll, with no extra timer to leak. **Silence
  never sparks**, so ordinary listening gets an occasional accent rather than a strobe.
- A mark that is still generating (`markBusy`) is left entirely alone, and a pointer on the
  rail still outranks both.

Measured in a real browser (`tools/verify/rail-preview.mjs`, 28 sampled frames):

```
samples with a highlighted mark: 23 of 28 (threshold 20, random 3)
a highlighted mark, computed: {"r

plugins.description: 在 DSH「插件」页里编辑 daily agent preset 的子条目列表（persona 与工具组合）——内存挂载，不写任何文件
plugins.readme_text:
# daily-chat-config

给 DSH 的 `daily` agent preset 加一个编辑入口：**「插件」页 → 本插件那一栏 →「日常配置」**。卡片里显示
当前生效的子条目列表（`preset-daily` 行的 `config.plugins`）的 entry-list YAML 文本，persona 与工具组合
都在这一层。点「保存」把它写进本插件的设置字段（走官方设置服务，落在 profile patch 层里本插件那一行），
点「恢复默认」把字段写空，宿主半随即把上游默认挂回运行中的 preset。

整个过程不碰任何已发布的文件：上游包 `@local/dsh-daily-chat`、`node_modules` 与 DSH 安装目录都保持原样。

## 环境要求

- **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** 或更高 —— 用到这一版的 volatile 设置字段、插件页 keyed 根槽 `plugins.bundle.config`，
  以及 `loader/volatile-update` 事件；更早的 0.1.x 契约不同，装上不会生效；
- 上游插件 [`dsh-daily-chat`](https://github.com/corlinniu/dsh-daily-chat) —— 本插件编辑的就是它声明的 `daily` preset；
- 许可证 [MIT](./LICENSE)。

## 它做什么

| 半边 | 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主 | `index.js` | 设置字段 `yaml`（`.volatile()` 字符串 = 子条目列表 YAML）+ 把它应用到 `preset-daily` 行（`entry.fiber.update(config, true)` 内存挂载；不碰任何文件） |
| 宿主 | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁层，只插入宿主半边一行（客户端半边由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明，不需要另开一行） |
| 宿主 | `package.json` | 包名 `dsh-daily-chat-config`、`dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client`（web 平台 + 客户端模块依赖） |
| 客户端 | `client.js` | **插件页**本插件那一栏的「日常配置」卡片（keyed 根槽 `plugins.bundle.config`）：textarea + 保存 / 恢复默认 + 状态行；值走**内置** `remote.settings`，设置服务或本插件设置项缺失时降级为只读提示 |
| 客户端 | `test/client-harness.mjs` | `client.js` 的自检 harness（stub loader + 手写 hook 运行时 + 官方 `settings` remote 桩，不安装、不联网） |

卡片里显示的值来自：字段有文本 → 该文本；没有 → 空（= 用上游默认）。文本的基线是挂载时从 `preset-daily`
行捕获的 `config`，清空字段时原样挂回去。

## 安装

profile 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`（桌面的默认 profile 是 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）。推荐走「插件」页：

1. 「插件」页添加插件，填 `github:Shiro-Design-16/dsh-daily-chat-config`（也可以填本地克隆目录 —— 后者会被写成 `link:` 依赖）；
2. 重启 DSH；
3. 「插件」页 → 本插件那一栏 →「日常配置」。

命令行等价做法：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Shiro-Design-16/dsh-daily-chat-config
```

它装依赖，并把包名同步进 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。如果你不用命令行、
而是自己动手改 manifest（依赖写 `github:` 还是本地 `link:` / `file:` 都行），那这两处都要照顾到：`dependencies`
里有一条同名依赖，`dsh.profile.bundles` 里也要有这个名字。只改了依赖没进 bundle 清单、或者清单里留着旧名字，
启动日志会报一行 `skipping profile bundle …`：插件不生效，也不影响启动（这行警告是 stderr 打的，日志里能找到）。

装完 `yaml` 会出现在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里；`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 与 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 由宿主运行时
提供、**故意不声明成依赖** —— 一旦声明就会从公共 registry 装一份普通包，而只有 DSH 的 schemastery 会把
`.volatile()` 字段包成 cosmokit `Volatile` 引用（见「已知限制」）。

## 契约

契约分两面：宿主半边 = 本插件的设置字段（见下），客户端半边 = 用**内置**的 remote 命名空间 `settings` 读写它。

面板的坐席是**插件页**：注册进 keyed 根槽 `plugins.bundle.config`，key = 本包 `package.json` 里的 `name`
（`dsh-daily-chat-config`，就是本包的包名），由插件管理器按 bundle 行派发；owner 传下来的 props（`view` / `entryKey`）
用不到就忽略。它**故意不占设置页**：`settings.section` 是设置外壳给自己那排页面（account / general / models /
Agent 预设）用的列表槽，第三方 bundle 不该在中间插一个导航坐席，而「插件」条目本来就是展示与配置各 bundle 的地方。

客户端**故意不把任何 remote 命名空间写进 `inject`**：宿主半没装配时那条 inject 永远无法满足，条目就停在
pending，而渲染器把**任何**未激活条目当致命错误，整个界面起不来。所以客户端 `inject: []`，服务改用
`ctx.reflect.get('remote.settings')` —— 官方**内置**命名空间，第三方 bundle 无需自建 —— 在每次调用时现查；
拿不到服务、或本插件的设置项没注册，就以「宿主未提供设置服务 / 宿主半未启用」降级视图呈现
（横幅 + 编辑器和按钮禁用 + 状态行）。写用
`remote.settings.update('daily-chat-config', { yaml: text }, revision)`（`daily-chat-config` 就是本插件的
loader entry id），「恢复默认」= 写空字符串；被拒时状态行显示宿主返回的原文，绝不显示成功。
`slots` / `locale` 同样走 `ctx.inject([...], cb)` 的回调形式，不占用模块级 `inject`。

**动手加回 `inject` 之前请先读这一段。** 同样是「条目没激活」，宿主侧和渲染器侧的处置完全相反：

| | 宿主侧 `auditStartupEntries`（`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js`） | 渲染器侧 `eM`（`dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-*.js`） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 判定 | 先收集**所有**未激活条目，再筛出 `requiredStartupEntryIds` 里的那些 | 遍历 `ctx.loader.entries()`，把 `fiber.state` 映射成状态名后判 `!== "active"` |
| 白名单 | 有：`requiredStartupEntryIds` 那 7 个 id（`agent-loop`、`webserver`、`modules`、`connection`、`headless-runner`、`acp`、`sdk-jsonrpc-server`），判定时还会并入当前 bootstrap 自己那一条 `bootstrapIncludes.get(ctx)` | **没有** |
| 动作 | 只对白名单里的 `throw`（`required.size > 0`）；其余**只打一行 warning，照常启动** | `o.length > 0` 就 `throw`，一条都不放过 |

所以本插件在宿主侧从来只是 warning（`daily-chat-config` 不在那 7 个 id 里），真正把应用打死的是渲染器
那一侧 —— 崩溃日志里的 `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` 就是这么来的。

渲染器内联的状态表是 `PENDING:0 / LOADING:1 / ACTIVE:2 / FAILED:3 / DISPOSED:4 / UNLOADING:5`，
因此那条判定式等价于 **`fiber.state !== 2`**（`ACTIVE` 是 `2`；`4` 是 `DISPOSED`，不要记错）。

宿主半边对外只有一个设置字段：命名空间 = 本插件的 loader entry id **`daily-chat-config`**，字段名 **`yaml`**。

```
Config = z.object({ yaml: z.transform(z.string(), …).default('').volatile() })
```

- `yaml` 的**内容单位**是子条目列表（`preset-daily` 行 `config.plugins` 那一段的 entry-list YAML），不是整份
  `daily.patch.yml`：行级元数据（`id`/`name`/`description`/`order`）留在 loader 行里，用户改不到 —— persona
  就在子列表里，这才是用户真正要改的东西。
- 值由**官方设置存储**承载：`.volatile()` 字段由 DSH 的设置服务按条目 id 派生成表单，用户在插件页里编辑，
  官方配置编辑器把改动写进当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖记录 —— 宿主半边不碰任何文件。
- 写入前官方先校验目标 `Config`（`resolveConfig` 在 `readFile`/写盘之前），非法文本连文件都碰不到；`apply`
  侧再兜一次，手工改坏的 patch 文件不会把运行中的 preset 带崩。空文本 / 字段未设置 = 用上游默认。
- 生效只走内存：把新子列表挂到 `preset-daily` 行（`entry.fiber.update(next, true)`，`noSave`），不落盘、
  不改行选项，也从不删除 profile patch 里的任何一行。
- 可观测日志：每次应用 / 等待行 / 跳过 / 还原都打一行 `[daily-chat-config] …`，含子条目行数与来源
  （`mount` / `volatile-update` / `entry-init`，还原时标 `source=reset-to-base`），**不含用户文本** ——
  headless 集成验证就 grep 这几行（YAML 报错的 snippet 里会带原文，所以拒因只取首行）。
- **功能信号走 `warn`，并镜像到 `process.stderr`**：本运行期的 Logger 根本没有 exporter —— cordis 的 Logger
  只写内部 buffer，归档里唯一的 exporter 是 `dsh-app-boot` 的启动诊断收集器（`levels: { default: 2 }`，只在
  抛出的 `StartupError` 上挂载、从不打印）。实测两级都零命中：`info` 抓不到，改 `warn` 后仍然
  `grep -F '[daily-chat-config]'` 零命中（真机启动日志里只有 node 自己的 deprecation 警告），于是「apply 没
  跑到」和「跑到了但没人导出日志」分不开。所以结果行走双通道：`ctx.logger.<level>`（留给别的部署里可能存在
  的文件型 exporter）+ `process.stderr.write`（唯一真能留痕的通道；app-boot 自己的诊断
  `skipping profile bundle …` / `disabling profile plugin …` 也是 stderr 写的），两条文本逐字一致。
  这是可观测性取舍、不是「出错了」：等待行只走 logger（每次启动不往 stderr 刷噪音），只有「一直等不到」
  的收尾是 `warn`。

校验规则（任一不通过就拒绝，运行中的 preset 一个字节不动）：文本能解析成 YAML；顶层是行列表；每一行是映射
且有非空 `name`（或 `!!js` 表达式）；`group: true`（或 `name: cordis:group`）的行其 `config` 必须是**嵌套
子列表**；非 group 行的 `config` 必须是映射。拒因写成可读中文 —— 卡片的状态行直接显示它。

### 契约出处

| 结论 | 出处 |
| --- | --- |
| 覆盖记录文件名 | `dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:487` 定义 `PROFILE_PATCH_FILENAME = "cordis.patch.yml"`，`:4137` 导出 |
| 覆盖是整份替换、不深合并 | `dsh-app-boot/README.md:205`「A user patch replaces the whole matched config — an id-targeted patch does not deep-merge, so a profile override restates the bundle fields it keeps」 |
| 空文件会让启动失败 | `dsh-app-boot/README.md:61`（空或只剩注释的 patch 层让 boot 失败，用 `[]` 关掉这一层） |
| 设置字段的官方形态 | `dsh-settings/README.md`「Edit fields that plugins declare with `.volatile()`… Forms identify each plugin by its profile entry id」；活例 `dsh-better-sidebar/lib/index.js:56-63`：只有 **DSH 的** schemastery 会把 `meta.volatile` 字段包成 cosmokit `Volatile` 引用，Loader 的 volatile 提交路径遍历的就是这些引用（公共包产生普通值 ⇒ 实时写入被静默丢弃） |
| 写入前先校验、且由官方写盘 | `dsh-config-editor/lib/index.js`：`next = change(current, inherited)` → `resolveConfig(fiber.runtime, resolved)` → 之后才 `readFile`/`parseDocument`/`writeFileAtomic`（`entry.fiber === undefined` 的条目路由到 insert 行，绝不覆盖既有行） |
| 生效路径 | `cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js:393-425` `Entry._commitVolatile()`：schema 校验失败只 warn、运行中的引用不动；成功则 `fiber.ctx.emit(self, "loader/volatile-update", paths)` |

plugins.description: Windows 全局划词助手：Cherry 同款取词基础，复用 DSH 模型翻译、解释与总结。MIT 开源。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Selection Assistant · 划词助手

[![Verify](https://github.com/bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**让常开的 DeepSeek Harness 顺便接管全局划词，不再为这一个功能多留一整套聊天软件。**

Windows 划词工具条：**翻译 / 解释 / 总结**，另有可输入、粘贴 OCR 文字的**快捷翻译**窗口。复用 Cherry Studio 所用的 MIT `selection-hook` 取词基础，界面、提示词和 DSH 集成独立实现。

> **开发预览版。** 当前目标是 Windows 10/11 + DSH Desktop **0.2.0-rc.2**。依赖版本刻意锁定，其他 DSH 版本需要验证。已接入真实宿主，三种模型操作完成，用户确认自动划词和译文正常。自动化测试不等于各类应用都兼容；详见[验证记录与资源实测](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。不宣称零进程或固定内存占用。

## 界面预览

以下截图由纯示例文字生成，没有真实选区、模型请求或私人数据。

![划词工具条](docs/images/toolbar.png)

![原生结果窗](docs/images/panel.png)

[设置窗口预览](docs/images/settings.png)

![快捷翻译](docs/images/quick.png)

[深色快捷翻译](docs/images/quick-dark.png)

## 设计

- 选中文字只弹工具条，**点击动作后才调用模型**。
- 非激活原生工具条不抢原窗口焦点；结果窗可选中文本、复制、停止、置顶、拖动和缩放。
- 通过 `ctx.llm.stream` 使用 DSH 已配置的模型；不复制 API Key，不启动完整 Agent，不开放文件/命令工具，不创建一堆“未分组”会话。
- 单次无历史请求，英文默认译成中文、明显中文默认译成英文；解释/总结默认中文，也可固定输出语言。96 种目标语言可按中文、英文或本地名称搜索，支持自定义语言；翻译质量取决于所选模型。
- 自定义三类提示词，支持 `{{targetLanguage}}`。显式独立模型或跟随 **DSH 全局默认模型**，不是跟随当前打开的会话。
- 首次加载处于暂停状态。用户在设置中勾选后才开始监听；托盘可暂停，`Ctrl+Alt+D` 可手动取词。
- `Ctrl+Alt+T` 或双击托盘打开快捷翻译。支持输入、粘贴、清空、目标语言、复制、停止、重试及 `Ctrl+Enter` 翻译；也可用 Alt+Tab 找回窗口。
- 标题栏水滴按钮调节 20%–100% 不透明度；四边、四角均可连续拖拽调整大小。划词结果窗与快捷翻译窗分别自动保存大小和透明度，关闭或重启 DSH 后恢复；更换屏幕时按可用区域调整。
- 点击翻译后结果窗会出现在前方；固定按钮控制持续置顶，生成过程中不会反复抢焦点。
- 暂停划词后仍可手动翻译；两个窗口独立处理请求。打开、粘贴、修改语言均不发送请求。
- 快捷翻译关闭后保留本次进程内的内容，清空或退出后释放，不写入历史文件。剪贴板只有图片时提示先 OCR。
- 浮条默认位于鼠标松开点左下方，右端贴近松开点；靠屏幕边缘自动避让，底部空间不足时移到上方。快捷取词使用可信选区坐标；结果窗手动拖动或固定后保留位置。支持系统、浅色和深色主题。
- 翻译窗口、设置窗口及托盘使用当前 DSH 主程序的图标，适配不同显示缩放；图标从已安装宿主读取，不另行下载。
- 跟随系统主题时，已打开的窗口也会自动切换深浅色；唤醒、解锁和重新打开时再次核对。调透明度或选语言时，Esc 优先关闭弹层。
- 剪贴板兜底默认关闭，密码管理器和终端默认排除。只处理选区，不主动读附近段落。
- 无公开 HTTP 端口、无网页脚本桥、无遥测、无原文/结果历史文件。仅用继承的 stdio JSONL 连接私有子进程。

## 运行结构和资源取舍

```text
DSH Host 插件                  Node 取词伴生进程              C# WPF 原生界面
模型/设置/取消  ← stdio →  selection-hook 2.1.1  ← stdio →  工具条/结果/设置/托盘
```

**增加两个辅助进程，不增加 Chromium/WebView2 进程。** 取词 native addon 不装入 DSH 主宿主，异常的 UIA provider 不应拖住整个 DSH。WPF 使用 Windows 现有的 .NET Framework 4.8，首次加载用系统 C# 编译器从本仓库源码构建，输出缓存到插件数据目录；不下载编译器、不要求管理员、不修改 DSH 安装包。

窗口只做 UI，不联网；辅助进程环境采用 OS 字段白名单，不继承模型 API Key、DSH 认证变量或 `NODE_OPTIONS`。模型凭据只留在 DSH。

## 安装（确认兼容后）

优先通过 DSH 的 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入：

```text
github:bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant
```

仓库不需要 JavaScript 构建步骤。`selection-hook` 包含 Windows 原生预编译依赖；不同包管理器可能询问是否允许其 `node-gyp-build` 安装脚本。请先审阅再决定，**不要授权不相关的生命周期脚本**。源码开发可以先 `pnpm install --ignore-scripts`，本项目已通过直接加载 prebuild 验证，不要求自动重编译 native addon。

CLI 示例（仅在你的运行实例确实使用此 profile 时）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant
```

应用自有 profile 可能不同，优先在当前实例的插件页面安装，不要盲目修改其他 profile。宿主提示需要重启时，请先保存当前任务再重启；本插件不会自行重启 DSH。

首次加载会出现托盘图标，右键打开设置：

1. 确认 DSH 已配置可用模型。
2. 阅读隐私说明，勾选“启用全局划词监听”，保存。
3. 在普通文本应用或浏览器中选中文字，点击翻译、解释或总结。
4. 取不到时先试 `Ctrl+Alt+D`；需要模拟复制的应用才显式打开剪贴板兜底。

### 停用 / 卸载

- 暂停取词：托盘 → 暂停全局划词（停止 hook 和取词热键，快捷翻译仍可用）。
- 完全停止：在当前 DSH 插件页面关闭或卸载本插件；卸载清理自有进程。
- 设置保留在 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-selection-assistant/settings.json`（未定义 DSH_HOME 时为用户目录的 `.dsh` 下同一路径）。这里仅有偏好和自定义提示词，没有模型密钥、选区或结果。
- 两个翻译窗口的宽、高和不透明度另存于同级 `window-state.json`，在调整后自动保存，不依赖原生编译缓存。原文和译文不会写入此文件。
- 原生编译缓存位于同级 `native-cache`。希望清除设置时先停用插件，再自行删除这个明确的插件数据目录，不要删除整个 DSH 数据目录。

## 隐私与边界

选区本身可能含敏感数据。应用黑名单与明显凭据格式拦截只是一层辅助，**不是全面密码/隐私检测保证**。不需要时暂停；不要把敏感选区提交给云模型。模型服务的计费、存储及 DSH 自身诊断策略仍适用。

开启剪贴板兜底可能模拟复制并短暂接触剪贴板，无法保证所有第三方应用都完全无副作用。默认关闭。不开管理员权限来绕过 UIPI；提权应用、图片/扫描 PDF、canvas 和特殊编辑器可能无法取词。首版不包含 OCR、原文替换、翻译历史、自动上传、自动联网搜索或自动执行工具。

结果支持安全的轻量 Markdown（标题、列表、引用、粗体、行内码、代码块）；不执行 HTML、不自动打开链接。复杂表格/公式不是浏览器级排版。

## 开发与验证

本项目直接在 `main` 分支开发，验证后同步 GitHub，保持单一主分支。

需要 Node 22.19+；原生 UI 构建在 Windows 使用已安装的 .NET Framework 4.8（精简版 Windows 可能缺失）。

```powershell
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm verify              # JS 语法 + 无 hook / 无模型调用的单元测试
pnpm build:native        # 系统 csc 编译原生 UI
pnpm demo                # 仅示例 UI 的冒烟测试和本地截图；不监听真实选区
node scripts/verify-window-restart.mjs # 独立原生进程重启、尺寸/透明度恢复与语言提交
node scripts/verify-window-preferences.mjs # 偏好文件、原子保存及异常恢复
node scripts/verify-languages.mjs # 语言搜索、选择与旧设置兼容
node scripts/verify-toolbar-placement.mjs # 松开点对齐、边缘避让和多种缩放
node scripts/verify-host-icon.mjs # 已安装宿主的多尺寸图标与原生窗口图标
node scripts/verify-theme.mjs # 系统主题通知、已打开窗口、固定主题与退出清理
node scripts/verify-popup-keyboard.mjs # 弹层键盘优先级，不误停翻译或关窗
```

示例截图仅写入 gitignored 的 `.local/`。`demo` 不加载取词库、不注册全局快捷键、不访问剪贴板、不调用模型。CI 在 Linux/Windows 运行纯逻辑测试，并在 Windows 编译 UI。

`node scripts/benchmark-native.mjs` 会显示合成窗口并记录固定流式文本和十次关闭重开的界面资源样本。它只测原生 UI，不代表两个 helper 的总占用或与 Cherry 的对照。

本地源码链接不提供 JS 热更新：DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的插件开关可能复用已加载的模块。修改 Host JS 或构建器后需要在任务停止时正常重开 DSH；只改原生界面时，可通过插件开关重载。构建缓存指纹包含全部 C# 文件、manifest 和 app.config；`native-cache/<hash>/ui-status.json` 只保存最近的进程、热键注册和错误类型，不含原文、译文或密钥。

### 发布前手动验收

- [ ] 真实 DSH 加载/停用/重启，确认没有孤儿进程。
- [ ] Chrome/Edge、记事本、常用文档/PDF 的真实取词。
- [ ] 点击动作后原文不串、切换选区不覆盖已显示结果。
- [ ] 三种动作的真实模型结果、停止、失败和重试流程。
- [ ] 高 DPI、多显示器、负坐标、贴屏幕边缘。
- [ ] 暂停、黑名单、无剪贴板兜底时剪贴板保持不变。
- [ ] 统计两个辅助进程的总工作集与空闲 CPU，不只看主进程。

## 开源与许可

本项目 **MIT**。第三方许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。`selection-hook` 为 MIT；Cherry Studio 主程序为 AGPL-3.0。这里没有复制 Cherry 的应用源码、图标或长提示词，也不宣称由 Cherry/DeepSeek 官方开发。

问题反馈：[Issues](https://github.com/bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant/issues)。请不要上传 API Key、私人选区、聊天日志或完整本机配置。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: move sessions between workspaces safely — frame-level zstd header rewrite, byte-level verification, full-directory backup, live membership update
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-mover

> 把 DSH 会话从一个工作区安全搬到另一个工作区，**保留可续聊的完整历史**。
> Move DSH sessions between workspaces safely — frame-level zstd header rewrite, byte-level verification.

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）插件：在 **设置 → 会话迁移** 里选目标工作区、选会话、点一下，就把会话搬过去，归属即时更新、无需重启。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的会话日志是**多帧 zstd**，并且有一条硬性约定：**第 1 个帧必须只包含 header 那一行**，其余每帧独立可解码（带 checksum）。DSH 读取时用 `assertZstdHeaderFrame` 校验，不满足就抛 `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError`，而会话枚举会**静默跳过**这条日志 —— 表现就是：

> 迁移完成后，那个对话在侧边栏里**彻底消失**（文件其实完好）。

手工改 header 时最容易踩的两个坑：

1. **把整份日志一次性重压**。改完 `cwd` 后重压全文，会把「头部帧 + 上千个事件帧」塌缩成单个帧，正好触发上面那条校验。
2. **硬编码日志文件名**。文件名带格式世代号：v0 叫 `session.jsonl.zstd`，vN(N>0) 叫 `session.vN.jsonl.zstd`。硬编码 v0 名字的实现，在较新的 DSH 上会**一个会话都定位不到**（实测 0/31）。

本插件按帧处理、按目录里实际存在的世代解析文件名，从根上避开这两个问题。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **迁移会话** | 设置 → 会话迁移：选目标工作区 → 选会话 → 迁移 |
| **按标题认会话** | 列表显示会话**标题**（与侧边栏同源），并标出它当前属于哪个分组；支持按标题 / 路径 / ID 过滤 |
| **帧级改写** | 只重压第 1 帧（header，写入新 `cwd`），**body 帧字节原样保留** |
| **字节级校验** | 帧数不变 + 每个 body 帧逐字节比对 + 头部 id/cwd 核对；不做全量解压，大日志也不吃内存 |
| **整目录备份** | 迁移前把整个会话目录 + `manifest.json` 备份到 `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session-mover-backup/<id>/<时间戳>/` |
| **拒绝覆盖** | 目标工作区已有同 id 会话时直接拒绝，不动原会话 |
| **事务性** | 先写临时文件并校验，通过后才 `rename`；任何一步失败都会清掉半成品 |
| **归属热更新** | 通过官方实体 API（`WorkspaceEntity.attachSession / detachSession`）更新分组，**无需重启** |
| **帧结构修复** | 已经被"整份重压"搞坏、在界面里消失的会话，可以就地修复（修复前自动备份） |

### 标题从哪来

标题有两个来源，按"快 → 准"的顺序取；取不到只是不显示，**绝不影响迁移**：

1. **投影缓存**（快）：`<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json` 里的
   `record.rows.title.val`。本机实测覆盖 22/31 个会话。缓存只是显示提示，可能滞后于日志。
2. **`sessionQuery.readTitleSnapshots()`**（准）：官方公开服务，从日志里折叠标题事件。
   **只对缓存里没有标题的会话调用**，避免每次打开面板都全量读日志。

分组列来自 `workspaceRegistry.list()` 的成员关系；没有归属的显示为「未分组」。

## 安装

```powershell
# 有 git（标准写法）
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:yvban/dsh-session-mover#main

# 没有 git：pnpm 解析 github: 依赖需要 git，可以改用归档 tarball 的 URL
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add https://github.com/yvban/dsh-session-mover/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
```

`<你的 profile>` 通常是 `web`；桌面版是 `desktop`。如果 PATH 里没有 `dsh`，用应用自带的 CLI：

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add github:yvban/dsh-session-mover#main
```

装完**重启 DSH**（客户端面板在启动时加载），然后打开 **设置 → 会话迁移**。

## 使用

1. **目标工作区**：下拉里选一个已注册的工作区。
2. **选中会话**：列表按创建时间倒序，每行显示标题 / 当前分组 / 原始 `cwd` / 体积 / 会话 ID。
   - `打开中` 的会话不能迁移（日志被写句柄占着）。
   - 标了 `帧结构异常` 的会话先用「修复帧结构」，修完**重启 DSH** 就会重新出现。
3. **迁移选中会话**：完成后归属即时生效，不用重启。

## HTTP 接口（面板用的就是这三个）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/plugins/dsh-session-mover/state` | 工作区清单 + 会话清单（含 `readable` / `live` / `title` / 分组） |
| POST | `/plugins/dsh-session-mover/migrate` | `{ sessionId, targetWorkspaceId }` |
| POST | `/plugins/dsh-session-mover/repair` | `{ sessionId }` |

两个 POST 需要 `x-dsh-session-mover: session-mover` 头，并通过 Host 的本机同源校验；跨站请求会被拒。

## 已知边界

- **正在 DSH 里打开的会话不能迁移**（日志被写句柄占着），返回 409。请先关掉那个会话。
- **热更新归属只用到一个非公开方法**：`workspaceRegistry.indexHeader()`。`attachSession` 会用
  内存里启动时缓存的头部索引校验 `cwd`，文件搬走后该索引过期，必须先刷新它。这一点无法用公开
  API 替代。若该方法在某版本不存在，插件会自动退回"直写 `workspace.json`"并提示需要重启；
  再不行就只搬文件，重启后手动把会话拖进目标分组。
- 迁移**不会**改动 `defaultWorkspaceId`，也不会动别的会话。
- 只用 Node 内置模块，无第三方运行时依赖。

## 开发与测试

```powershell
node --check lib/migrate.js
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/client.js
node tests/unit.mjs        # 12 项
node tests/host.test.mjs   # 10 项
```

覆盖内容：

- 路径编码（`projectKey` / `encodeSegment`）与真实 `sessions` 目录名**逐字一致**（含中文路径）；
- 合成多帧 fixture 的完整迁移：header 改写、**body 帧逐字节不变**、旧目录删除、备份与 manifest；
- 世代感知定位：v0 与 vN 两种命名都能定位并**沿用同名**迁移；文件名世代与 `header.version` 不一致时判定为不可读；
- 单帧塌缩（历史上导致会话消失的那个 bug）的**检测与修复**，修复后内容零丢失且幂等；
- no-overwrite、迁移到同工作区的 no-op、日志位置与头部 `cwd` 不符时拒绝；
- host 集成测试：用模拟 ctx 真实跑通 `apply()` → 路由注册 → 鉴权（跨站 403、缺确认头 403）→
  迁移成功（`attach`/`detach`/`indexHeader` 调用与文件落位都有断言）→ 打开中的会话 409 → 修复入口；
- 标题优先级：缓存命中直接用，缓存缺失才查 `sessionQuery`，并断言**命中过的不会重复查**；
- **归属更新必须被证实**：模拟上游 `attachSession` 静默无效（成员被 canonical-cwd 过滤丢掉）时，
  插件必须报 `disk` 而不是 `hot`，并如实说明需要重启——避免"报成功但侧边栏没有"；
- **真实 DSH 会话根目录的只读回归**（本机 31/31 可定位、可读；没有真实目录时自动跳过）。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-commands

Smarter slash-command matching for DSH skills.

The stock slash source matches skill names literally. This plugin registers a smart skill-matching slash source in the browser with suffix / contains / alias matching — for example `/studio` finds `autonomous-studio`.

The host half is an empty mount so the bundle loads cleanly; the behavior ships via `exports["./client"]`.

## Install

Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: ChatGPT subscription / GPT provider for DeepSeek Harness desktop: image input, host tools and DeepSeek/GPT switching. Harness 桌面版 ChatGPT 订阅适配器，支持图片、工具调用和模型切换。Community MIT plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

**把 ChatGPT 订阅带进 DeepSeek Harness。登录账户，选择 GPT，即可开始工作。** 无需 API Key，支持 GPT / DeepSeek 切换、图片理解，以及 Harness 的文件、搜索和终端工具。 **仅适用于 DeepSeek Harness。** 本插件不能安装到 DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 或普通聊天桌面客户端中。当前验证范围为 Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS。 [快速开始](#快速开始) · [使用文档](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [下载安装包](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/latest) · [English](README.en.md) ## 为什么使用 - **用自己的订阅**：通过 OpenAI 页面登录授权，无需配置 API Key。 - **两种模型，随时选择**：在会话中切换 GPT 与 DeepSeek，也可让新会话默认使用 GPT。 - **图片与工具一起用**：向支持图片的模型提问，使用 Harness 内置工具读取文件、编辑代码、搜索和运行命令。 - **思考强度可调**：在模型菜单中选择推理等级，档位与默认值自动匹配当前模型。 - **连接后即可选模型**：自动加载当前账户的可用模型，支持添加和切换多个账户。 - **免费开源**：MIT 许可；插件不额外收费。模型权限与使用额度取决于你的 ChatGPT 账户。 ## 快速开始 适用于 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS**，需要可使用订阅模型的 ChatGPT 账户。 ### 1. 安装插件 在 **Plugins → Add plugin** 中填入： ```text dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.3 ``` Registry 选择 **npm 官方源（https://registry.npmjs.org/）**，点击 **Install**。完成后，等当前任务结束，完全退出并重新打开 Harness。 > 若找不到切换源的入口，或安装失败，使用[终端安装或本地包安装](docs/INSTALLATION.md#其他安装方式)。 ### 2. 连接 ChatGPT 打开 **Settings → ChatGPT 订阅 → 连接 ChatGPT**，点击 **打开授权页面**，在 OpenAI 页面完成登录与授权。返回 Harness 后会自动显示连接状态和可用模型。 ### 3. 开始使用 新建会话，在模型选择器的 **ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT)** 下选择模型。 试着输入：`帮我阅读当前项目，说明它的用途。` 支持图片的模型也可以直接接收会话中添加的图片。 ## 常见问题 **这个插件支持哪个产品？** 仅支持 DeepSeek Harness。DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 和普通聊天桌面客户端不支持安装本插件。当前验证范围为 Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS。 **如何在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅？** 安装 `dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.3`，在设置中连接自己的 ChatGPT 账户，再从 ChatGPT plan 中选择模型。无需 API Key，模型权限与额度由账户决定。 **可以直接填 GitHub 地址吗？** 这是源码地址：`https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter`。不同宿主与市场的安装器支持有差异，日常安装建议使用上面的明确包名与版本。 **已经连接，却没有模型？** 点击“刷新模型”，检查当前账户的订阅权限、额度及网络。模型列表以账户实际返回为准。 **如何升级？** 用相同包名安装新版本，然后完全退出并重开 Harness。保留原 Profile 和账户目录即可延续使用。 **如何退出或卸载？** 先在设置页退出账户，再到 Plugins 卸载。[详细说明](docs/PRIVACY.md#断开与卸载)。 ## 了解更多 [思考强度](docs/REASONING.md) · [安装与排错](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [兼容范围](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [数据与隐私](docs/PRIVACY.md) · [版本说明](RELEASE_NOTES.md) · [参与开发](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) 会话文本、所选图片和工具结果会发送至 OpenAI。登录凭证保存在本机未加密文件中，具有仅当前用户可读写的权限。本插件是独立社区项目，不隶属于 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek。 ### 插件头像 启用插件后，窗口右下角会显示「大肥鱼指挥 Codex」头像。图片随安装包提供，无需外部图片服务；头像不响应鼠标操作，不遮挡下方控件的点击。停用插件后自动移除。

plugins.description: Incrementally archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base: extract, summarize, dedupe, upload. DSH 会话归档进 WeKnora 知识库。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-weknora-archive **中文** · [English](#english) 把 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）会话**增量归档**进 [WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora) 知识库的 host 端插件。是官方只读插件 `@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora`（4 个检索工具）的**写入侧互补**。 ## 功能 | 工具 | 说明 | |---|---| | `weknora_archive_session` | 归档某个项目的 DSH 会话：定位会话目录 → 解压 `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` → 提取对话 → 启发式总结（模板：主题/决策/产出/细节/遗留）→ 按文档标题去重后上传；知识库不存在时按项目名自动新建；首次归档附 `00_项目总览.md`；支持 `dry_run` 预览 | | `weknora_archive_status` | 只读：列出本机会话项目目录与会话数，查看目标知识库内已归档文档与解析状态 | | `weknora_archive_list_knowledge_bases` | 只读：列出该凭据可见的知识库 | | `weknora_archive_create_knowledge_base` | 新建知识库（注意：新建库可能需在 WeKnora 端配置 embedding 模型，否则文档解析失败） | 工具名前缀可通过 `toolPrefix` 配置（默认 `weknora_archive`）。工具描述中英双语。 ## 安装 ```bash node "/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" \ plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-weknora-archive ``` ## 配置 走 DSH 官方插件配置机制：插件 bundle 自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，默认从环境变量读取（**key 不落地、不入库**）： | 字段 | 环境变量 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `baseUrl` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_BASE_URL` | WeKnora 部署地址（裸域名或 `/api/v1` 结尾均可），如 `http://weknora.example.com` | | `apiKey` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_API_KEY` | 具备写入/摄取能力的 scoped API key | | `knowledgeBaseId` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_KB_ID` | 可选：固定目标库；缺省按项目名自动匹配/新建 | | `sessionsDir` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_SESSIONS_DIR` | 可选：会话存储根目录；缺省自动探测 `/sessions` | | `maxSummaryChars` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS` | 单篇总结上限（默认 8000） | 也可把 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert 行拷进 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 直接填值（注意文件权限）。 ## 隐私说明 - 会话数据**只发往你自己配置的 WeKnora 实例**，插件不经过任何第三方服务。 - API key 只用于请求头 `X-API-Key`，**绝不写入日志、异常信息、工具结果或本文档**；日志输出前统一走 `redactConfig()` 脱敏。 - 总结为**启发式规则生成（无 LLM 参与）**，凭据类内容不收录完整值。 ## API 兼容性 认证头为 `X-API-Key`（非 Bearer），路由中横线风格：`GET/POST /knowledge-bases`、`GET /knowledge-bases/{id}/knowledge`、`POST /knowledge`（multipart 上传 Markdown）、`POST /knowledge/{id}/reparse`。**以你的 WeKnora 实际 API 为准**；若有出入只需调整 `lib/client.js`。 ## 本地单测 ```bash npm test # node test/mock.test.mjs，mock 数据 + mock 客户端，无需网络与凭证 ``` ## 已知边界 - 总结是启发式抽取，不是 LLM 精炼；追求质量可在归档前手工润色。 - 正在运行的会话文件可能解压失败，会被跳过（下次归档自动补上）。 - 新建库的 embedding 配置需在 WeKnora 端完成（PUT 接口会静默丢弃 embedding 字段）。 --- # dsh-weknora-archive (English) A DeepSeek Harness host plugin that **incrementally archives DSH sessions** into a [WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora) knowledge base — the write-side complement to the official read-only `@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora` plugin (4 retrieval tools). ## Tools | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | `weknora_archive_session` | Archive a project's sessions: locate session dirs → decompress `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` → extract conversation → heuristic summarize (topic / decisions / artifacts / hard details / leftovers) → dedupe by document title → upload. Auto-creates the knowledge base by project name when absent; adds a `00_项目总览.md` overview on first run; `dry_run` supported. | | `weknora_archive_status` | Read-only: list local session project dirs with counts, and documents already in a target KB with parse status. | | `weknora_archive_list_knowledge_bases` | Read-only: list visible knowledge bases. | | `weknora_archive_create_knowledge_base` | Create a KB (a fresh KB may need an embedding model configured on the WeKnora side). | Prefix is configurable via `toolPrefix` (default `weknora_archive`). Tool descriptions are bilingual (EN/中文). ## Install ```bash node "/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" \ plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-weknora-archive ``` ## Configuration Uses DSH's official plugin-config mechanism: the bundle ships a `cordis.patch.yml` that reads environment variables by default (**no key hardcoded anywhere**): | Field | Env var | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `baseUrl` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_BASE_URL` | Your WeKnora deployment root or `/api/v1` root (placeholder in this repo — set your own) | | `apiKey` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_API_KEY` | Scoped WeKnora API key with ingest capability | | `knowledgeBaseId` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_KB_ID` | Optional fixed target KB; otherwise matched/created per project | | `sessionsDir` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_SESSIONS_DIR` | Optional sessions root; auto-detected when empty | | `maxSummaryChars` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS` | Per-summary cap (default 8000) | Alternatively copy the insert row into your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` with literal values (mind file permissions). ## Privacy - Session data goes **only to the WeKnora instance you configure** — no third-party service involved. - The API key is used solely in the `X-API-Key` header and is **never logged, never embedded in errors, tool results, or this README**; all log paths go through `redactConfig()`. - Summaries are produced by **heuristic rules without any LLM**, and credential-looking values are never recorded in full. ## API compatibility Auth is the `X-API-Key` header (not Bearer); kebab-case routes: `GET/POST /knowledge-bases`, `GET /knowledge-bases/{id}/knowledge`, `POST /knowledge` (multipart Markdown upload), `POST /knowledge/{id}/reparse`. **Defer to your actual WeKnora API**; if it differs, only `lib/client.js` needs changes. ## Tests ```bash npm test # mock data + mock client, no network or credentials required ``` ## Known limits - Summaries are heuristic extractions, not LLM-polished prose. - A live session file may fail to decompress and is skipped (picked up on the next run). - Embedding configuration for newly created KBs must be done on the WeKnora side. ## License MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：万事通强尼 —— /johnny 出摊，没收到钱就装傻；敲钱喂给 dsh-pet 大肥鱼，才会说真话 | Pay the fish, get the truth
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-johnny

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：**万事通强尼 —— 没收到钱就装傻，钱到位全说。**

给你喜欢的桌宠（dsh-pet 大肥鱼）配一个"付费问答"小剧场：`/johnny` 出摊后，你说什么他都打太极（「有可能知道，有可能不知道。」）；想要真话，得**敲钱**、再把钱**喂给肥鱼**——鱼啃一口，真答案落进对话。

致敬《白头神探》前身剧《Police Squad!》里的擦鞋线人 Johnny——那位"什么都知道、但钱到位才肯说"的万事通。

## 三步玩起来

1. **出摊**：对话里输入 `/johnny`（再敲一次收摊；屏幕角落会出现「强尼模式」徽标 + 红色 ×，**点 × 秒退**）
2. **敲钱**（三通道任选）：
   - 桌面：鼠标 **左左·右右**
   - 手机：**摇一摇**
   - 或输入框打「**发钱**」发送（被拦下，不发给模型、不花 token）
3. **喂鱼**：把钱拖到肥鱼身上 → 鱼播动画 + 气泡「TOKEN 的味道……不错……」→ **真答案出现在对话里**

模式里你发的每句话都会被"扣下"：问题记进会话，强尼只回那一句招牌搪塞（鱼会同步动一下、冒泡帮腔）。**装傻环节零模型调用、零 token。**

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://codeload.github.com/wobenshiwomu/dsh-johnny/tar.gz/v0.1.0'
```

或在图形界面：侧栏「插件」→ 添加插件 → 填上面这条 URL。装完重启 DSH 生效。
URL 末段的 `v0.1.0` 是版本标签；升级时换成本仓库的新版本标签重装即可。

**建议搭配 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（大肥鱼桌宠）**——"喂鱼"环节靠它的 `/dsh-pet-7340` 接口。没有鱼也能玩：出摊 / 装傻 / 敲钱 / 红叉都好使，只有最后喂鱼那步会提示"鱼没反应"。

## 配置项（全部可选）

在 profile 用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-johnny
  config:
    bubbleText: 'TOKEN 的味道……不错……'   # 喂钱后鱼气泡文案
    bubbleMeme: ''                          # 可选气泡配图（dsh-pet 表情包名，如 吃饱饱摸肚子）
    eatAnim: '余额-钱袋满溢'                 # 喂钱时鱼播的动画
    askBubbleText: '有可能知道，有可能不知道。'  # 扣下时鱼气泡文案（留空=不冒泡）
    askAnim: '工作状态-思考冒泡'              # 扣下时鱼播的动画（留空=不动）
    # petId: main                           # 联动的宠物 id
    # petBase: /dsh-pet-7340                # dsh-pet 接口前缀
    # moneyWords: [发钱, 给钱, 付钱, 交钱, 小费]  # 输入框召钱词表
    # storageDir: ''                        # 状态存储目录（默认 $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-johnny）
```

## 原理（一段话）

模式里客户端在捕获层拦下你的发送；「点单」经 HTTP 进宿主后，用 `session.append(…, { surfaceOp: 'append' })` 把问题与搪塞台词写进会话（**不惊动模型、零 token**）；喂钱触发 `resolveAgent → agent.followup`，把被扣的问题包进「鱼已收钱」消息——只有这一轮"真回答"过一次模型。鱼的反应（动画 + 气泡）由客户端同源调用 dsh-pet 接口完成。

> 小注：最初想让模型亲自"演"强尼，真机实测模型会把"装傻要钱"判为操纵性/注入而拒绝出演；改成"拦截式台词池"后反而更稳、更省、更好笑——他每次都说同一句，就是笑点。

## 测试

- `node test/sim.mjs`：**66 项断言**（模式开关与持久化 / 点单扣话 / 解锁载荷 / HTTP 路由 / 配置透传）
- 真机 E2E：扣下时零模型调用（assistant 计数不变）→ 喂钱 → 模型答出暗号（TOKEN-99），全链路贯通

## 已知问题

- Android/Termux 上使用 dsh-pet 需要先让它能正常加载：其静态 import 的 `@electron-internal/extract-zip` 没有安卓预编译，会在插件加载期抛错；可用 `pnpm patch` 换成懒桩绕过（该模块只在桌面模式用到）。修复建议（改成使用时动态 import）已同步给 dsh-pet 仓库。
- dsh-pet 的"桌面模式"（Electron 透明窗）在安卓不可用，属上游限制；Web 模式不受影响。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与祖先进程链）+ bash 命令预检 + 可扩展规则库。Zero-dependency safety guard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-guard 🛡️

鲸鱼娘**防呆插件**：把「一天犯四次的低级错误」变成工具层面的硬拦截。

> 起因：2026-10-09 一天里，鲸鱼娘因为同一个坑反复翻车 —— `pkill -f "FurMark_GUI"` 把自己的命令行也匹配上了，于是**杀掉自己**。主人提议：「不如写个插件专门拦这些智障操作。」

## 它做三件事

| # | 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① | **`safe_kill` 工具** | 按模式杀进程，**自动排除自身 + 全部祖先进程链**。以后杀进程不用再手写 `pkill`。 |
| ② | **bash 命令预检** | 调 bash 工具前扫描命令文本：命中危险模式就**拒绝执行**并给出安全替代写法；命中风险模式就放行但插一条醒目告警。 |
| ③ | **可扩展规则库** | 内置 9 条真实教训（见下），可随时往 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json` 加自己的坑，**改完存盘立即生效，不用重启**。 |
| ④ | **设置页** | **设置 → 防呆**：状态 / 处置方式（拦截⇄只提醒，点击即生效）/ 受保护进程链 / 规则清单（勾选即停用）/ 最近拦截日志 / 文件位置。 |

## 内置规则

| 规则 id | 触发场景 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pkill-self-match` | `pkill -f <模式>` 而命令自身命令行含该模式 | **拦** + 给 safe_kill 写法 |
| `grep-xargs-kill-self-match` | `ps \| grep "<模式>" \| xargs kill` 会连自己一起杀 | **拦** |
| `sudo-heredoc-stdin` | `sudo -S` 与 heredoc 抢 stdin，密码喂不进去 | **拦** + 给「先落盘再提权」写法 |
| `sudo-needs-tty` | 非交互 shell 里 sudo 拿不到终端 | 提示（用 `-S` 或 `pkexec`） |
| `rm-rf-root` | `rm -rf /`、`rm -rf /etc` 等 | **拦** |
| `kill-pid1` | `kill 1` / `kill -9 1` | **拦** |
| `chmod-r777-root` | `chmod -R 777 /`（或系统目录） | **拦** |
| `local-bin-not-in-path` | 命令存在于 `~/.local/bin` 但不在当前 PATH 里 | 告警 + 给绝对路径写法 |
| `pip-no-mirror` | pip 命令没走国内镜像 | 提示（慢几十到几百倍） |

**防误伤设计**：预检会先剥掉注释、把引号内容换成位置标记。所以 `echo "文档里写的 rm -rf / 是反面教材"`、`grep "kill 1" /var/log/syslog`、`rm -rf ./build` 都**正常放行**——只有真会伤到自己的才拦。

## 设置页

**设置 → 防呆**：

![设置页](assets/settings-page.png)


## 自研插件图标

三个自研插件的设置页与设置导航图标是一套手绘矢量（24×24、描边 1.7、`stroke=currentColor`
跟随主题明暗），设计稿来自千问 `qwen-image-3.0`，再由我描成精确路径：

| 插件 | 图标 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh-memory-lite | 摊开的书 + 便签卡 | 记忆库 |
| **dsh-whale-guard** | 盾牌 + 鲸鱼尾巴 | 守卫（盾）+ 本尊（鲸鱼） |
| dsh-multi-tts | 喇叭 + 声波 + 气泡 | 朗读出声 |

**为什么要动 DOM**：DSH 的 `navIcon(id)`（`dsh-client-ui-settings-general/lib/client.js`）是一张
**写死的表**，未登记的 section 一律回退系统齿轮，而 `settings.section` 的注册选项只有
`id/order/label`，没有图标位。所以每个插件的 `client.js` 在 `apply()` 里做一件事：
在 MutationObserver 里找到「自己那一行」的 `svg.navIcon` 并替换掉，命中范围仅此一个节点，
幂等、不动他人 DOM。React 重渲染会把它换回来，所以观察器持续纠偏（未命中时极廉价）。

**升级注意**：若 DSH 将来给 `settings.section` 加了图标字段，应改回声明式写法、删掉这段 DOM 逻辑。

## 用法

装好之后，直接在对话里用工具：

```
safe_kill({ pattern: "FurMark_GUI" })            # 默认 SIGTERM
safe_kill({ pattern: "comfy", signal: "SIGKILL" })
guard_status()                                   # 看保护链 / 规则数 / 最近命中
```

命令行等价物（顺手保留）：

```bash
/usr/local/bin/safepkill "FurMark_GUI"
```

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-guard
      name: 'dsh-whale-guard'
      config:
        enabled: true              # 总开关
        mode: block                # block=真拦；warn=只告警放行
        precheckTools: [bash]      # 参与预检的工具
        rulesFile: ~/dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json
        stateDir: ~/dsh-home/whale-guard   # 审计日志 audit.jsonl
        auditLog: true
        rules:
          disable: [pip-no-mirror]  # 关掉某条内置规则
          custom:                   # 或直接在配置里写规则
            - id: no-prod-restart
              title: 别直接重启生产实例
              severity: warn
              pattern: 'systemctl\\s+--user\\s+restart\\s+dsh-web'
              message: 生产实例重启前先确认回档点。
              fix: 先起隔离实例验证。
```

## 加自己的规则

编辑 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json`（插件首次运行会自动生成带示例的模板）：

```json
{
  "custom": [
    {
      "id": "任意唯一名",
      "title": "一句话说清这个坑",
      "severity": "block",
      "pattern": "正则表达式（对整条命令匹配，也可以给数组）",
      "message": "为什么错",
      "fix": "正确写法"
    }
  ]
}
```

- `severity`：`block`（拒绝执行）/ `warn`（告警放行）/ `hint`（轻声提示）
- 规则的 `pattern` 是对**整条原始命令**做正则匹配（大小写敏感，需要忽略大小写就加 `"flags": "i"`）
- 也可以写 `"builtin": "pkill-self-match"` 表示「复用某条内置规则的判定逻辑」

## 为什么 `safe_kill` 不会自杀

`pkill -f` 之所以自杀，是因为它匹配的是**完整命令行**，而执行这条 pkill 的 shell 命令行里就含该模式，于是「自己匹配自己」。

`safe_kill` 的链路：

1. 用 `pgrep -f` 拿候选 PID（只读，不杀）
2. 读 `/proc/<pid>/stat` 逐级上溯，算出**自身 + 全部祖先进程**的排除名单
3. 逐个 `process.kill()`，命中排除名单的直接跳过并在结果里说明原因

全程不拼 shell 字符串（无注入面），也不依赖 `~/.local/bin` 在 PATH 里（非交互 shell 的 PATH 坑绕开了）。

## 自检

```bash
node tools/selftest.mjs      # 78 项：规则命中/防误伤/heredoc 攻防/safe_kill 实战/设置页路由
```

## 上生产 / 更新

```bash
# 装进 profile（会把插件写进 profile 的 bundles，下次启动即加载）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard
systemctl --user restart dsh-web        # 让当前实例加载新插件
```

- **安装方式是 `link:`**（符号链接到本目录），所以**本目录就是生产代码**：
  - 改 `lib/*.js` → 重启 DSH 后生效；
  - ⚠️ **别删/别移走本目录**，否则生产 profile 的链接会断（插件加载失败）。
- 规则文件 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json` 不随插件走，是**本机数据**，升级插件不影响它。
- 回档点（装之前的三件套备份）：`~/dsh-home/backups/pre-whale-guard-20261009-135612/`
- 审计日志：`~/.dsh-home/whale-guard/audit.jsonl`（每条命中的规则、命令、是否拦截）

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-plugin-web-socks-proxy

DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 `web_fetch` 在访问境外网站时自动走本机代理（默认 `socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`，即 Clash 默认混合端口），其余站点保持直连。

**v1.1.0 起，代理在「设置 → 通用设置 → 网络代理」里随时可改**，无需动配置文件：

- **范围**：按域名自动分流（默认）/ 全部走代理 / 直连（停用）；
- **协议**：`SOCKS5（远程解析域名）`（`socks5h://`，推荐）/ `SOCKS5（本地解析域名）`（`socks5://`）/ `HTTP CONNECT`（`http://`）；
- **地址与端口**：改完按回车或移出输入框即保存，立即生效（写入 profile 补丁层的 volatile 覆盖，热重载）。

`bypassDomains`（localhost、127.0.0.1、.cn、本机服务端点等）在任何模式下都保持直连。

## 工作方式

- 注册一个 id 为 `web-socks-router` 的 `WebFetchProvider` 到 `ctx.web`，并把 `web` 服务的 `fetchProvider` 指向它。
- 每一跳 URL 独立决策路由：
  - `mode: auto`（默认）：仅 `proxyDomains` 列表中的域名走代理（`bypassDomains` 优先级更高）；
  - `mode: always`：除 `bypassDomains` 外全部走代理；
  - `mode: never`：全部直连（插件仍在位，方便快速关闭）。
  - 以上三项即设置界面「网络代理」行的三个选项；`proxy` 与 `mode` 是 volatile 配置字段，界面写入后由 config-editor 持久化进 profile 补丁。
- 域名规则：裸域名 `google.com` 匹配自身及全部子域；`*.example.com` 只匹配子域。
- `socks5h://` 由代理端解析域名（推荐）；`socks5://` 本地解析后再连代理（会做公网地址校验）。
- 代理连接失败时报错 `WEB_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE`（提示检查本地代理客户端），不会静默直连泄露流量。
- 直连路径复刻了官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 的安全姿态：仅 HTTP(S)、拒绝 URL 内嵌凭据、解析结果全部校验为公网地址并锁定连接、仅跟随同源重定向、字节/字符上限、按 Content-Type/charset 解码。

## 附带能力

- 注册一段系统提示（`web-socks-proxy`，可用 `promptSection: false` 关闭），让 Agent 知道：
  `web_fetch` 会自动走代理；shell 命令需要代理时先设 `ALL_PROXY`（PowerShell：`$env:ALL_PROXY = 'socks5://127.0.0.1:7890'`；bash：`export ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:7890`），curl 也可以 `-x socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`。

## 安装

桌面端「设置 → 插件」或插件管理器安装本目录（本地 file 包），安装后自动作为 bundle 加入 desktop profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。配置位于 bundle 自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`（插入行 id 为 `web-socks-proxy`），可在配置编辑器中直接修改。

## 卸载/回退

在插件管理器中停用或移除本 bundle 即可：随 bundle 注入的 `web` 行覆盖一并消失，基础层的 `fetchProvider: http` 自动恢复，行为回到原始直连。

## 故障诊断

超时/连接错误信息带有 `stage` 字段，指示停滞的阶段，例如：

- `tcp connect direct …` / `SOCKS proxy 127.0.0.1:7890 socks-greeting`：代理客户端未监听或不可达，确认 Clash 等本地代理在运行；
- `await-connect-reply …`：CONNECT 请求已发出但代理未回复（通常是代理端上游节点/规则问题）；
- `tls handshake …`：隧道已建立但 TLS 失败（一般是代理上游被干扰）；
- `http exchange …`：TLS 正常，等待 HTTP 响应。

超时错误同时附带 `trace`（SOCKS 帧读取的事件序列），可用于进一步定位。握手阶段停滞的错误里 `…ms since connect` 表示从 TCP 连上到超时的耗时。

## 开发

- 修改 `lib/index.js` 后，若 profile 补丁层将本目录加入了 hmr 的 `root` 监视列表（`- id: hmr / config: root: [<本目录>]`），改动会自动热重载；否则需重启 DeepSeek Harness 才会重新导入模块（启用/停用开关不会重新导入已缓存的 ESM 模块）。
- 仓库内另有两个独立诊断脚本（与插件无关，仅辅助排障）：`../socks-diag.mjs`（裸 SOCKS5+TLS 协议探测）与 `../provider-diag.mjs`（在宿主外直接运行 provider 代码）。

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-panellist The management plugin for the Panellist in the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client. The Panellist is the column on the left of the session UI: the global entries contributed by individual plugins — plugins, automation tasks, skill center, memory system, SSH, MCP connectors… They come from different plugins, each declares its own order, and each decides its own icon and name. This plugin lets the **user** take over: which Panel entries appear on the rail, in what order they appear, what they are called, what icon they use, and which entries are folded into a Group. All configuration is done in a new tab in Settings, and changes take effect immediately. > Status: **implemented**. This README pair is the whole specification — there is no separate design document: behaviour is §2–§3, the configuration and the interfaces are §4, the compatibility contract is §5, how to install it is §6, and how it is built is §7. The normative configuration shape is [`docs/schema/config.schema.json`](docs/schema/config.schema.json). > > Three refinements to the original design (all discovered during implementation and backfilled into this document): the rail id of a Group is `dsh-panellist:`; unconfigured Panel entries are always listed on the rail, but an `order` is written only once the Sequence is non-empty (i.e. after your first structural change); and the `/panellist/api/reveal` endpoint was added to implement "Open config file". ## Screenshots | Settings → Panel list | A Group menu on the rail | | :-: | :-: | | ![Settings → Panel list](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![A Group menu on the rail](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) | --- ## 1. Why it is needed The DSH Panellist is a **read-only projection**: the shell enumerates the registrations in the `sidebar.panellist` slot and renders them sorted by the order **each item reported at registration time**. No official API is provided for rewriting someone else's registration: - Order is read-only — a plugin can only decide the `order` of its own item; - There is no concept of a "Group" — one row is one Panel entry; - The icon is decided by the component the contributor provides, and the name is decided by the contributor's `label`; - The icon of the Settings navigation tab can only be picked from a list built into the kernel. So this plugin has to use two levers at the same time, and keep DOM intervention to a minimum: 1. **Registry rewrite** — rewrite the order, name and icon component on the registration at runtime (the registration object is not frozen and is handed back by the slot registry, so a post-hoc write is visible to the shell); this plugin's changes do not touch any plugin's own page. 2. **Minimal DOM/CSS reprojection** — only one thing cannot be done through the registry: taking a row off the rail. Group rows are registrations too (registered by this plugin), so their row box, highlight, tooltip and collapsed-state behavior still come from the shell; the popup menu is an overlay and does not modify native rows. --- ## 2. Behavior spec (confirmed) ### 2.1 What it manages - **All** registrations in the Panellist are treated alike: kernel-shipped items (plugins, automation tasks, skill center, memory system, SSH, MCP connectors) and items registered by third-party plugins can all be managed. - This plugin's own settings tab is not in the Panellist, so it is not managed. - Real Panel entry ids are discovered at runtime and are not hard-coded; the ids in this document's examples are illustrative only. ### 2.2 Sequence model The Sequence is a series of **ordered items**, each of which is either a **single Panel entry** or a **Group**: - Each Panel entry appears **exactly once** in the whole Sequence (the Sequence is a partition of the set of Panel entries, with no duplicates); - A Group itself occupies one position in the Sequence and contains an **ordered** subset of Panel entries; - **Only one level** of nesting is allowed (a Group cannot contain another Group); - An empty Group is invalid; a Group with only 1 item is allowed, but the management panel warns about it. The design conversation settled the notation this way (`G{…}` = one Group): | Notation | Interpretation | | --- | --- | | `a c b d e` | `[a][c][b][d][e]` | | `a b c` | `[a][b][c]` | | `a dropdown(b c d e)` | `[a][G{b,c,d,e}]` | | `a dropdown(b d e c)` | `[a][G{b,d,e,c}]` | | `a dropdown(b e c)d` | `[a][G{b,e,c}][d]` | | `dropdown(a b c)d e` | `[G{a,b,c}][d][e]` | ### 2.3 Shown / Hidden - There are only two states: **Shown** / **Hidden** (there is no third "disabled" state). - Hidden = it no longer appears on the rail, but the Panel entry itself still exists and is still usable (it can be selected from the management panel, and activated by other plugins or keyboard shortcuts), and the functionality of the plugin it belongs to is unaffected. - Exception: **if a Hidden Panel entry is currently active, its row is shown temporarily** — avoiding the case where "the user is still on this page, but the rail has no entry for it". - **Members of a Group can be hidden too**, where "hidden" means "left out of the Group menu": a member's rail row is already suppressed by the Group, so for a member hiding only affects the flyout. The member stays in the Group — the count, the ordering and the Group trigger highlight all still see it. - **A missing member is left out of the Group menu automatically** (its registration is gone, and a disabled "missing" row in the menu only took up room the user cannot act on). It stays in the configuration and in the settings page's "missing panels" list, waiting to be cleaned up. ### 2.4 Label override - A pure display-layer override, affecting only three places: the text of the rail row, the tooltip text in the collapsed state, and the accessible name. - It does not change same-name displays elsewhere in DSH (Settings, command palette, etc.), and does not change the original name declared by the contributor. - The first version is a **single string**, effective for all languages. ### 2.5 Icon override Three sources, and you can switch back to the original icon at any time: 1. **Keep the original icon** (default); 2. **Built-in icon set** — 24 inline vector glyphs shipped with this plugin (zero dependencies, usable offline). They are drawn to the spec the icons beside them in the rail are drawn to — the **`Icon*OutlineRegular`** weight: `viewBox="0 0 16 16"`, `fill="none"`, `stroke="currentColor"` at **1px**, geometry on the 16 grid at half-step coordinates inside roughly 2…14, round caps and joins, `aria-hidden`, no ids and no external references. Three of them are the shipped artworks of the rail's own defaults, so a panel given one of them looks identical to the entry it replaces: `puzzle` is the plugin pinwheel (`IconPluginPinwheelOutline`), `clock` the clock (`IconClockOutline`), `more` the ellipsis (`IconEllipsisOutline`). The set is checked mechanically at 16px next to those shipped artworks, and its ink extents are measured against them; 3. **User-uploaded icon** — paste SVG source; - Allowlist sanitization: removes `script`, `foreignObject`, event attributes, and external references (cases where `href`/`xlink:href` point outside); - A single SVG is capped at **64 KB**; - Inline rendering (not ``), so it follows the theme's colors. The **settings navigation row has its own dedicated glyph** (a panel list, at the heavier `Icon*OutlineMedium` 1.3px weight that column is drawn at) — see §3. ### 2.6 Groups and Group triggers - A Group trigger has its **own** icon and name; by default they are pre-filled from the icon and name of the "first item in the Group" (a common name is "More"), and the user can change them. When no name is set, the trigger text is resolved from the first live member at render time — nothing is baked into the config. - The Group trigger's **whole row is clickable**, and clicking it expands the Group menu; a whole-row click is always used to expand the menu and never navigates to a page. The menu lists the Group's members and nothing else: an "Overview" link to the Group's own page used to sit in its title row and was

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-todos

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：**每个会话独立的待办清单**，列由用户自定义，默认只有「序号｜事项」。

界面与 AI 共用同一份数据：你在面板上勾选，模型能读到；模型写进去的事项，面板也会显示。

## 特性

- **会话隔离**：每个会话有自己的事项与列配置，互不影响。
- **自定义列**：文本 / 数字 / 日期三种类型，可新增、重命名、左右移动、删除；事项列可改名但不可删除。
- **事项操作**：新增、编辑、删除（带确认）、勾选完成、再次勾选恢复未完成、上移 / 下移。
- **搜索与筛选**：搜索所有列，筛选全部 / 未完成 / 已完成。
- **批量操作**：批量完成、恢复、删除（作用于当前筛选结果）。
- **撤销**：最近 20 次操作可回退，包含删除列及其数据；没有重做。
- **导出 CSV**：导出全量清单（不是当前筛选），带完成标记，兼容中文 Excel，并对公式注入做了转义。
- **按需展示**：不创建就不显示、不占空间；展开后的宽度、内边距、折叠摘要对齐原生任务框。
- **AI 可用**：模型通过 `session_todos` 工具读写同一份清单，与界面共用同一个宿主方法。

## 安装

安装一个 DSH 插件是**两步**，缺一不可：

1. **装依赖** —— 让包在 profile 里可解析；
2. **启用 bundle** —— 把包名写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

`dsh plugin --profile <name> <args...>` 只是 **pnpm 的转发**（在 profile 目录里执行），所以它只完成第 1 步：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Tpihis/dsh-session-todos.git
cd dsh-session-todos
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"        # ① 装依赖
```

第 2 步没有对应的 CLI 命令，用插件管理器完成：

- GUI：侧边栏「插件」面板里把 `dsh-session-todos` 打开；
- 或让 agent 调 `plugin_manager`：`set_bundle`，`target = dsh-session-todos`，`enabled = true`；
- 或一步到位：`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录（安装 + 启用）。

**只做第 1 步插件不会加载。** 这不是猜测：`dsh` 只提供 `dsh plugin`（pnpm 转发）和 `--patch` 两个入口，没有 `dsh bundle` 之类的命令；而且本机 profile 里就有一个实例——`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer` 在 `dependencies` 里但不在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，因此始终 `enabled: false`。

验证是否启用成功：

```sh
node -e 'console.log(require(process.env.HOME+"/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json").dsh.profile.bundles)'
```

名字出现在这个列表里，并且插件面板显示已启用，才算装好。

安装完成后：

- 宿主半即时生效；
- **客户端半需要刷新一次页面（F5）**才会出现新代码；
- 没有 `pnpm run dev:web` 时，客户端插件不会自动热更新。

## 使用

打开任意会话，输入框上方会出现一行「会话待办」摘要（**未创建清单时不显示**）。点开即可编辑。

也可以直接对模型说：

> 把这些需求加入当前会话待办，并增加分类、优先级和截止日期列。

模型侧的 `todo_write` 是它自己的执行计划，与本清单无关。

## 数据与边界

- 数据存在宿主存储域 `session_custom_todos`（本机位于 `~/.dsh/storages/session_custom_todos/`），**不在插件目录内**，卸载插件不会删除数据。
- 每个会话最多 2000 条事项、20 个数据列；列名最多 80 字符，单元格最多 10000 字符。
- 并发写使用 revision 检查：拿旧版本号提交会被拒绝，提示刷新后重试。
- 会话分支（fork）默认是空白清单，不继承父会话。
- 会话删除后，其域记录不会自动清理。

## 已知限制

- **写操作会在对话里留下一条命令卡片**。界面的写操作通过斜杠命令 `/session-todos` 落到宿主，而 DSH 一定会把命令生命周期（`command/run` + `command/done`）渲染成卡片，无法避免。为让它可读，每次写操作返回一句中文摘要（如「已完成 1 条（2/3 已完成）」），卡片摘要行显示该文本，而不是默认的「已完成」。摘要生成在 `src/model.js` 的 `summarize()`。
- 想做到**完全不产生这类卡片**，需要改用插件自建的 typert RPC（宿主 `ctx.typert.register` + 客户端 `ctx.remote.$mount`）。曾实现过一版，但桥接调用挂起会让面板写入锁卡死，未收敛，故采用当前折中方案。
- 未做第二台机器、其他 DSH 版本、其他操作系统的验证。

## 开发

```
src/host.js        宿主半（apply / inject，命令、工具、会话投影、存储域）
src/model.js       纯业务逻辑（校验、变更、撤销、视图、摘要）+ 单元测试
src/model.test.js  测试：node --test src/model.test.js
client.js          浏览器半（React，通过 __ModuleLoader__ 注册）
cordis.patch.yml   bundle 补丁，插入一行 session-todos
```

### 改完代码为什么不生效

运行中的 DSH 进程按 URL 缓存已导入的模块，而 profile 安装的 bundle **不会**因为自身文件变化而热重载。原地改文件，跑的还是旧模块。

```sh
npm run refresh     # 给入口的相对导入写入内容哈希 ./model.js?v=<hash>
```

然后重新启用 bundle（或重启 DSH）。哈希必须是**字面量**——Loader 要静态读取入口的 `export const inject`，所以不能用 `Date.now()` / `Math.random()` 在运行时拼。

注意：`refresh` 只能让入口**的依赖**换 URL；如果入口文件本身（`src/host.js`）的缓存需要失效，仍然要重启 DSH 或更换入口文件名。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 侧栏的 DeepSeek API 价格时段提醒：当前处于空闲时段还是高峰时段、距离切换还有多久，以及当前生效的价目表。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek 价格时段提醒

*[English](README.en.md) · 中文*

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在 Web 界面**侧栏底部**常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于
**空闲时段**还是**高峰时段**、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录
DeepSeek 账户的余额。

![侧栏底部的标记](docs/screenshot-sidebar.png)

*侧栏底部实拍：绿色月牙 = 空闲时段，状态文案旁是绿色口号，右侧为距下次切换的倒计时。*

![点击标记展开的面板](docs/screenshot-panel.png)

*点击展开：当前时段与折扣、剩余时间与切换时刻（本机时区、跟随界面语言）、口号、账户余额（充值/赠送余额、
更新时间、刷新与去充值）、价目表（加粗为当前价、划线为高峰价），以及底部的规则与来源。深色主题下的侧栏与面板见
[docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。*

## 它提醒什么

| 时段 | 北京时间 | 价格 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日） | 标准价 |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时间，含周末与法定节假日全天 | 高峰价的 50% |

> ⚠️ 2025 年那套「00:30–08:30 错峰优惠」已于 2025-09-05 取消，`deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-reasoner`
> 也已于 2026-07-24 下线——**都不是现行规则**。规则与价目表以
> [DeepSeek 官方价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) 为准（核对于 2026-10-10）。

## 特性

- **随日历走**：周末与法定节假日整天空闲；内置 2026 年落在工作日的 19 个节假日，日历未覆盖的年份标注「按工作日估算」。
- **余额**：展开面板即读一次已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额（充值余额、赠送余额，两位小数 + 千分位，与「设置 → 账户」同口径），
  附更新时间、手动刷新与「去充值」入口。走 DSH 账户自身的 Remote 命名空间，插件**不接触任何密钥**；
  未登录时只显示一行提示，没有账户控制器的配置档则整个区块隐藏。只在打开面板时读取，不做轮询。
- **情绪价值**：空闲时段喊你「站起来蹬」，高峰时段提醒你「心疼着蹬」——侧栏那一行直接就能看到，点开还有完整一句「便宜时段，尽管使劲用」/「贵时段，蹬一下心疼一下」。
- **中英双语**：文案走 Harness 的 locale 命名空间，切换界面语言即时生效。
- **零依赖、免构建**：`client.js` 已提交进仓库，装上即用；Host 半边不注册任何工具或会话状态。
- **可自改**：规则、节假日与价目表在 `src/policy.js`，余额格式化与状态机在 `src/balance.js`，改完重建即可，见 [docs/development.md](docs/development.md)。

## 如何安装

插件零依赖、无生命周期脚本，且**已提交构建产物**，因此安装时不需要任何构建步骤。
下面三条路径都在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测过（验证记录见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)）。

| 路径 | 操作 | 适用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **GitHub**（推荐） | **设置 → 插件** → 粘贴 `https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip` | 一般使用 |
| **tarball** | `pnpm pack` 后，在安装框粘贴 `.tgz` 的绝对路径 | 离线 / 内网 / 锁版本 |
| **本地目录** | `git clone` 后，在安装框粘贴该目录的绝对路径 | 要改代码 |

前两条拿到的只有运行时文件与文档（无 `src/`、`scripts/`、`test/`）；要改规则请用本地目录方式。
命令行等价写法（仅限非 `desktop` 配置档）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip
```

### 安装须知

- **桌面版只能走界面**：`desktop` 配置档由 Electron 独占，命令行会拒绝
  （`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。
- **装完刷新页面**：客户端 bundle 由 HMR 追加进引导图，刷新可确保生效。
- **本地目录装的是软链**（`link:`）：改完 `node scripts/build-client.mjs` 刷新即可，不必重装。
- **版本耦合**：样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，槽位是 `sidebar.footer.action`，并由 `dsh.client.inject`
  依赖 DSH 自带的 sidebar 与 locale 客户端包；余额通过**可选**的 `remote.account` 命名空间读取
  （没有账户控制器的配置档自动隐藏该区块）；DSH 改槽位名、locale API 或账户 Remote 时需跟着调整。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) | 文件结构、自定义规则、规则来源与边界假设、设计取舍、构建与测试 |
| [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md) | 验证状态：实测项、截图、未验证项、验证方法 |

plugins.description: Signed chain-of-custody for DeepSeek Harness sessions — hash-chained, ed25519-signed records of what the agent actually did, commits bound into the chain
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attest-chain

Signed chain-of-custody for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) sessions.

Headless agents bypass PR gates entirely; chat UIs show what the agent *said*
it did. This plugin records what the agent actually **did**: every watched
tool result (`bash`, `write`, `edit`, `web_fetch`, …) appends a hash-chained,
ed25519-signed custody record to a durable JSONL ledger. Tamper with any line
and the chain breaks; delete the tail and it no longer matches the published
head. Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

Family: **dsh-read-guard** guards what the agent reads, **dsh-pr-gate** gates
what it writes, **dsh-attest-chain** proves what it did.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Nothing in the dsh plugin ecosystem produces tamper-evident records of agent
activity. The nearest neighbours inventory plugins (`dsh-harbor`, 24★ — a
read-only list of what's *installed*) or add LLM-based reviewing. The
in-toto-shaped lane — signed, verifiable, CI-consumable evidence of what an
agent session did — is empty. The signing core is vendored from
[agent-attest](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-attest), whose CI gate
can consume this ledger as session-side evidence.

## How it works

```
tool result ──> custody record {time, tool, callId, isError, sha256(content)}
            ──> chained: digest = sha256(canonicalJSON({seq, prevDigest, record}))
            ──> signed: ed25519 over the digest (keypair in .dsh-attest-chain/keys/)
            ──> appended: .dsh-attest-chain/session.jsonl (one line, strict order)
```

Verification is pure and offline: replay the ledger, recompute every digest,
check every link and signature. Publish the head digest (or the public key)
anywhere durable — a PR description, a CI variable — and any later comparison
detects tampering or truncation deterministically.

A keypair is generated on first run; the private half never leaves the
machine running the agent. `sign: false` runs a digest-only chain if you only
need tamper-evidence against a published head.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-attest-chain
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).



## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-attest-chain
  name: dsh-attest-chain
  config:
    tools: [bash, write, edit, str_replace_editor, web_fetch]
    ledgerPath: .dsh-attest-chain/session.jsonl
    keysDir: .dsh-attest-chain/keys
    sign: true
```

Add `.dsh-attest-chain/` to your repository's `.gitignore` — the private key must
never be committed; the public key is what a verifier checks.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test   # syncs the vendored agent-attest core, builds, runs unit tests
```

The canonical-JSON serializer and ed25519 PEM helpers are vendored from the
sibling `agent-attest` checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`).

## Roadmap

- Session-end in-toto statement envelope (full interop with agent-attest CI)
- Per-session ledgers keyed by session id
- A `verify` tool card: replay + verdict inside the Web UI
- GitHub check-run bridge: head digest posted to the PR

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party signed session records, or a major plugin-adds
attestation natively, this freezes at its last working version with a
postmortem here. The signing core stays owned by agent-attest either way.

plugins.description: The Coreness kit for DeepSeek Harness — a plugin bundle for a profile.
plugins.readme_text:
# Coreness for DeepSeek Harness **A face, a memory and a brake for a DeepSeek Harness profile.** Coreness is one package a profile lives by. It brings the profile a page of its own in the application, keeps the journal of what the profile and its sessions do, gives the profile's MCP servers a face, holds a request the vendor would otherwise refuse, and adds a route to the Qoder models. It installs as it is: the halves the browser loads are plain files, served where they lie — nothing is built, nothing is compiled, and what is installed is what runs. ## ⚡ Install **The application installs its own plugins.** *Plugins* → *Add plugin* takes a package name, a tarball, a git address or a local path, and the package goes into the profile the application is running — one door for the desktop application and for the web one, and no profile to name: ``` github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` The same page switches the package off without removing it, and takes it off again. That address follows the newest release, and what stands published is a release — so the address and the newest release are one thing here. A fixed release is named by its own tag — `…Coreness-DSH#v0.3.0` — and a released tag is never moved: that line gives the same code whenever it is run.
By command line — for a terminal; nothing above needs it The line is ready to run as it stands, because the desktop application's own profile carries that name: ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` Another profile is named by its own name instead — the web surface's is `web` — and naming a profile that does not stand yet creates it. `dsh` is the application's own command and is not one Windows or macOS comes with, so until the application puts it on the path a terminal answers *not recognized*. The application does that from its own menu: in the window's title bar beside the app icon, **Application** → **Manage dsh Command…** — the dialog shows the location it manages, and the same dialog takes the command off the path again. A terminal opened before that act keeps the path it started with, so open a new one afterwards.
The profile's composition is read when the application starts, so the package becomes live at the next start, and the platform says itself when a change it made needs a restart. Nothing is built on the way in and no permission for install scripts is asked: the package is plain files, the install takes the directories its manifest names and nothing else, and the address is fetched over the network the application already uses rather than by a git client — a machine without git installs it. ## ✨ What a profile gets - 🗂 **A page of its own** — the profile's overview: what it carries, which bundles and rows stand and which are off, and the settings a session or a plugin has to be told. - 🔌 **The MCP servers, seen and edited** — one card per server: its kind, its address, the environment it needs, and switches whose effect lands in the profile rather than in a copy. - 📓 **The journal** — the environment's memory: what changed in the profile and what a participant did, kept as records that carry a kind, an area, a name and an author. - 🚦 **A limiter that waits instead of refusing** — a call over the limit takes its turn in a queue; nothing is limited as the package ships. - 🧠 **A route to the Qoder models** — the account's own models, each with the reasoning levels it accepts and the output budget it allows. The account's token is entered once, on the page, and kept by the platform's own store; no value of it stands in the package. - 📜 **The rules of its own tree, in force** — one prompt section, registered through the platform's own prompt registry and read from `plugins/rules/section.md`, so a session of the profile carries them in every request and no compaction can take them out of the model's sight. They are paid for by every request — 243 tokens by the platform's own accounting — and a profile that does not want them drops that row from the bundle. ## 🧩 What it needs - **DeepSeek Harness.** The version this package was built against is declared in the manifest, and the application compares that declaration with its own before a profile imports a plugin: a mismatch leaves the plugin out and says so, instead of failing quietly later. ## 📦 What lands Exactly the list the package's manifest names — the assembly and the plugins, each with its own README beside its code. No part of the workshop they are built in: the contracts, the checks and the notes of this project stay where the work is done — with one deliberate exception, the section of rules this tree wants in force, which ships because a rule that must be in force has no other structurally safe home. ## 🧭 What it deliberately does not do - It is not a second door to the platform's own acts: enabling, disabling, installing and removing belong to the application's Plugins page, and this package reports what stands rather than competing with it. - It does not own the MCP side: the platform owns the servers, the connection and the registry, while this package owns the picture and the form. - It limits nothing until a limit is declared. ## 📄 License MIT.

plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness ⇄ JetBrains integration: DSH chat inside your IDE, and your IDE workspace — project, attached modules, active file and caret — in front of the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ⇄ JetBrains

Small packages that connect a local [DeepSeek Harness](../../) (DSH) to a JetBrains IDE, so the IDE and
the agent share one workspace instead of two islands.

Each one works on its own: the IDE plugin and the DSH bundle are the two halves of the same workflow, and
the session-link plugin only lets a page be asked for a session by address. The DSH bundle carries both a
Host half and a web-client half, so installing it covers the tool, the context line, and the clicks.

| Package | Platform | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`jetbrains-companion/`](jetbrains-companion) | IntelliJ Platform plugin (Java, no Gradle) | **DSH Chat** tool window embedding DSH's own web client, one DSH session per IDE window, live workspace publication, a loopback bridge so DSH can put a file in front of you, and a `DSH Changes` tool window that shows a published turn as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. |
| [`jetbrains-workspace/`](jetbrains-workspace) | DSH profile bundle (host half + web-client half, plain JavaScript) | Reads the IDE's workspace — including a module's multiple content roots from its `.iml` — into DSH as a tool, a runtime context line, and a registered workspace. Works with the companion running or from the IDE's own state files after it closed. Sends opened and clicked files to the IDE: the Host half replaces DSH's default desktop opener, and the client half redirects the Sidebar file viewer. |
| [`jetbrains-session-link/`](jetbrains-session-link) | DSH client plugin (plain JavaScript) | Lets `#dsh-session=<id>` — or a hash change on an open page — select that session without a reload. Optional: the chat panel falls back to the client's stored selection when it is absent. |

> **Unofficial.** Neither package is made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with JetBrains or DeepSeek.
> IntelliJ, IDEA and JetBrains are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o.

## What you get

- **Chat inside the IDE.** The `DSH Chat` tool window renders DSH's web client, authenticated with the
  same browser-session cookie DSH gives a browser, and opens the session for the window you are in.
- **One workspace, seen from both sides.** The window's root project and every attached module/VCS
  directory reach the model as a runtime context line and as a `jetbrains_workspace` tool result, with
  each directory labelled by the source that reported it.
- **Round trip.** DSH can read the active file, caret and selection, and open a file in the IDE at a
  line — with the companion's bridge, or with the IDE state files when the IDE is closed.

- **Review a turn as a diff.** `DSH Changes` lists every turn `dsh-jetbrains-workspace` publishes and
  opens any changed file as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. A turn's diff also opens by itself, with a
  **Keep** / **Revert** notification, the chat panel's toolbar has a **Changes** toggle, and reverting works
  per file or per hunk — refusing rather than half-reverting a file that changed since the turn.
- **Nothing is lost while the IDE is closed.** The review document outlives the IDE: on the next start the
  companion mentions the turns it missed, with one click to the panel.

## Why one DSH, not one per project

Because the value is in seeing everything at once. One Host process holds every session, so a reader can keep
an agent running in one project under watch while working on something else in another session that has
nothing to do with the IDE. It is also why this bundle publishes one review document for the whole Host
rather than one per workspace: the changes panel lists the turns of every session that changed files, so an
agent left running in another project still reports where the reader already is.

The IDE side leans the same way. One companion serves the whole IDE: the chat panel keeps one session per
project, the window junction can be told to register the shared parent so a multi-module checkout is one
workspace (`junctionRoot: common-parent`), and `jetbrains_workspace` answers for every attached directory.

What that costs, measured rather than assumed: the companion descriptor is *one file per user*, and the
companion starts **one bridge per IDE run**. Opening a second IDE window produced no second `bridge on` line,
and the one descriptor already named both windows' projects. So a Host reaches every window through one
bridge, DSH's workspace tool sees all of them, and the companion decides which window shows a diff or opens a
file by matching the path against each project's base path. The Host also accepts a *set* of descriptors (the
single one plus any `jetbrains-companion/*.json` beside it) and chooses by workspace, so a future build that
publishes one descriptor per window needs no Host change.

## What each half gives you

Each half is useful alone, and they do not depend on each other to install. What you get changes:

| Capability | IDE plugin only | DSH bundle only | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DSH Chat` tool window in the IDE (embedded DSH client, cookie auth) | yes | — | yes |
| One DSH session per IDE window, grouped in the DSH sidebar | yes — the panel registers the workspace and creates or attaches the session itself | — | yes |
| The model knows which IDE window is open (runtime context line) | — | yes, from the IDE's state files, or live when the companion runs | yes |
| `jetbrains_workspace` tool: root project, module content roots, active file, caret, selection | — | yes | yes |
| `jetbrains_open_in_ide`: the model opens a file in the IDE | — | no — it needs the companion's bridge | yes |
| Session selected without reloading the page | no — it seeds the client's stored selection and reloads once | — | yes, with `jetbrains-session-link` |
| Change review of a turn (which files, and their diffs) | — | yes — publishes `<DSH home>/jetbrains-changes.json` with the coordinates DSH's own `/api/changes.*` routes need | yes |
| A presented artifact opens in the IDE (`present` → editor tab) | — | opt-in — `autoOpenDeliverables: true`, and only for the window's own session | yes (needs the companion bridge) |
| A turn's changes as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff | yes — the `DSH Changes` tool window | yes — publishes the document it reads | yes |
| A turn's diff opens by itself, with Keep / Revert | yes — `POST /changed` on the companion bridge | yes — posts the notice (`autoOpenDiffs`) | yes |
| Revert a file, or one hunk of it | yes — the panel and the notification action | — | yes |
| Turns published while the IDE was closed | yes — mentioned on the next start | yes — the document outlives the IDE | yes |
| Clicking a deliverable or changed file opens it in the IDE | — | the wrap is on by default (`openInIde`), but the IDE itself needs the companion's bridge — without one the desktop opener still runs | yes |
| Clicking a file in the DSH UI opens it in the IDE, not the DSH sidebar viewer | — | yes, on by default (`openSidebarFilesInIde`) — falls back to the sidebar | yes (needs the companion bridge) |

So: install the **IDE plugin** to chat with DSH inside your IDE (it needs a DSH running locally, and
reads DSH's credential document to sign the browser cookie — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Install
the **DSH bundle** to put your IDE workspace in front of the model. Install **both** for the round
trip, where the model can name the file you are editing and open another one for you.

The two halves talk through DSH's own HTTP API and the companion's descriptor
(`<DSH home>/jetbrains-companion.json`, carrying a `version` and a `source` marker), so either half can
be updated on its own: a bundle that finds no live descriptor falls back to the IDE's state files, and a
companion never requires the bundle to be installed.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/abadiegie/dsh-jetbrains.git

```sh
cd jetbrains-companion
./build.sh                 # compiles against the installed IDE and copies the jar into it
IDE_HOME=/path/to/idea ./build.sh
```

Then restart the IDE. Settings live under `Settings ▸ Tools ▸ DSH Companion`. Step 1 needs no DSH-side
plugin; installing it alone gives you the chat panel (se
