plugins.description: DSH plugin: keeps streamed answers free of red (broken) KaTeX regions - validates every maths region with the client's own renderer before it is written
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-math-tex

让 DSH 的数学回答始终可读：给模型一套排版规则，再在文本落盘之前拦截并修好每一个会被渲染成红字的公式区域。

这是一个 host 侧插件，**没有客户端部分**——渲染器改不了，所以修复发生在文本还属于我们的最后一刻。

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的对话渲染用 KaTeX 渲染 Markdown 数学，只要遇到它解析不了的东西，就把**原始源码**用 KaTeX 的错误色 `#cc0000` 直接吐到屏幕上。**没有崩溃，也没有日志**：一个位置不对的 `$$` 足以让整篇推导变成"一片血红"，而用户只会看到一片红字，不知道哪一步错了、也不知道原因。

前端是 `app.asar` 里的一个整体 bundle，给 KaTeX 传的选项是空的（没有 `errorColor`、没有 `maxExpand`、没有 `trust`），所以**事后无法配置**。文本一旦落盘，屏幕上和会话记录里就都是坏的。

`dsh-math-tex` 因此在文本落盘之前动手。

## 两道防线

| | 机制 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `systemPrompt.section` | 事前规则：行间公式单独成段、`$$` 内只有公式、标题不粘公式……让模型少犯这个错 |
| 2 | `llm/stream` waterfall | 兜底：用**客户端同版本**的 KaTeX 逐个区域判定，把会渲染成红色的区域改写掉，然后才落盘 |

第 2 道是关键：`llm/stream` 是每一次流式模型调用外面的 waterfall，改写过的 chunk 会同时进入持久化的消息体、实时前端帧和上下文压缩，所以**屏幕和记录一起修好**。

## 判定不是正则，是问渲染器

直觉上的启发式（公式太长、嵌套太深、用了重型宏）经实测**两个方向都会错**：300 字符的公式、8 层 `\underbrace`、`\substack`、公式里的中文都渲染正常，而一个 99 字符的公式却死了。

更麻烦的是，"渲染器抛没抛异常"也不是判据：

| 输入 | 第 1 段调用（严格） | 第 2 段调用（宽松） | 读者看到 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `\foobar{x}` | 抛错 | 不抛错，把 `\foobar` 用 `#cc0000` 画出来 | 红字 |
| `x_1_2`（双下标） | 抛错 | 不抛错 | 红字 |
| `\htmlClass{red}{x}` | **成功** | — | **红字** |

第三行是最阴的一种：严格调用完全成功，输出里却带错误色。**只看异常的实现会把它判成健康。** 所以判定看的是**渲染产物里有没有错误色**。

## 修复原则：不猜数学

一个区域会被渲染成红色时，按顺序尝试：

1. **重新排版**——公式本身没问题、只是框架错了（例如 `$$` 开在段落中间），改成规范的 `$$\n…\n$$` 块；
2. **定点施救**——只在两种有确定语义的情况下动：删掉渲染器不认识的命令的反斜杠（`\foobar` → `foobar`），或给重复的算子重新分组（`x_1_2` → `x_{1_2}`）。改完必须**重新渲染验证"严格通过且无红色"**才接受，所以永远不会出现"改一下只是把错误挪了个位置"的循环；
3. **源码围栏**——修不了的（括号不闭合、`\begin` 没有 `\end`）作为一个代码块原样给出。

**数学永远不会被删掉。** 最坏情况是读者看到公式源码（可复制、可恢复），而不是红字。猜结构性损坏等于替作者编造数学，这件事不做。

## 安装

```bash
node tools/install.mjs              # 复制到 profile 并注册 bundle
node tools/install.mjs --dry-run    # 只说会改什么
node tools/install.mjs --uninstall  # 从 bundle 列表移除
```

装完**必须开新会话**：bundle 栈是会话的 runner 进程启动时读的，当前会话不会重新加载。

手工挂载也可以：把本包放进 `<profile>/node_modules/`，再把名字加进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 设置：

```yaml
- id: dsh-math-tex
  name: dsh-math-tex
  config:
    repair: auto
    logFile: C:/tmp/math-tex.log
```

| 选项 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` 时两道防线都不挂载 |
| `promptRules` | `full` | `full` / `minimal` / `off`，规则集大小 |
| `repair` | `auto` | `auto` 改写 / `check-only` 只记日志不改写 / `off` 完全放行 |
| `tailBuffer` | `15` | 最少扣住多少个字符，避免完成记号被逐字泄漏 |
| `maxHold` | `600` | 单个未闭合区域最多等多少字符，超了就原样放行（宁可不管，不可卡住） |
| `logFile` | `''` | 诊断日志路径；留空则只走 host logger |
| `katexPath` | `''` | 指定 KaTeX 位置，默认自动按 profile 解析 |
| `macros` | `{}` | 传给渲染器的宏，与客户端行为保持一致 |

未知键**报错而不是静默忽略**——写错的选项看起来像生效了，比没有这个选项更糟。

## 日志能证明它真的在工作

```
oracle: katex 0.16.47
prompt section "math-output-format" registered (full)
llm/stream hooked model=deepseek-flash mode=auto
guarded stream: 214 text delta(s) in, 231 out
```

最后一行是**真实回合**的判据：`in` 必须远大于 1（自测喂的假流是 1）。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

| 文件 | 测什么 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guard-test` | 判定与区域切分是否和渲染器一致 | 39 |
| `red-render-test` | 三类红字是否都能抓到 | 48 |
| `e2e-test` | 真实事故文本端到端是否可读 | 39 |
| `wire-test` | 流式输出是否等于整篇修复 | 97 |
| `fuzz-test` | 该性质在 236 种任意切分下是否成立 | 236 |
| `config-test` | 每个文档化选项是否真的有效 | 26 |
| `smoke-test` | 包是否按宿主的加载方式加载 | 22 |
| `installed-test` | profile 里那份**安装副本**（不是源码目录）能否加载并自修 | 10 |
| `regression-test` | 已修缺陷不再回归（用例逐字引自真实会话） | 23 |

合计 9 个文件、540 条断言，约 4 秒，不需要网络。

最有说服力的是 `fuzz-test`：它要求**真实事故文本的任意切分**（1 字符一帧到 1600 字符一帧，外加随机切分）最终都重组为**逐字相同**的整篇修复结果。

`regression-test` 是唯一断言"**输出来的文本**渲染后没有红色"的文件——其余文件盯的是判定与结构，它是最后一道"判定对了、但改完仍然红"的防线。把修复回退掉，它会红 4 条。

### 关于 `test/fixtures/real-broken.txt`

这份夹具复刻的是**事故文本的结构**（同一批缺陷形态：段落中间的 `$$` 配错对、`##` 粘在行间公式里、未闭合的 `\begin`、结尾的代码围栏），内容已替换为与具体题目无关的通用推导，因此它测的是缺陷形态而不是任何一次具体事故。

想直接看一份文本是怎么被判定的：

```bash
node tools/inspect-fixture.mjs                    # 默认检查上面这份夹具
node tools/inspect-fixture.mjs path/to/text.md    # 换成任何一份文本
```

它会打印区域数量、被标记的区域及其原因、修复动作，以及修复后是否还有区域会被渲染成红色。

排查真实会话时另有三件工具：

```bash
node tools/find-red-session.mjs                   # 扫本机所有会话，列出还会渲染成红色的回答
node tools/inspect-session.mjs <session.jsonl>    # 单条会话逐条消息：区域、判定、守卫会怎么修
node tools/probe-region.mjs 'd\alpha=0'           # 把候选写法逐个送进渲染器，看哪种被接受
```

## 设计边界

- **渲染器不可改**：这是设计前提，不是让步。前端是打包好的 bundle，没有数学相关的 slot 可以替换。
- **只做 host 侧**：唯一能同时影响屏幕、会话记录和压缩的拦截点在 `llm/stream`。
- **宁可不管，不可卡住**：所有等待都有界（`maxHold`），超限即原样放行——那正是没有插件时的行为，因此安全。
- **不改写非数学文本**：不含 `$` 和 `\` 的文本逐字节直通。

## 文档

- `STATUS.md`——现在装了什么、证明了什么、还差什么（交接用）。
- `docs/`——判据的来源：`FINDINGS.md`（到底坏在哪）、`KATEX-MEASUREMENTS.md`（逐个用例的实测数字）、`DESIGN.md`（方案怎么定的、否掉了什么）。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-codex

Codex 式换窗压缩引擎——彻底替换官方 dsh-compaction-basic 的「LLM 摘要式压缩」。

## 机制

- 继承官方 `BasicCompactionEngine`，只覆写官方承诺的唯一子类钩子 `summarize()`；
- 摘要改为**纯确定性指针模板（零 LLM 调用）**：归档声明 + 恢复通道指引（history_search / history_read / notes read）+ 最近 model 检查点笔记全文（读 `~/.dsh/context-budget/notes/<sid>.jsonl`，只读）+ 被归档区首尾消息截断锚点；
- SummaryResult 走官方契约的模板分支（无 `llmStreamCall` 字段，官方注释点名 "template, remote, or other summarizer"），转录中 `compaction/summary` 事件显示 `provider: template, model: codex-rollover`；
- shadow 事务、replay 定价、工具配对平衡、并发锁、阈值自动触发（0.8×窗口，router-standard 为 0.55）、context-overflow 恢复、/compact（compactNow）全部原样继承。

## 装配

- 源码：`~/.dsh/plugins-src/dsh-compaction-codex/`（本目录），构建：`bash scripts/build.sh`（链接 dsh-install 类型依赖 + tsc 编译 src → lib）；
- profile 链：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-compaction-codex` 软链 + `package.json` link 依赖（防 pnpm install 剪掉）；
- 预设：6 个用户预设（code / code-guarded / code-lean / dshagent / designharness / router-standard）compaction 组中 `compaction-basic` 条目已替换为 `compaction-codex`（2026-09-29，各文件留有 `.bak-20260929` 备份）；
- 生效范围：仅新会话（预设热扫描；运行中会话保持旧代装配）。

## 约束与边缘

- 官方 `summarizeCompaction` 要求摘要帧 token 数 < 被 shadow 内容 token 数；本模板上限约 5K 字符（约 1.5K tokens），对数千 tokens 以上的压缩区安全；极小压缩区会按官方逻辑抛错并留在日志（不会静默）；
- notes 文件缺失/损坏时自动降级（省略检查点段），不阻塞压缩事务；
- 回滚：预设 yml 中把 name 改回 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（或恢复 .bak）即回官方 LLM 摘要，热生效（新会话）。

## 决策记录

- 2026-09-29 用户拍板：方案 A（子类替换）+ 纯 Codex 式（永不 LLM 摘要，无混合开关）；
- 否决方案 B（从零实现抽象 CompactionEngine：需重写 shadow 持久化/锁/配对平衡，收益零风险高）与方案 C（拆压缩组：长会话必撞上下文硬上限）。

plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-undici-timeout

[![awesome · DSH plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

DSH 插件：给 LLM 出口（`globalThis.fetch` → Node 内置 undici）换一条**可配置超时 + 可保活复用**的直连通道。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)　·　发布流程: [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)　·　收录条目: [`contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/`](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/)

## 为什么需要它

- Node 内置 `fetch` 背后的 undici，`connectTimeout` 固定 **10s**（DNS+TCP+TLS 全算在内），
  没有环境变量/参数可调；
- 本机（WSL）直连 `opencode.ai` 的新建握手实测出现过 **11.6s**，双栈探测也常整轮
  `AggregateError`（IPv6 无出口 + IPv4 抖动）；
- pi-ai 每次重试都 `new OpenAI(...)` → `Shims.getDefaultFetch()` **当场读全局 fetch**，
  所以每次尝试都是新 TCP+TLS，被 10s 砍掉 → `TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT` → 重试又重连。
  今天（2026-10-13）的日志：87 次 TIMEOUT + 8 次 TRANSPORT，autoswitch 开代理 10 次。

对比：OpenCode（Go 客户端）全程复用一条已建立的 HTTP/2 连接，握手只发生一次，
所以同样的网络下它不超时。本插件就是把这套「长超时 + 保活复用」搬给 DSH。

## 这东西的寿命：它是一个补丁，不是一块功能

它存在的理由只有两条，而且两条都在**上游**，不是 DSH 的既定设计：

1. Node 内置 `fetch` 的 `connectTimeout` 固定 **10s** 且没有开关（Node/undici 上游行为）；
2. undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成 `true`，而 Cloudflare 边缘对 h2 上的 SSE 长流会
   回 `NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM`（上游默认值 × 边缘策略）。

这两条一旦在 DSH 侧被解决 —— 比如 LLM 层允许指定 dispatcher / 连接超时，或者换掉内置
fetch —— 本插件就**没有存在价值了**，直接卸掉：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-undici-timeout   # 或者删掉 profile 里那条 insert
```

判断「可以卸了」的依据（任一条成立即可）：

- 状态路由 `stats` 长期没有 `TIMEOUT`，且直连握手不再接近 10s；
- DSH 的 LLM 层能自己配连接超时 / 强制复用连接（看 release notes，或
  `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 里出现了对应配置项）；
- 上游把内置 fetch 换成了自带 Agent 的实现。

在那之前它是**最小补丁**：单文件、零依赖、只接管白名单域名、随时可摘。
所以只从 GitHub 分发，不发 npm、不进插件市场。

## 原理

```
agent 回合
 └─ dsh-llm-retry（重试）→ dsh-llm-pi-ai → pi-ai → new OpenAI({ fetch: undefined })
      → openai/client.mjs: this.fetch = Shims.getDefaultFetch()   ← 每次尝试当场读全局
      → 【本插件包装过的 globalThis.fetch】
           ├─ 命中 hosts 白名单 且 无代理 env → undici.fetch(url, { dispatcher: 自建 Agent })
           └─ 其它（代理模式 / 非白名单 / Request 输入）→ 原样透传给原来的 fetch
```

- 用**解析到的那份 undici**（`argv[1]` → profile 扫描 → bare）自建 `Agent`：
  `connect.timeout`、`headersTimeout`、`bodyTimeout`、`keepAliveTimeout/MaxTimeout`、
  `pipelining`、可选 `family`。
- **不碰 `setGlobalDispatcher`**：那是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` 的地盘（代理联动靠它），
  抢了会把 net-proxy 弄坏。本插件只接管「本来要走直连」的那部分流量。
- 代理 env（`http_proxy/https_proxy/ALL_PROXY` 任一大写或小写）在场时**自动让路**，
  由 harness 的代理层处理——所以能和 `dsh-net-proxy` / `dsh-net-autoswitch` 共存。

## 配置项（`cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件的 `config:`）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。`false` 时不改 fetch，状态路由仍在。 |
| `hosts` | `["opencode.ai"]` | 命中这些域名（含子域）才接管；`"*"` = 全部直连流量。 |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `30000` | **核心项**。DNS+TCP+TLS 的总预算（内置固定 10s）。范围 1000–600000。 |
| `headersTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 等响应头。 |
| `bodyTimeoutMs` | `0` | 相邻 body 块间隔；`0`=关闭，卡流交给 pi-ai 的 `streamIdleTimeoutMs` 看门狗。 |
| `keepAliveTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 空闲连接保留时长（复用 = 不重握手）。 |
| `keepAliveMaxTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 保活上限。 |
| `pipelining` | `1` | 每连接并发请求数。 |
| `family` | `0` | `0`=跟随系统；`4`/`6`=强制 IP 族（本机 IPv6 无出口时 `4` 很划算）。 |
| `allowH2` | `false` | **⚠️ 见下面「h2 的坑」**。undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成了 `true`，不显式关掉，本插件会顺手把 LLM 出口从 h1 换成 h2。 |
| `autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeoutMs` | `0` | Node happy-eyeballs 的**地址轮换间隔**（默认 250ms）。注意：尝试是**并行保留**的，这个值不是单地址的放弃窗口——黑洞地址实测默认与调大都会等到 connect 超时才死，改大只会拖慢轮换，一般别动。保留它只为极端调优。 |
| `delegateOnProxyEnv` | `true` | 有代理 env 时让路。 |
| `undiciPath` | `""` | 留空自动解析；可显式指到某份 `undici/index.js`。 |
| `probeOnStart` | `true` | 启动时打一次探针（默认打 LLM 网关的 models 端点，不花 token）。 |
| `probeUrl` / `probeTimeoutMs` | `…/zen/go/v1/models` / `15000` | 探针目标与超时。 |
| `logSlowMs` | `0` | >0 时把达到该耗时的请求写日志。 |
| `logFailures` | `true` | 失败请求记日志（含 cause）。 |
| `routePath` | `/_dsh/undici-timeout` | 状态路由。 |
| `logFile` | `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log` | 日志落盘。 |

## 安装

**只从 GitHub 分发**（本插件是上游行为的补丁，不发 npm、不上市场）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout
```

装完**重启 DSH** 生效。也可以钉住某个版本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout#v0.1.1
```

零 npm 依赖、无构建步骤，所以 pnpm 不会弹 `allowBuilds` 授权（本插件没有任何
`prepare` / `install` 脚本）。⚠️ 别和下面路线 B 的 `file://` 直插**同时用**：
包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert id 也是 `undici-timeout`，同 id 冲突。

改完代码想知道「别人 clone 下来到底装不装得上」，本地跑一遍试装验证 —— 把包装进一个
临时 DSH_HOME 里的干净 profile、真启动一次、再请求插件自己的状态路由：

```bash
./scripts/trial-install.sh          # 走 tarball（等价于 GitHub Release 资产）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --git    # 走本地裸仓库 git+file://（等价于 github: 源）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --spec=github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout   # 直接验真实远端
# 🎉 试装验证通过 = 组合成功 + 启动就绪 + 状态路由应答
```

打 tag / 建 Release 的步骤见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。

### 路线 B：file:// 直插 profile 用户层（改代码时用这条）

`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: undici-timeout
      name: file:///home/mqnu/program/dsh/dsh-undici-timeout/lib/index.js?v=5
      config:
        enabled: true
        hosts: [opencode.ai]
        connectTimeoutMs: 30000
        # 本机 IPv6 无出口：别让地址族探测把预算烧在 10 个死地址上
        family: 4
        # undici 8 的 allowH2 默认是 true，不关掉就会把出口换成 h2（见「h2 的坑」）
        allowH2: false
        bodyTimeoutMs: 0
        keepAliveTimeoutMs: 60000
```

`dsh-hmr` 会监听该文件，**原地写** 2 秒内自动重挂（tmp+rename 会换 inode，收不到事件）。
⚠️ insert 行按 **id 幂等**：只改 `name`（换 `?v=`）或改 `config` 不会立刻重挂——要么**摘掉再插回**，
要么重启 DSH（HMR 的实测行为，和 dsh-net-autoswitch 一致）。
2026-10-15 复验：只把 `?v=4` 改成 `?v=5` 并加配置，HMR 确实重挂了（实例 id、`installedAt`
都换新），但**跑的还是旧模块代码** —— 日志里没有新加的 `h2=off` 字段，状态路由里也读不到
`allowH2`。原因就是同 id 的 entry 按**旧 URL** 重新 import。**摘掉（等 HMR 跑一轮）→ 再插回**，
这次 `?v=5` 才真正被 import，`h2=off` 出现在日志里。改代码务必按这个顺序。

## h2 的坑（2026-10-15 定位，`allowH2` 就是为它加的）

症状：插件明明在跑（`matched` 一直涨），却仍然「很频繁地失败」，重试日志里
`code=TRANSPORT` 暴涨。

根因是一条**静默换协议**：

| | 用的 undici | ALPN 实测 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内置 `fetch`（Node 22 自带） | 6.24.1 | `http/1.1` | h1 |
| 本插件（`argv` 解析到 harness 那份） | 8.11.2 | `h2` | **h2** |

undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值从 `false` 翻成了 `true`
（`lib/core/connect.js`: `allowH2 = allowH2 != null ? allowH2 : true`，
`lib/dispatcher/client.js`: “enabled by default”）。我们用 undici 8 建 Agent，
于是 LLM 出口从 h1 变成了 h2 —— 这不是本插件想要的，却实实在在换了传输层。

代价：`opencode.ai` 前面是 Cloudflare，h2 上的 SSE 长流会被边缘掐：

```
请求失败 CONNECTION（2275ms）…/chat/completions :: ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR / Stream closed with error code NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
```

- 2026-10-15 当天：插件记了 **85 次失败，其中 79 次是 nghttp2 流错误**（93%），
  全部落在 `/chat/completions`（长流），`/models`（短请求）一次都没有；
- 首次出现 `ERR_HTTP2` 是 **2026-10-14T07:00**，即代理被关掉、插件开始全量接管直连之后；
  重试日志里 `TRANSPORT` 从 ~10/天 → **201/天**（10-14），`TIMEOUT` 则从 238/天 → 4/天
  （**插件治超时的效果是真的**，只是换了个失败形态）。

修法：`allowH2: false`（已进 DEFAULTS）。关掉之后复用一点没少：

| 4 连发（读完 body） | 新建连接数 | 耗时 |
|---|---|---|
| `allowH2: false` | 1 | 924ms → 383 → 363 → 374ms |
| `allowH2: true` | 1 | 947ms → 340 → 350 → 349ms |

即 h1 + `keepAliveTimeout` 的复用与 h2 等价，「不重握手」的目标照旧达成，
而 Cloudflare 那套 h2 流控彻底不参与。

2026-10-15 03:31 热更后（`?v=5`，`family=4` + `allowH2:false`）现场复验：
**75 秒内 22 个请求（全是 `/chat/completions`）20 成功 0 失败，`ERR_HTTP2` 0 次** ——
同一台机器、同一分钟里，改之前是 85 次失败/天、其中 93% 是这个 h2 流错误。

## 直连失败的另一半：20 个地址里的 10 个是死的（2026-10-15 实测）

`opencode.ai` 的 DNS 一次回 **10 个 IPv4 + 10 个 IPv6**，本机 **IPv6 无出口**
（`curl -6` 秒失败）。地址族探测（happy eyeballs）会把预算烧在这 10 个死地址上：

| 同一分钟内的对照 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 裸 TCP 连 10 个 IPv4 | 全部成功，245–1332ms |
| `curl`（双栈）/ `curl -4` | 8/8、5/5 成功，connect 0.27–0.46s |
| **内置 fetch**（undici 6） | **2/6 成功**，4 次 `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`，~2511ms |
| **插件 Agent，family=0** | **6/6 成功**，中位 352ms |
| 插件 Agent，family=4 | 6/6 成功，中位 379ms |

所以「插件生效了吗」的答案是：**生效，而且比内置通道明显强**；
但 `connectTimeoutMs: 30000` 救不了这种形态 —— 整轮在 ~1.0s / ~2.5s 就死掉，
是地址族探测把整轮判死，不是 10s 的 connect 预算不够。`family: 4` 能把这半边也堵上。

WSL 里直连脆弱、本机代理（`127.0.0.1:10808`）实测 3/3 HTTP 200（~0.9s）——
代理开着时插件按设计让路，也就不会被 h2 那套流控碰到。

## 状态/排障

```bash
# 读状态（在机器上直接 curl；Host 白名单只放行回环/本机网卡）
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout | python3 -m json.tool

# 手动补一枪探针
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout \
  -H 'x-dsh-undici-timeout: 1' -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"probeNow"}'
```

- `stats.matched/ok/failed/byError`：接管了多少请求、失败怎么归类；
- `stats.delegatedProxy`：因代理 env 让路了多少（联动在工作就正常）；
- `stats.lastRequests`：最近 10 条（host/path/ms/status/error）；
- `lastProbe`：最近一次探针（启动探针也会写日志）。
- 日志：`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log`。

冒烟（不经过 DSH，验证解析与网络）：

`

plugins.description: Offline HAR diagnostics with minimal evidence for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# HAR Triage

Offline network evidence for DeepSeek Harness. Find failed and slow browser requests without handing the agent your URLs, cookies or response bodies.

浏览器网络排障插件：读取本地 HAR，生成可回查原始请求索引的离线诊断报告。默认不把网址、请求头、Cookie、参数值或正文带进报告和 AI 工具结果。

![Synthetic HAR diagnosis: signals, source indexes and timing evidence](docs/report-demo.jpg)

The screenshot uses the bundled synthetic scenario, not real browser traffic.

## What it does

- Reads an existing HAR 1.2 capture; never records traffic, sends requests, or changes the capture.
- Groups requests into endpoint aliases, highlights HTTP 4xx/5xx, unavailable responses, slow requests and long waiting phases.
- Produces a self-contained HTML report: signals → request row → measured timing phases. Filters, pagination and source locators work offline.
- Returns at most 20 evidence entries to the agent, with a count of omitted evidence. The full numeric projection stays in the local JSON/HTML files.

Request #43 corresponds to `log.entries[42]` in your original HAR. Endpoint aliases deliberately do not reveal names. Keep the original capture private and use its index to look up the actual request locally.

## Install in Harness

Node 22.19+ is required. Install the prebuilt bundle into your chosen profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-har-triage/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-har-triage-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile YOUR_PROFILE --dump-config
```

The configuration should contain the `har-triage` row. Start that profile, put your HAR inside its session workspace, and ask:

> Inspect capture.har with har_triage. Save reports in a new har-review directory. Explain the measured evidence and cite the original HAR entry indexes. Do not guess root causes.

Tool arguments:

```json
{"input":"capture.har","outputDir":"har-review","slowMs":2000}
```

The tool uses Harness filesystem and sandbox services. It requires write permission to create the reports and refuses input/output paths outside the session workspace. Existing report files are never overwritten. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-har-triage`.

## Try without Harness

The CLI and analysis/report modules use Node built-ins only. From a source checkout:

```sh
node src/cli.js capture.har --out new-report-directory --slow-ms 2000
```

Open `new-report-directory/report.html`. The output directory must not exist. The original capture is unchanged.

For a reproducible synthetic example:

```sh
npm run demo
```

This creates a new directory under `artifacts/` with a deliberately synthetic capture and its report. It is not evidence of real browser traffic or real users.

## Evidence, not root-cause claims

`503` means the capture records a server-error response. `status: 0` means it did not record a valid HTTP response. Neither identifies a failing service, proves CORS, or proves an expired token. A high wait/TTFB share is an observation, not proof that the backend or database is slow.

Unknown phase timings and byte sizes remain `-1`, displayed as “Unknown.” TLS is part of the HAR connection timing and is not added a second time. Contradictory phase durations are flagged; the report hides misleading proportions.

## What is retained and removed

Retained: source entry index, sequential endpoint alias, controlled method/status/content classes, relative offsets, numeric durations/sizes, and fixed diagnostic codes. Aliases group the same method/origin/path within one capture; query strings and fragments do not affect grouping.

Removed: complete URLs including origins and paths, query values, headers, cookies, request/response bodies, page titles, initiator data, IP addresses, absolute timestamps, extension fields, raw error text, and the original file digest. The report ID hashes only the retained projection. Arbitrary source strings are not copied to reports or tool evidence.

This is a minimal diagnostic projection, **not** a scrubbed HAR, an anonymization guarantee, or a replacement for reviewing an artifact before sharing it. Status patterns, sizes, timing, request counts and grouping can still identify an application. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Limits

- HAR JSON only: version `1.2`, UTF-8, at most 16 MiB and 10,000 entries. Invalid supported entries fail with fixed errors rather than silently truncating the evidence.
- HTTP and HTTPS requests are analyzed. Other protocols are excluded and counted. Missing timing/size values are retained as unknown; a valid request URL, start timestamp, duration, status and response content object are required.
- Synchronous bounded analysis: cancellation is checked before parsing and between entries, not an interruptible worker. The slow threshold defaults to 2,000 ms and is configurable per call.
- Reports are created exclusively. If HTML creation fails after JSON creation, the JSON is retained and the tool reports the partial result; retry using a fresh destination.
- No upload, traffic replay, header inspection, body analysis, automatic source lookup, or edits to the original HAR.

## Development and validation

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

48 tests passed on Node 24 and 26. They cover actual CLI subprocesses, controlled output and failure text, input limits, phases, original-file preservation, and real Cordis tool dispatch/filesystem/sandbox/Loader integration. `smoke:host` is a real service composition, not a CLI profile boot or a live-LLM test.

The packed bundle was separately installed through the actual CLI into fresh temporary Profiles on Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, then booted with `runProfile` and exercised through `har_triage`. Source bytes were unchanged; output omitted the synthetic canary; overwrite and workspace-escape attempts were refused. HMR was disabled only in those temporary Profiles. The alpha host emitted three unrelated Typert activation warnings; rc.2 did not. No LLM or real credentials were used.

Browser checks covered status filtering, signal-to-request navigation, correct source locators, no console errors, and a 390-pixel layout without page-level overflow. The demo and regression captures are synthetic; real-user usefulness is not yet validated.

## Related tools

[net-debug](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/net-debug) is an existing Harness HTTP client with history, replay and HAR export. [harlite](https://github.com/brucehart/harlite) already offers extensive HAR analysis, SQL, waterfall and HTML reporting. This plugin does not replace those tools: its narrower purpose is a Harness-native, no-external-binary, allowlisted evidence path for agent-assisted debugging.

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: dsh字体亮度的控制
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-label-tune

Calm down the over-bright text of the DSH web GUI (dark theme): softer label tokens,
a relaxed bold weight, and lighter headings. Pure client-half plugin — no host code,
no restart, no runtime dependencies.

把 DSH Web GUI **深色主题里过亮的文字压下来**的小插件（纯客户端半边，零依赖、零构建）。

## 安装

| 场景 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| **桌面版 App**（profile 由 Electron 独占管理，CLI 装不进去） | 在 App 的插件市场里搜 `dsh-label-tune` 或填仓库地址安装 → 重启 App |
| CLI + `web` profile | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-label-tune`，再把 `dsh-label-tune` 加进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` |
| 本地开发（`link:`） | `dsh plugin --profile web add link:F:\path\to\dsh-label-tune` |
| 零安装（不碰 DSH） | 把仓库里的 [`dsh-label-tune.css`](./dsh-label-tune.css) 贴进 Stylus 用户样式（域 `http://127.0.0.1:19387`），或任意自定义 CSS 插件（`dsh-custom-css`、`dsh-theme-studio` 的 Custom CSS 框） |

**为什么桌面板要用市场装**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...` 会被拒绝 ——
`error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。
桌面 profile 的插件只能走 App 自己的市场/插件通道。

## 生效方式

只有客户端半边 ⇒ **保存后刷新页面（F5）即生效，不需要重启 dsh web**。
只有"新增了配置层"（刚装完插件）才需要重启一次进程。

## 它改了什么

| 部位 | 官方 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 正文 `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `bluish-50` rgb(249,250,251) **17.4:1** | `bluish-200` rgb(225,229,238) **14.5:1** |
| 正文暗档 `-primary-dimmed` | `bluish-100` | `bluish-300`（一起压，否则它比正文还亮、层级倒置） |
| 次要 `-secondary` | `bluish-300` | `bluish-300`（不变） |
| 三级 `-tertiary` | `bluish-400` | `bluish-400`（不变） |
| 加粗 `<strong>` | 与正文同色 + 字重 **600** | 颜色降到 `bluish-300` + 字重 **500** |
| 标题 h1–h3 / h4 | 700 / 600 | 600 / 500 |

对比度按底色 rgb(21,21,23) 手算（WCAG AAA 正文要求 7:1）。

**为什么加粗要单独处理**：DSH 没有给加粗单独的颜色 token（`grep strong` 在
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 里 0 命中），它继承正文颜色，唯一差别是字重。
Windows 上微软雅黑只有 400/700 两个真实字重，**600 由 Chromium 合成加粗（涂抹）**，
笔画发糊就会显得比正文刺眼 —— 所以这里把加粗降到 500 并压暗一档。

实现全部引用官方静态变量（`var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-N)`），不写死 rgb，跟随上游配色。

## 微调

| 想要的效果 | 改哪里 |
|---|---|
| 正文再亮一档 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` → `bluish-150`(15.5:1) 或 `bluish-100`(15.7:1) |
| 正文再暗一档 | → `bluish-300`(12.1:1) |
| 加粗再暗 | `strong` 段的 `bluish-300` → `bluish-400`(8.5:1) |
| 加粗用真 Bold | `strong` 段 `font-weight: 500` → `700` |
| 加粗保持原色 | 删掉 `strong` 段里的 `color` 行 |
| 标题别那么重 | 第 3 段 h1–h3 `600` → `500`，或整段删掉 |
| 浅色主题同样处理 | 去掉末尾可选段的注释 |

## 自测

```sh
node --test test/verify.mjs
```

用最小 DOM/window 桩离线跑：模块契约（id / `apply` / `inject`）、样式只注入一次、
注释配平、定稿色阶与加粗/标题规则在位、生效规则里不出现写死 `rgb()`，
以及"实测无效的那组 markdown strong token 不再出现"的回归保护。

## 卸载

移除插件即可；临时恢复可在 DevTools 里
`document.getElementById('dsh-label-tune-style')?.remove()`（仅当次会话）。

## 备注

`--dsw-font-markdown-base-strong*` 这组 token（定义在
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme/lib/styles/gradient-shadow-text.css:57-62`）
实测覆盖后观感无变化，说明渲染器不消费它，因此本插件不启用该段，只保留选择器级规则。

`peerDependencies` 里只声明了一个可选的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`：宿主从 0.2.0-rc.1 起会在
boot 阶段按插件声明的 peer 范围做 semver 闸门（范围外的层被静默跳过，日志
`dsh: skipping profile bundle "X"`）。这里用 `>=4.0.0` 这种显式区间而不是 `^`，
避开 0.x caret 被规范化成 `<0.2.0-0` 的坑。

## License

MIT © 2026 Upstream196

plugins.description: Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness Settings -> Models, written to that model's reasoningEfforts in cordis.patch.yml.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-reasoning-levels

Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness's **Settings → Models**.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/releases/tag/v0.1.2)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**Model Reasoning Levels** — the reasoning-effort control each model entry is
missing, written straight into that model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

The shipped Models page edits a model's `id`, display name, context window,
max-output tokens and input types, and deliberately edits **no** reasoning
effort: effort is a per-*model* capability while that editor is per-*provider*.
This plugin adds the missing control **inside each model entry** — directly
under the id/name line, or under the expanded context-window/input-types area —
and converts the selection into the model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

## What it contributes

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| `settings.models.provider-card` (keyed `llm-pi-ai`) | reaches each pi-ai provider card, discovers its model rows, and portals a per-model effort editor into every model entry — hand-declared routes included |
| Locale namespace `dsh-model-reasoning-levels` | English and Simplified Chinese copy |
| `scripts/reasoning-efforts.mjs` | validates a selection and prints the `reasoningEfforts` YAML and the settings path op it becomes |

Browser half only: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists so the Loader row can
carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`). No route, no service, no Config.

## What it looks like

```
Settings → Models → Baidu Team → Customized settings → Models
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [deepseek-v4.1-flash] [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash]       ⌄   🗑   │
│ Reasoning effort levels              Inherited              │
│ [Off] [Minimal] [Low] [Medium] [High] [XHigh] [Max]        │
│ Low wire value: low   High wire value: high                 │
│ [Inherit catalog] [Non-reasoning] [Apply]  { off: null, … } │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

![The Reasoning effort levels control appended inside a model entry on the Settings → Models page](docs/images/reasoning-levels-row.png)

*The control inside one model entry: the seven level chips, one wire-value field
per selected thinking level, **Inherit catalog** / **Non-reasoning** / **Apply**,
and the exact `reasoningEfforts` value the current selection becomes.*

## How the control reaches the row

The shipped page declares **no seat inside a model row**, and its `ModelRow` is
an internal component. The only sanctioned row-level change is shadowing the
whole `settings.section` `models` entry — a shadowed copy of the page. This plugin takes
the narrower path instead: it owns the provider-card seat, then discovers each
model row structurally.

- The row's id input carries an `aria-label` built from the shipped page's own
  `settings.models` locale namespace (`Model ID 1`, `模型 ID 1`, …). The plugin
  binds that namespace and matches the label, so discovery follows the active
  language and never depends on a hashed CSS class name.
- It appends one container per `modelEntry` and portals a React editor into it,
  so the control lives inside the model entry and disappears with the row.
- A `MutationObserver` re-runs discovery when the fold opens, a row is added or
  removed, or the page re-renders. A shipped row restructure would need the
  selector updated.

### Saving, and the page's own Apply

The editor writes through the settings transport (`settings.mutate` path ops);
the host persists the result. The shipped page keeps its **own draft** of the
model list and its own Apply writes the whole `models` array for a hand-declared
route, which can restore the `reasoningEfforts` value the card loaded at open.

To keep the editor's value authoritative, the row remembers the declaration the
user applied and, if a later settings change reverts it, writes it again — up to
three times, so a refusal is reported instead of retried forever. Applying the
effort and then using the card's Apply for another field therefore converges on
the effort value you chose.

For a catalog route the editor uses the narrow
`providers.<route>.modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts` path, which the page's
model editor does not touch — unless the page materializes a `models` array (by
editing the model list), which the adapter refuses beside `modelOverrides`. The
row's re-apply covers that case while the card is open.

## The level vocabulary is closed and ordered

`off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` — exactly the harness's own
`THINKING_LEVELS`, in escalation order. The editor always emits the map in that
order, whatever order the chips were clicked. `off` means "do not think"; the
other six are thinking levels.

## The conversion rules (they are the adapter's)

Each chosen level becomes a key whose value is the spelling dispatch sends, so a
gateway with its own vocabulary can be renamed (`max: ultra`). The plugin
enforces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `resolveModelReasoning` rules before the
write:

| Selection | Result |
|---|---|
| `off, low, high, max` with wire values | `{ off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }` |
| `off` alone | refused — a model that cannot think uses `false` |
| nothing selected | refused — omit the field to inherit |
| a non-`off` level with no wire value | refused — it needs the value dispatch sends |
| an empty-string wire value | refused |
| a level outside the seven | refused |
| the "Non-reasoning" form | `reasoningEfforts: false` |
| the "Inherit catalog" form | the field is unset, restoring inheritance |

A declared map **replaces** the model's capability set: levels not declared are
not offered. That is why `off` must be present in the map when the user keeps
it, and why "off only" is `false` rather than `{ off: null }`.

## Where the value lands in `cordis.patch.yml`

The editor writes settings path ops; the host persists them into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. `reasoningEfforts` sits beside the fields the shipped row
already edits:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      baidu-team:
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
            reasoningEfforts: { off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }
            contextWindow: 1000000
            maxTokens: 256000
            input: [text, image]
            name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
```

The expanded spelling is equivalent and easier to hand-edit:

```yaml
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              low: 'low'
              high: 'high'
              max: 'max'
```

A model that cannot think, and one that keeps the installed catalog capability:

```yaml
          - id: acme-plain
            reasoningEfforts: false      # no selector beyond off
          - id: acme-catalog
            contextWindow: 128000        # reasoningEfforts omitted -> inherits
```

### The

plugins.description: Chess Game Plugin for Deepseek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Chess Game

国际象棋 × 两种形态：**单文件网页版**（双人同屏）+ **DeepSeek Harness Web 插件**（悬浮窗，双人/人机对战，PGN 导出）。零依赖、完全离线。

## 网页版（index.html）

两个人在同一台电脑上用鼠标轮流对战，浏览器打开 `index.html` 即玩。

- 白方先行，点一下自己的棋子（显示可走格圆点），再点一下目标格落子
- 红圈表示可吃子；被将军的王红圈高亮提示

## DSH 插件 dsh-chess-float（packages/chess-float/）

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里下棋：输入框工具栏 **♟ 按钮** → 弹出**可拖动悬浮窗**。

**功能**：

- 双人对战 / 人机对战（可选执白或执黑）
- 人机 AI：本地 negamax + αβ 剪枝引擎，5 级难度（入门→大师，难度=搜索深度，低难度带随机失误），毫秒级响应、零模型调用、完全离线
- 完整规则：王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变、将杀、逼和、50 回合规则、子力不足和棋
- 悔棋（人机模式自动回退双方各一步）、SAN 标准记谱、**PGN 棋谱导出**（可导入 Lichess / chess.com 复盘）
- 主题 token 适配明暗主题

**安装**：

```bash
# 从源码（本仓库）
dsh plugin add packages/chess-float

# 离线安装（其他机器）
mkdir -p ~/plugins/chess-float
tar -xzf dsh-chess-float-1.2.0.tgz -C ~/plugins/chess-float --strip-components=1
dsh plugin add ~/plugins/chess-float
```

预构建 tarball 见 [Releases](https://github.com/x-cores/dsh-chess-game/releases)。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可看到 ♟ 按钮。

## 正确性验证

走法引擎通过标准 perft 校验（走法枚举数与国际象棋公认参考值完全一致）：

| 测试局面 | 深度 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 初始局面 | 1–4 层 | 20 / 400 / 8,902 / 197,281 ✓ |
| CPW #3（吃过路兵密集） | 1–5 层 | 14 / 191 / 2,812 / 43,238 / 674,624 ✓ |
| CPW #4（易位/升变密集） | 1–4 层 | 6 / 264 / 9,467 / 422,333 ✓ |

AI 引擎验证：深度 3 对随机对手 71 步将杀（约 44ms/步）；大师(5) 单步约 1.2s。

## 运行测试

```bash
node test-perft.js      # perft 规则校验
node test-gameplay.js   # 完整对局路径模拟（易位/过路兵/升变/SAN）
```

plugins.description: Turn your phone's Huawei XiaoYi into a remote control for the DSH agent on your own PC. DSH (DeepSeek Harness) host plugin for XiaoYi OpenClaw mode: zero third-party deps, hand-written RFC6455 WebSocket client, AK/SK auth, heartbeat, A2A streaming, SSRF-hardened inbound attachments.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xiaoyi **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) A **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) host plugin** that connects **Huawei XiaoYi in OpenClaw mode** to your local DSH session — voice, text and images from your phone reach the agent running on your own machine. > **This is not a standalone chatbot.** XiaoYi is only the entry point; what it connects to is your local DSH session (same tools, same working directory). There is no second agent. ``` Huawei XiaoYi on your phone (anywhere) │ voice / text / images ▼ Huawei Cloud wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link │ long-lived connection (AK/SK auth + 30s heartbeat) ▼ This plugin (runs inside the DSH host process) │ ▼ DSH session xiaoyi-listen-* ``` --- ## Prerequisites This is **not** plug-and-play. Before installing, make sure you have all three: | # | Requirement | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | **A DSH host** | DSH = DeepSeek Harness. This is a host-side plugin; without a host it cannot run. | | 2 | **XiaoYi Open Platform credentials (OpenClaw mode)** | You need `AK` / `SK` / `agentId`. These are Huawei Cloud developer credentials you must apply for yourself on the XiaoYi Open Platform. | | 3 | **Node.js ≥ 20** | The code uses the built-in `fetch` / `FormData` / `Blob`. Developed on Node 24. | > If you cannot obtain item 2, you can still read this repository as a **protocol reference implementation** — `index.js` implements the XiaoYi/OpenClaw handshake, auth, heartbeat and JSON-RPC message exchange in full. ### Where do `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` come from? **They are issued by Huawei. This project cannot create them for you and cannot tell you whether your account is eligible.** You have to apply for them yourself: 1. Register a **Huawei developer account** and complete **real-name verification** — 2. Sign in to the **XiaoYi Open Platform** and create an agent — When creating it, choose the **OpenClaw mode**. Other modes are not compatible with this plugin. 3. Take the values from the agent's detail page: - `agentId` — shown in the **AgentCard** block; - `AK` / `SK` — under **Credentials → New credential**. **The SK is displayed only once**, so copy it immediately. 4. Add your own Huawei account to the agent's **test whitelist**. Until the agent is published, only whitelisted accounts can reach it; it takes effect after a few minutes. 5. Official documentation for this mode — > Menu names, entry points and the review process are decided entirely by Huawei and may change at any time. If a step above no longer matches what you see, follow Huawei's own documentation rather than this file. > This plugin only **consumes** the three credentials. It never asks Huawei for anything else on your behalf. --- ## Features - **Zero third-party dependencies.** Only Node built-ins are used, including a **hand-written minimal WebSocket client** (RFC6455 client side: text frames, fragmentation reassembly, ping/pong, and handshake verification). Fewer packages in the plugin tree means fewer chances that one failed package takes the whole host down. - **Complete protocol implementation.** Auth signing, init handshake, heartbeat with stale-connection detection, JSON-RPC 2.0 streaming, and control messages (`clearContext` / `tasks/cancel`). - **Inbound attachments.** Images and files sent from XiaoYi are downloaded to disk, and their local paths are handed to the agent in the session (ready for `read_image` / `read`). - **Outbound online files (experimental).** Send local files back to XiaoYi (the protocol only accepts public https URLs; supports a local tunnel or a third-party image host). See the direction table below — this direction is **not** reliable. - **Session reuse.** On a cold start the plugin resumes the existing session instead of opening a new conversation every time. ### What can travel in each direction | Direction | Support | | --- | --- | | **Phone → this plugin**
(what you send to XiaoYi) | **Text, voice (transcribed) and images/files all work.** Attachments are downloaded to `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/media/` and their local paths are handed to the agent. | | **This plugin → phone**
(what you get back in XiaoYi) | **Text works** — the reply body, plus anything sent with `xiaoyi_send`. **Pushing an image or file back to the phone is unreliable**: the protocol accepts only a public https URL, and the XiaoYi client is not guaranteed to render the file part. Treat `xiaoyi_send_photo` as experimental. | > In short: **the inbound direction is the reliable one.** If your workflow depends on images or files arriving on your phone, do not rely on it. --- ## Installation ### 1. Place the source Put this directory anywhere you keep plugins. The conventional location is: ``` ~/.dsh/plugin-sources/dsh-xiaoyi ``` ### 2. Register it in your profile **Option A (recommended, one command):** ```bash # install from the GitHub repository dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/HangZhouXi/dsh-xiaoyi # or from npm (after it is published there) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-xiaoyi ``` **Option B (edit by hand):** Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`: ```jsonc { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // ... "dsh-xiaoyi" // ← add to bundles ] } }, "dependencies": { // ... "dsh-xiaoyi": "git+file:///C:/Users//.dsh/plugin-sources/dsh-xiaoyi" } } ``` > A plain local path dependency also works: `"dsh-xiaoyi": "file:../../plugin-sources/dsh-xiaoyi"`. ### 3. Install and cold-start ```bash dsh plugin --profile web install ``` Then **cold-start the DSH host**. (Host-side plugins are not applied by hot reload — a cold start is required.) ### 4. Provide credentials Edit `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/state.json`: ```json { "enabled": true, "ak": "XiaoYi Open Platform AK", "sk": "XiaoYi Open Platform SK", "agentId": "agentId of your OpenClaw-mode agent", "wsUrl": "wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link", "sessionId": "", "cwd": "C:\\Users\\\\Desktop", "publicBaseUrl": "", "imageHost": "" } ``` | Field | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `enabled` | Master switch. `false` disconnects the channel. | | `ak` / `sk` / `agentId` | XiaoYi Open Platform credentials. All three are required. | | `wsUrl` | WebSocket endpoint. Leave as the default unless Huawei changes it. | | `sessionId` | The DSH session to reuse. Normally written by the plugin itself. | | `cwd` | Working directory for the session. Must be writable. | | `publicBaseUrl` | Only for outbound files in `local` mode: the public https base URL of your tunnel. | | `imageHost` | Optional default publisher for outbound files. Set `"catbox"` to make catbox.moe the default; leave empty to stay local-only. | You can also let the agent configure these at runtime with the `xiaoyi_set` tool (changes take effect immediately and reconnect). Log file: `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/xiaoyi.log` --- ## Agent tools | Tool | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `xiaoyi_status` | Channel status: whether credentials are complete, whether the WebSocket is connected, the listening session id, queue length, last error, message counters. | | `xiaoyi_set` | Update credentials / switch (`ak`, `sk`, `agentId`, `wsUrl`, `enabled`). Takes effect immediately on the live connection. | | `xiaoyi_send` | Push a short message to the current XiaoYi conversation (useful as a long-task completion notice). | | `xiaoyi_send_photo` | Send a local image or file to XiaoYi (the protocol only accepts public https; see "Outbound files" below). | | `xiaoyi_reconnect` | Force a disconnect and reconnect (after changing credentials, or when the link looks stale). | ## HTTP routes | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `GET /xiaoyi/state` | JSON status. | | `GET /xiaoyi/connect` | Start the channel and make sure the listening session is ready. | | `GET /xiaoyi/disconnect` | Stop the channel. | | `GET /xiaoyi/public/` | Serves published outbound files. Filenames carry a random compon

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：把本机 opencode 生态接入 DSH 模型菜单——OpenCode Go 订阅（经 opencode-api-plugin 网关）+ Zen 免费档（内嵌 opencode2api，无需网关运行）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-gateway

**English** | [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that wires the local opencode ecosystem into DSH's model menu with two provider routes:

| Route | Endpoint | What it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opencode-gateway` | `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1` (the local [opencode-api-plugin](https://github.com/EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin) gateway) | Everything the gateway aggregates: the OpenCode Go subscription (reading the machine's local opencode login state), OpenCode Zen, and any custom upstreams in `gateway.config.json` |
| `opencode-free` | in-process loopback proxy (default `http://127.0.0.1:10102/v1`) | The inlined opencode2api port driving the machine's own `opencode serve` backend for the Zen free tier — **no gateway process needed** |

By design this plugin ships **no usage panel**; quota display lives in the gateway's `/api/usage` and the tray.

## Features

- **Curated OpenCode Go registry** — the default menu follows the user's ZCode list (15 models); display names, context windows, effort vocabularies, vision flags and a refusal list for 41 entries, measured request-by-request and ported from [AIMFllyYS/dsh-protocom-api](https://github.com/AIMFllyYS/dsh-protocom-api) (MIT) — including the measured quirks (Go spells its disable word `off` and refuses `none`; grok/muse serve `/responses` only, which the gateway converts transparently).
- **Live model discovery** (soft-failing) — both routes mount immediately with configured/seed menus and upgrade in place once the endpoint's listing answers; a failed read keeps the current facts serving.
- **Managed backend lifecycle** — the free route spawns `opencode serve` when absent (first init ~10–20 s) and reclaims only a backend **it spawned**; one reused from the gateway stays with the gateway.
- **In-process loopback bridge** — pi-ai's transport needs a real URL, so the plugin wraps the LocalProxy functions in an HTTP listener bound to loopback only (default 10102, configurable); the listener never holds the host's event loop, so headless tasks still exit.

## System requirements

- **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2 and < 0.3.0-0** (measured peer range); verified on **0.2.0-rc.2**
- The free tier needs the opencode CLI installed; `opencode auth login` is recommended (better model list and limits, anonymous works too)
- The gateway route needs the companion gateway [EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin](https://github.com/EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin) running (`start-gateway.cmd`, `start-tray-hidden.vbs` or the tray)

## Install

### Desktop app (recommended)

Open the app, choose **Plugins** in the sidebar, click **Add plugin** and paste a local path:

```
D:/Agent/dsh-opencode-gateway
```

or a Git spec (once published):

```
github:<owner>/dsh-opencode-gateway#v0.1.0
```

Click **Install**, wait for pnpm, then click **Enable now**.

### CLI

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add "D:/Agent/dsh-opencode-gateway"
```

> The installer runs a full compatibility sandbox install, which can take many minutes on this machine; hand-composing the profile is faster — see the Chinese README.

## Configure

The plugin installs no settings UI; configuration lives in the composition layer (the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/` on the desktop app) and takes effect on restart:

```yaml
- id: opencode-gateway
  name: dsh-opencode-gateway
  config:
    gateway:
      provider: opencode-gateway
      displayName: OpenCode Go
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GATEWAY_KEY
      hiddenModels: ["free/"]
      models: []
    free:
      provider: opencode-free
      serverUrl: http://127.0.0.1:10001
      proxyPort: 10102
      opencodePath: opencode
      manageBackend: true
      zenApiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY
      disableTools: true
      internalAllowedTools: [webfetch, bash, websearch]
```

## Model manager page

DSH settings gain an **OpenCode Gateway** section (plugin v0.2.0+): one card per route (OpenCode Go / OpenCode Free) managing that route's model menu.

- **Refresh** pulls the live listing (OpenCode Go via the gateway's `/v1/models`, OpenCode Free via the inlined proxy's backend listing).
- **Checkboxes** decide what lands in the model menu (composer chip included); newly discovered models are tagged and unchecked.
- **Save checked** commits one revision-fenced settings write; the menu and chip update immediately and survive restarts; a conflict reloads the snapshot and drops staging.
- **Restore defaults** unsets that route's `models` — the menu falls back to the shipped list (or the composition `models`, when configured).

Precedence: saved settings `models` (even an empty array) > composition `cordis.patch.yml` `models` > shipped defaults. Saved entries that carry only id/name/context are enriched by the host from the measured registry (missing effort vocabulary and vision flags; an explicit `reasoningEfforts: false` is never touched). Backend-structural fields (serverUrl / proxyPort / opencodePath …) ask for a restart when changed on the page; the model menu applies live.

### Environment (`~/.dsh/.env`)

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `OPENCODE_GATEWAY_KEY` | The gateway's Bearer token; **any non-empty value works while the gateway runs without a token** (a missing credential fails before network I/O with `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`) |
| `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY` | Passed to the backend as `OPENCODE_API_KEY` to unlock paid models; falls back to the local opencode login state (v0.1 reads the process environment only, not the credentials seam) |

### `models[]` entries

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The model id the endpoint accepts, forwarded verbatim |
| `name` | Selector label |
| `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` | Capacities; `maxTokens` also becomes that model's per-request default output cap |
| `reasoningEfforts` | `false` declares a non-reasoning model; a dict `{level: wire spelling}`, where only `off` may be empty (send nothing) |
| `input` | `["text","image"]` declares image input |

## How it works

- **Two routes, one adapter**: `PiAiAdapter` reads the current profiles snapshot once per operation; changed discovery facts atomically `replace` the registration — no restart, no disturbed in-flight stream.
- **Loopback bridge**: request bodies buffer into a fetch `Request`; responses stream back out. A mid-stream drop after the headers are flushed destroys the socket instead of throwing `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` into the server callback.
- **Single retry layer**: the plugin's `retryPolicy` defaults to `normal/maxRetries 0` — retries belong to the gateway (subscription routes) or the inlined proxy (free route), never both.
- **Thinking bridging**: `reasoning_content`, `reasoning` + `reasoning_details`, and inline think tags all flow through pi-ai's delta parser into DSH's reasoning-delta collapse (the gateway strips Go routes' inline tags server-side).

## Known limits (v0.1)

- **No usage panel** (by design); quota lives in `/api/usage` + the tray.
- **`zenApiKeyEnv` reads the process environment only**; stored credential references are not resolved yet.
- **Headless one-shot tasks linger on exit**: a control run with this plugin removed lingers the same way — DSH headless base behavior, not this plugin.
- Two processes racing to spawn the same backend port (10001): a failed spawn surfaces an error and a retry succeeds; health-check-before-spawn mitigates it.

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build   # tsdown → lib/index.js (Host, ESM); tsc -b → lib/types
pnpm run test    # vitest
```

The `lib/` build output is committed alongside the sources (git installs need no build) — run `pnpm run build` before committing code changes.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 — contains the embedded opencode2api implementation ported from opencode-api-plugin (itself ported from [TiaraBasori/opencode2api](https://github.com/TiaraBasori/opencode2api), MIT; license copy at `assets/LICENSE.md`), and the OpenCode Go registry measurements from dsh-protocom-api (MIT).

plugins.description: Automatic guitar-tab transcriber & synced player generator as an Agent Skill — works with DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude Code and compatible harnesses
plugins.readme_text:
# Guitar Tab Maker · 吉他谱工坊

自动扒歌 + 生成「边播放边跳和弦」的吉他跟练播放器。技能目录形式，遵循 [Agent Skills](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/agent-skills) 规范（`SKILL.md` + `scripts/`），**可直接被 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）、Claude Code 等兼容 harness 加载**。

## 它做什么

输入一首歌的音频（mp3/wav/m4a/flac），输出单文件 HTML 播放器：

- 原曲音频内嵌（**不转调、不损伤音质**）
- 和弦随播放进度跳动高亮，附下一个和弦预告
- 每个和弦带指法图（开放和弦 + 大横按）
- 每小节标注扫弦箭头（8 个八分音符格）
- 歌词逐行同步、段落快捷跳转、播放变速跟练

## 工作管线

| 脚本 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `scripts/fetch_lrc.py` | 双通道抓带时间轴歌词（酷我 musicId 优先，网易云兜底） |
| `scripts/analyze_song.py` | librosa 扒谱：beat 追踪 + 调内白名单 HMM/Viterbi + 小节制合并 |
| `scripts/verify_song.py` | 音频-谱面一致性校验（低频频谱根音比对），防原调标错/文件错配 |
| `scripts/build_songs.py` | 按配置重建曲库；指法和弦按 `(原调根音 − capo) mod 12` 自动换算 |
| `scripts/build_player.py` | 音频 base64 注入模板，生成单文件 HTML |
| `scripts/validate_player.py` | 成品综合校验（占位符/字段/段落索引/图库覆盖） |

## 快速开始

依赖：Python 3.10+、[ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)、Node.js（仅 harness 加载需要）。

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1) 歌词
python scripts/fetch_lrc.py --title 歌名 --artist 歌手 --kuwo-id 358603096 --out lrc.json
# 2) 扒谱（原调根音与 BPM 为粗略先验，可用网络资料）
python scripts/analyze_song.py --audio song.mp3 --key-root Bb --key-mode minor --bpm 89 --lrc lrc.json --out analysis.json
# 3) 一致性校验（必跑）
python scripts/verify_song.py --audio song.mp3 --analysis analysis.json
# 4) 写配置（参考 examples/songs.example.json）后构建
python scripts/build_songs.py --config songs.json --template assets/player_template.html --out built.html
python scripts/build_player.py --template built.html --out player.html --audio 1=song.mp3
# 5) 终验
python scripts/validate_player.py player.html
```

完整 SOP、变调夹选法与踩坑检查点见 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)。

## 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用

把整个目录放到 dsh 的技能发现路径即可，无需转换：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`（或 `~/.agents/skills/`，Claude Code 同根）
- 项目级：`<repo>/.agents/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`

dsh 只发现发现根下的**直接**子目录（不递归），不要嵌套两层。frontmatter 支持 `disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable` 两个 dsh 专属开关。

## 免责声明

- 输出为**参考级谱面**：AI 听辨的切换点可能有小偏差，可在 `SONGS` 数据中改 `t` 值自行校准。
- 本仓库**不含任何歌曲音频或歌词**；请仅对自己有权使用的内容扒谱，并自行处理版权。
- MIT License。

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that replaces the font settings in general settings with searchable font pickers.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-font-settings

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web plugin that replaces the font settings in **Settings → General** with searchable font pickers: text, code, and terminal fonts are set independently, and the fonts installed on your machine can be listed on request.

The shipped rows ask you to type a comma-separated font name from memory. This plugin shows you the list instead — and draws every candidate in its own face, so you pick by sight.

## Features

- **Searchable pickers** for the text, code, and terminal font roles. Focus or type to open the list; ↑/↓ move with wrap-around, Enter applies, Escape cancels the edit, a click outside closes it.
- **Every row is drawn in the family it would apply**, so a candidate is recognized by how it looks rather than by its name.
- **Free text still works.** Anything not in the list can be typed; the harness normalizes it (names are quoted, generic families stay bare) and it becomes the field's value.
- **Load the fonts installed on this machine** with one button (Chromium-based browsers expose the list through `queryLocalFonts`; where it is unsupported or denied, the button says so and everything else keeps working). The catalog is searchable rather than dumped: type part of a family name and its matches are listed.
- **Font size for every role**, next to its font picker.
- **Collapsed by default** to a single "Font settings" row with a chevron disclosure, so the General list stays compact. The current text font is summarised on the collapsed row.
- **The system default is always one click away** — the first entry in every list clears the override.

## Install

The plugin installs as a profile bundle. Use the Web sidebar's **Plugins** page, or the `plugin_manager` tool's `install_bundle` (it requires `danger-full-access`). The spec can be a git address, a local path, or a registry name:

- **From GitHub**: `https://github.com/yiqiuacc/dsh-font-settings.git` (the manager runs `git ls-remote` against GitHub before installing; pnpm's `github:yiqiuacc/dsh-font-settings` shorthand works too).
- **From a local checkout**: `link:<absolute path to this directory>`.
- **From a registry** once published: `@styiqiu/dsh-font-settings`.

Installing enables the bundle by default. Opening **Settings → General** then shows one "Font settings" row where the built-in font group used to be.

## Where the choice is stored

The plugin owns no storage and no stylesheet. Every read and write goes through the harness theme service (`ctx.theme`), so the shipped machinery does the rest:

- **Persistence** — the settings scope stores each list and size; the profile records them as the `ui-theme` config row of its `cordis.patch.yml`.
- **First paint** — the harness boot script embeds the stored lists into the served index HTML, so a page never flashes the default font before applying yours.
- **Application** — the theme presenter writes `--dsh-font-family-<role>` onto `body` as inline styles, and the token sheet composes the interface and code stacks from them.

Because both surfaces read one store, this plugin's choices and the built-in font rows are always the same data. (Once installed, the built-in rows are not rendered — they are shadowed, see below.)

## How it works

- `client.js` is the whole plugin. It registers one entry in the General section's item slot **using the built-in entry's id at a lower priority**, which shadows that entry: a list slot renders one row per id and the lowest priority wins. The group replaces the built-in font rows rather than sitting beside them.
- The field and the candidate card are the shared client primitives — `Input`, `MenuSurface`, and `MenuGroup` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, a client baseline module — so the shared field geometry, menu material, sticky group headings, and focus behavior come from the harness rather than from this plugin.
- The committed list is adopted as the field's text only while the field does not hold the keyboard, so a write landing while you type — including the echo of your own commit — cannot replace what you typed or move the caret.
- The `theme` service is taken through a scoped injection (`ctx.inject(['theme'], …)`). Where that service is absent, the plugin registers nothing at all: the built-in font settings keep their place and the plugin is simply inert. The outer plugin never waits on the service, so a composition without it still boots.
- `index.js` is an **empty mount shell** (`export function apply() {}`). A profile bundle needs a mountable Host plugin for the Loader row to exist, and the browser bundle is discovered from that live entry — but this plugin has no Host-side behavior left.
- No build step and no dependencies of its own: plain ES modules, with React and the client primitives supplied by the client module loader.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` web (and Desktop, which uses the same web profile template).
- The local-font button needs a Chromium-based browser. Everything else is engine-neutral.
- `ctx.theme` is a **pre-stable API**: the harness states that public APIs can change, so a harness upgrade may require updating this plugin.

## Known limitations

- **The local catalog is listed only while filtering, and at most 24 rows of it.** Every row is painted in the family it would apply, and a cold font cache loads one font face per distinct family — hundreds of rows in one open stall the page for seconds. The curated list is unaffected; a filtered local list costs about what the curated one costs.
- **The group sits above "Appearance".** Shadowing requires a lower slot priority, and a list slot sorts by priority, so the group renders first in the General section. This cannot be avoided while replacing the built-in rows.
- **It depends on the built-in entry id `font-size`.** If a future harness renames that entry, the shadow stops applying and this group renders **beside** the built-in font rows instead of replacing them — duplicated controls, no crash and no error.
- **The roles are independent.** There is no "also replace the monospace font" switch: the code and terminal roles have their own pickers.
- **No separate preview block** — each list row is already drawn in its own face.
- **No font-size formatting beyond the harness ranges** (text 10–22, code 10–16, terminal 10–20 px); the steppers clamp to them.

## Development

There is nothing to build and nothing to install.

- Edit `client.js` and reload the page — the client bundle is fetched per page load.
- Only a change to `index.js` (the mount shell) needs a server restart.
- `README.zh.md` is the Chinese counterpart of this file.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: AI-written. Lazy-start a local llama.cpp model on demand and release RAM/VRAM when idle, with a DSH plugin. 由 AI 编写：本地大模型「用到才起、不用就放」—— 按需冷启动 + 空闲自动释放 + 假上下文上限兜住压缩
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-local-model-supervisor

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**

> **Lazy-start a local llama.cpp model when DSH needs it, release RAM/VRAM when it doesn't.**
>
> **本地大模型「用到才起、不用就放」:按需冷启动 + 空闲自动释放 + 一个假的上下文上限来兜住压缩。**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **AI-written code.** Every file in this repository was produced by an AI coding agent, not by
> hand — see **[AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md)** before you run it. It was verified on a
> single Windows machine, with no security review and no test suite.
>
> **本项目由 AI 编写。** 全部代码与文档均由 AI 编码助手产出,不是手写的 —— 运行前请先读
> **[AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md)**。仅在作者的一台 Windows 机器上验证过,无安全审计、无测试套件。

A local-model supervisor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai). It occupies the
ports your DSH local routes already point at and runs `llama-server` on private internal ports:
the model is loaded on the first request and **all RAM/VRAM is given back once it goes idle**.
Ships with a DSH plugin so the whole thing starts and stops with DSH.

```
DSH ──> 127.0.0.1:8080 (supervisor, always resident: ~30 MB RAM, 0 VRAM)
              │
              ├─ first inference request ──> 127.0.0.1:9080 (llama-server, started on demand)
              └─ 500s with no requests   ──> llama-server killed, VRAM released
```

---

## 1. Why this exists

DSH's local routes go through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, whose config is just
`api: openai-completions` + `baseURL` — it is a plain **HTTP client**. It has no hook that could
execute `llama-server.exe`. So in practice: the model is statically configured and always visible
in the model picker, but selecting it while nothing is running just fails to connect, and
**nothing will ever start it for you**.

The decision to lazy-start has to happen *before* the request reaches llama-server, so it can only
be intercepted at the HTTP layer. This project makes the supervisor **occupy the ports DSH is
already talking to** and moves the real llama-server to internal ports — so **no DSH configuration
has to change at all**, and curl / Python / any other client gets the same behaviour for free.

## 2. Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Only inference routes wake a model** | A stray request to the port must not load a multi-GB model — and, with a single GPU slot, must not kill whatever is serving. Non-inference paths get a plain 404 (with the caller's User-Agent logged) while nothing is loaded. Added after a client polling `GET /wyvrn/Synapse` swapped the resident model 24 times and cut off live generations. |
| **Never kills a live generation** | Switching models checks whether the resident model still has active requests; if it is mid-stream the switch is refused with a 503 explaining why, instead of cutting the stream off. |
| **Cheap while idle** | The resident supervisor is one Node process and measures ~2–4 MB above a bare `node.exe` on the same machine (bare node 36.9 MB, supervisor ~38–41 MB RSS; JS heap ~6 MB). It holds **no VRAM at all** until a request arrives. `node supervisor.js` also reports its own breakdown at `GET /__supervisor/status` → `memory`. |
| **One unified model list** | Declare any number of local models in a single list. Give a **`path`** and the supervisor manages the process; give a **`url`** and it just forwards to a server you already run (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, …). Two fields per entry is enough. |
| **Ports allocated automatically** | The *i*-th model takes `publicBase + i`; managed models take the next free port at or above `internalBase`, skipping anything claimed. Collisions are rejected at startup, never at spawn time. |
| **Routes generated for you** | `scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1` turns the list into a ready-to-paste DSH `providers:` block, so importing a model does not mean hand-writing YAML. |
| **Cold start on demand** | The first inference request spawns llama-server, waits for health, then proxies. Clients never need to retry. |
| **Idle release** | After `idleTimeoutSec` (default 500s) with no requests the process is killed and **both RAM and VRAM are returned**. The countdown starts when the last request *ends*, so long generations are never cut off. |
| **Metadata never wakes the GPU** | `/health` and `/v1/models` are answered synthetically; `/props` and `/metrics` return 503 while unloaded. **Otherwise a client polling `/v1/models` would pin the VRAM forever.** |
| **Single GPU slot** | Requesting a different model stops the current one first (one card cannot hold two). |
| **Soft context ceiling ("fake overflow")** | A fake ceiling below the real window forces DSH to compact while redundancy still exists — see section 5. |
| **Compaction grace window** | After a rejection, requests are let through for a while, so the summarization replay cannot be blocked by the same ceiling. |
| **Cold-start protection** | A 1-token warm-up plus a settle delay, and one automatic restart-and-replay if the server still dies on its first large request. |
| **Streaming preserved** | Byte-for-byte `pipe` forwarding; SSE works untouched. |
| **DSH plugin** | Starts/stops with DSH, plus `/localmodel status \| unload \| start` from any chat. |

## 3. Quick start

### 3.1 Requirements

- **Node.js ≥ 18** (standard library only — no third-party dependencies)
- **llama.cpp**'s `llama-server` (CUDA / Vulkan / CPU all work; developed against a Windows CUDA build)
- **PowerShell 7+** (optional, only for the `.ps1` helper scripts; the supervisor itself is pure Node)

### 3.2 Configure

```bash
cp supervisor/models.example.json supervisor/models.json
```

`models` is **one unified list** that accepts both kinds of local model source. All an entry needs
is a `name` plus either `path` or `url`:

```jsonc
{
  "idleTimeoutSec": 500,                       // how long before a model is released
  "ports": { "publicBase": 8080, "internalBase": 9080 },

  "defaults": {                                // applied to every managed model
    "ctxSize": 32768,
    "cacheTypeK": "q8_0",
    "cacheTypeV": "q4_0",
    "softContextRatio": 0.75                   // softContextLimit = ctxSize * this
  },

  "llamaServer": {
    "bin": "C:\\path\\to\\llama-server.exe",
    "args": [ "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--threads", "8", "--flash-attn", "on", "--jinja", ... ]
  },

  "models": [
    { "name": "qwen-2bit", "path": "D:\\models\\Qwen-2bit.gguf" },
    { "name": "qwen-4bit", "path": "D:\\models\\Qwen-4bit.gguf", "ctxSize": 16384, "mtp": true },
    { "name": "ollama",    "url":  "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1" },
    { "name": "lmstudio",  "url":  "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1" }
  ]
}
```

| Entry | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **`path`** — managed | The supervisor spawns llama-server for that file, cold-starts it on the first request and releases RAM/VRAM when idle. |
| **`url`** — external | An already-running OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, another llama.cpp). The supervisor only **forwards** to it on its own public port; it is never started or stopped, so external entries get no idle release. |

**Ports are handed out for you.** The *i*-th entry takes `publicBase + i`, and each managed entry
takes the next free port at or above `internalBase` — skipping anything already claimed, so even a
deliberately overlapping base pair (8080 / 8081) can never hand the same port to two things.
Set `publicPort` / `internalPort` on an entry to override; genuine duplicates are rejected at
startup with a clear error instead of failing later at spawn time.

**Backwards compatible.** `common` is still accepted as an alias for `llamaServer`, and the legacy
explicit schema (`publicPort` / `internalPort` / `model` / `args` per entry) keeps working unchanged.

### 3.3 Generate the DSH routes

Declaring a model is only half the job — DSH also needs a route pointing at it, and hand-writing
YAML for every model does not scale. Generate it from the same config instead:

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1                          # print to stdout
pwsh -File scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1 -OutFile ..\routes.yml   # or write it to a file
```

It emits a ready-to-paste `providers:` block — one route per model, pointing at that model's
supervisor public port, with `contextW

plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — sections any plugin contributes are hashed and baselined; silent rewrites fail loud
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-drift

System-prompt surface drift gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Any plugin or preset can contribute sections to the assembled system prompt.
Upgrading one can silently rewrite what the model is **told**; a malicious
one can inject "ignore all safety rules" straight into the prompt. This
plugin hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, hashes every section
(name → sha256(text)), baselines the surface, and diffs every later
assembly against it. **dsh-mcp-test guards what the model can call; this
guards what the model is told.** Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. The nearest neighbour (`dsh-modelprint`, 0★) fingerprints model
config, not the prompt surface. Prompt-injection plugins scan *content
flowing in*; nobody watches the assembled prompt itself — the one channel
every plugin can write to without anyone reviewing a diff.

## How it works

```
system-prompt/assemble ──> sections [{name, sha256(text)}] name-sorted
                     ──> baseline absent? freeze it (commit the file)
                     ──> diff: added / removed / changed sections
                     ──> warn once per distinct drift (signature dedup)
```

Dynamic sections (cwd, timestamps) can be excluded via `ignoreSections`.
Baseline file is stable, name-sorted JSON — commit it; it is the contract.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-drift
  name: dsh-prompt-drift
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-prompt-drift/baseline.json
    rebaselineOnDrift: false
    ignoreSections: []
```

## Develop
